description:
**Company Description**  

Egis is a leading global consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work together with our clients, across every aspect of transport, energy, and the built environment to build a more balanced, sustainable, and resilient world. The Egis Group has more than 50 years of experience and a team of 25,500 employees in over 70 countries around the world. Joining our Group means, above all, sharing our values as a people\-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation.


In the UK and Ireland, we are proud to be delivering some of the most iconic projects which help connect people, protect our environment, and meet emission reduction targets. From highways, rail and operations and maintenance, to energy, water, nuclear and smart infrastructure, clients choose us to help them solve their most complex challenges \- delivering climate\-responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industry and the planet.

 **Job Description**  

Reporting to the GSSC Talent Acquisition Lead, with an operational link to the UK\&I Talent Acquisition team, the Talent Sourcing Partner will provide dedicated sourcing, headhunting, market mapping and candidate identification support across UK\&I recruitment activity.


The role is designed to support all UK\&I business lines, flexing across different markets depending on recruitment demand and business priority. This may include Transport, O\&M, Water, Nuclear, Defence, Architecture, PMCM, Commercial, Engineering, Aviation, Buildings, Early Careers and Ireland. While the role is generalist in coverage, it may develop specialist knowledge in priority markets where demand, scarcity or growth requires deeper sourcing focus.


This role is part of the proposed UK\&I hybrid Talent Acquisition operating model. Position: Sales Intern

Location: Coimbatore 

Experience: Freshers can apply

**COMPANY PROFILE**

SKYX AEROSPACE is a leading AI Enabled Drone Tech Startup that manufactures and devolops innovative drone technology solutions designed for various applications including agriculture, logistics, surveillance, and industrial solutions. We are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) and delivering cutting\-edge products and technology\-driven solutions to our clients.

**JOB SUMMARY**

We are looking for three energetic and motivated Sales Interns to support our growing Sales and Business Development team.

The selected interns will work under the guidance of the Sales Manager and assist with lead generation, customer calls, lead qualification, meeting coordination, sales follow\-ups, market research and government tender activities.

Based on their skills, interests and performance during the screening process, the selected candidates will be assigned to one of the following focus areas:

* Agricultural Drone Sales
* Enterprise Drone Solutions and Projects
* Government Tenders and Bid Support

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Generate prospective customer and project leads through online research, databases, professional networks, referrals and other approved sources.
* Contact inbound and outbound leads through telephone calls, email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and other authorised channels.
* Understand customer requirements and validate leads based on application, location, budget, timeline and business potential.
* Schedule customer meetings, product discussions, demonstrations and follow\-up calls for the Sales Manager.
* Follow up with customers after meetings, demonstrations, quotations and proposal submissions.
* Maintain accurate lead details, communication records, follow\-up dates and opportunity status in the company’s sales tracker or CRM.
* Research opportunities across agriculture, mining, roadways, infrastructure, industrial inspection and other emerging drone applications.
* Assist in preparing presentations, quotations, proposals, company profiles and sales materials.
* Monitor relevant government procurement portals and identify suitable tenders and project opportunities.
* Support tender documentation, eligibility verification, compliance checklists and submission tracking.
* Coordinate with technical, operations, GIS, accounts and other internal teams to collect information required for customers, proposals and tenders.
* Support the company during exhibitions, product demonstrations, customer visits and promotional events.
* Prepare regular reports on calls, qualified leads, meetings, follow\-ups, project opportunities and tender status.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Should have passed and hold a degree in Diploma at least.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and research skills.
* Confidence in speaking with prospective customers over telephone calls and during meetings.
* Good written English and professional email communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
* Ability to maintain organised records and complete follow\-ups consistently.
* Willingness to learn about drone technology, its applications and government procurement processes.
* Comfortable working with targets and measurable activity goals.
* Strong attention to detail, especially for documentation and tender\-related work.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings, demonstrations, exhibitions or project visits when required.
* Previous exposure to sales, business development, telecalling, market research or government tenders will be an advantage but is not mandatory.

**BENEFITS**

* Practical exposure to sales and business development in the drone industry.
* Training in agricultural drones, enterprise drone solutions and government tender processes.
* Guidance and mentoring from the Sales Manager.
* Opportunities to participate in customer meetings, demonstrations, exhibitions and project discussions.
* Experience in lead generation, customer qualification, CRM management, proposal support and tender documentation.
* Possibility of full\-time employment based on performance, available positions and business requirements.

title: Senior IT Recruitment Lead & Account Manager
description:
This is a remote position.


**Senior IT Recruitment Lead \& Account Manager**
=================================================

**Location:** Remote / Hybrid  

  



**Experience Level:** 5\+ Years  

  



**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  

  



**Role Summary**
----------------

We are seeking a results\-driven **Senior IT Recruitment Lead \& Account Manager** to own end\-to\-end client relationships, lead team delivery, and manage hands\-on technical recruitment for niche software engineering and infrastructure roles.  

  



In this dual\-impact role, you will bridge the gap between client management and technical sourcing. You will act as the primary point of contact for multiple client accounts, direct intake calls and rate negotiations, and lead a recruitment team while maintaining an active hands\-on role in sourcing top\-tier technical talent across US and domestic markets.  

  



**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Account Management \& Delivery Ownership**

* Act as the primary Point of Contact (POC) for direct client accounts, managing end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle and intake calls.
* Negotiate rate cards, manage client SLAs, and drive metrics including submission\-to\-interview (3:1\) and interview\-to\-offer (4:1\) ratios.
* Expand existing accounts through high delivery performance, fast turnarounds, and consistent quality.
* Prepare and present recruitment metrics (time\-to\-fill, closures, SLA adherence) to internal stakeholders and executive leadership.

### **Team Leadership \& Mentorship**

* Lead, mentor, and assign requisitions to recruiters and associates, tracking daily targets and delivery pipelines.
* Serve as the first level of escalation for recruitment and client delivery blockers.
* Train junior recruiters and interns on advanced sourcing, resume screening, candidate assessment, and ATS management.

### **Hands\-On Technical Recruitment**

* Execute full\-cycle recruitment as an individual contributor for niche and leadership technical positions (Junior ICs to Technical Leads, Architects, and Managers).
* Hire across domains including **Cloud, AI/ML, DevOps, Data Platforms/Analytics, Full\-Stack, Mobile, UI/UX, and Cybersecurity**.
* Deploy headhunting, passive candidate outreach, and Boolean/X\-Ray sourcing strategies across LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, Dice, Monster, and GitHub.
* Utilize modern AI\-assisted tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok) to optimize sourcing efficiency, market benchmarking, and screening workflows.

### **US \& Global Staffing Operations**

* Manage requisitions across multiple engagement models, including Direct Hire (FTE), Contract, and Contract\-to\-Hire (C2H).
* Navigate US staffing tax terms (**W2, 1099, C2C**) and ensure compliance with US visa classifications (**H1B, Green Card, US Citizen, etc.**).
* Manage requisitions and candidate submissions through VMS and MSP platforms (e.g., **SAP Fieldglass, Beeline**).

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
-------------------------------------

* **Experience:** 5\+ years of full\-cycle IT technical recruitment experience spanning both Domestic (India) and US staffing operations.
* **Dual Capabilities:** Proven track record acting simultaneously as an Individual Contributor (IC) and Account Manager/Team Lead.
* **Domain Expertise:** Strong functional understanding of hiring within Cloud, DevOps, AI/ML, Infrastructure, Data Engineering, and Full\-Stack development domains.
* **US Staffing Logistics:** Strong knowledge of US visa statuses (H1B, GC, USC) and tax classifications (W2, C2C, 1099\).

description:

**ABOUT AMGEN**


If you feel like you are part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever\-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of. Join us.


**Role Summary**


The Senior Manager, Global Mobility Operations leads the day\-to\-day operational delivery of Amgen's global mobility and immigration programs, ensuring employees are supported through compliant, efficient and consistent relocation and immigration services. This role translates enterprise mobility strategy into operational execution while leading service delivery, vendor engagement, process improvement, compliance and a high\-performing team.


The role leads service delivery, vendor engagement, operational performance, process improvement, compliance and a high\-performing Global Mobility Operations team with full people\-management accountability.


As a trusted advisor to HR, Talent Acquisition and business leaders, the Senior Manager helps deliver an exceptional employee experience that enables Amgen to attract and move talent in support of its mission to serve patients.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead day\-to\-day execution of global mobility programs supporting domestic and international employee movement.
* Translate enterprise mobility strategy, policy direction and business objectives into team priorities, operating plans, service standards, KPIs and measurable operational outcomes.
* Drive operational excellence through process improvements, automation and standardized ways of working.
* Ensure consistent execution of mobility policies, procedures and operational governance.
* Oversee operational delivery of relocation services supporting new hires, international assignments, transfers and localization activities.
* Lead the processes while partnering with internal Tax, external tax provider, team members and HR leaders, related to cross\-border, non\-traditional movement for remote work and role relocation requests
* Oversee operational processes for trailing equity and trailing bonus for our Mobile population, coordinating with tax vendor and providing guidance to internal payrolls, HR and staff members
* Partner with Tax vendor and provide oversight to global payrolls related to shadow payroll reporting for compensation, relocation and trailing income
* Resolve complex operational issues while balancing employee experience, compliance and business priorities.
* Own operational performance and outcomes across Global Mobility Operations, including service quality, compliance, timeliness, employee experience and continuous improvement.
* Partner with external providers to support timely and effective service delivery.
* Support complex immigration matters in partnership with the Immigration support members on the team to provide guidance, escalation management and issue resolution.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Talent Acquisition and business leaders on mobility processes and relocation solutions.
* Partner closely with the Global Mobility COE Strategy Lead to implement enterprise mobility strategy and policy updates.
* Deliver reporting and operational insights that support program effectiveness and continuous improvement.
* Partner with the COE on day\-to\-day operational engagement with relocation providers, immigration counsel and other mobility partners.
* Monitor service delivery, operational performance and issue resolution while partnering with Global Mobility COE Lead on vendor governance.
* Manage assigned Global Mobility operational budgets and/or vendor spend, including forecasting, monitoring expenditures and allocating resources within approved parameters.
* Lead, coach and develop a high\-performing Global Mobility Operations team of 3 direct reports, with full accountability for people management, performance and development.
* Set priorities, allocate resources and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Build capability through coaching, feedback, development planning and knowledge sharing.
* Ensure compliance with applicable immigration, employment, payroll, tax and data privacy requirements.
* Maintain operational documentation, audit readiness and governance processes.
* Identify risks and recommend mitigation actions that strengthen service quality and compliance.

**What We Expect from You**

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, International Business, Law or a related field.
* 11\+ years of progressive experience in Global Mobility, Immigration, International Human Resources or a related discipline within a global organization.
* Experience leading operational teams and developing high\-performing talent.
* Strong knowledge of global mobility operations, relocation and immigration processes.
* Experience partnering with external service providers and managing operational delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders across a matrixed organization.
* Strong analytical, communication and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree or professional certification such as GMS, CRP, SHRM or equivalent.
* Experience supporting scientific, technical or executive populations.
* Experience managing operational budgets and/or significant external vendor spend**.**
* Experience with mobility technology, reporting tools or process automation.

*Join PacificSource and help our members access quality, affordable care!*

The Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) is responsible for developing and implementing HR practices and strategies that are aligned with business objectives and ensuring alignment between employees and management in designated business units. The successful HRBP acts as a consultant to business partners through the development of partnerships within the HR department and defined business units, an employee champion by developing practices that create an exceptional employee experience, and a change agent by assisting the organization in driving business objectives. Through proactive communication within the HR department and business managers, the HRBP identifies trends or issues and works with internal and external stakeholders to develop integrated solutions that help further organizational objectives.**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Executes practices and strategies across multiple HR domains including, but not limited to, organizational development, succession planning, workforce development, employee retention, organization design, and change management; identifies training needs for business units and individual executive coaching needs.
* Fosters an employee\-oriented culture that emphasizes quality, continuous improvement, high performance, and champions diversity and inclusion; works closely with management and employees to improve work relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
* Serves as primary point of contact for leadership and employees in assigned departments; drives to understand business units and their strategic initiatives.
* Provides guidance to business partners around workforce planning, strategy and operations, and HR practices. Provides day\-to\-day performance management guidance to management (e.g., coaching, counseling, career development, disciplinary actions).
* Maintains knowledge and ensures high ethical standard practice while ensuring compliance of all existing governmental and labor legal and government reporting requirements; maintains in\-depth knowledge of legal requirements related to day\-to\-day management of employees in order to reduce legal risks and ensure regulatory compliance. Partners with the legal department as needed.

* Develops and maintains relationships with key stakeholders both internal and external, works with other HR\-functions to assure consistent practices, policies, and procedures.

**Education, Certificates, Licenses:** Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or related field or equivalent years of experience required

Ability to maintain strict confidentiality with respect to employee related sensitive issues. Demonstrated knowledge of organizational design and organizational development principles. Agility to work comfortably in ambiguity and influence all levels of the organization. Solid understanding of HR policies/procedures, as well as local, state and federal employment laws. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Role description**  

### **Our Team**



At Cimpress Open, we are an emerging, dynamic, and expanding team dedicated to bringing Cimpress's unique mass customization capabilities to a global audience. Our ambition is to become the "print button" of the internet, leveraging the agility of a new entity within the Cimpress powerhouse.


The wider Cimpress organization comprises more than a dozen brands, collectively serving tens of millions of customers each year. Each brand offers tailored value propositions to meet the specific needs of its market. With a decentralized structure and autonomy, Cimpress empowers these brands to stay close to their customers. Cimpress Open will build on this foundation, benefiting from and advancing it through a focus on collaboration and driving positive change.



We are poised for significant growth, partnering with like\-minded organizations that share our ambition to empower people worldwide to make an impression through personalized, meaningful physical products.



Our Culture: We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We are a tightly knit, highly collaborative team that relies on open communication, psychological safety, and a healthy dose of humor to get things done. If you thrive in a friendly, witty, and fast\-paced environment, you’ll fit right in.


### **What You Will Do**


* Raise the AI Bar in Merchandising: Serve as the product champion for our AI Merchandising. You will own the strategy and execution of leveraging artificial intelligence to completely transform content management for our partner network.
* Architect the Catalogue Lifecycle: Evolve our core Catalogue Management and Lifecycle Capabilities. You'll ensure seamless tracking, optimization, and visibility of catalogue performance across all partners.
* Scale the Inventory Engine: Take ownership of managing and expanding our core Inventory services, ensuring seamless and highly reliable inventory capabilities applicable across all diverse partner models.
* Drive High\-Visibility, Cross\-Org Collaboration: Act as a critical bridge. You will collaborate closely with our Senior PMs to power our models across our partner ecosystems. Beyond Cimpress Open, you will skillfully navigate and manage a large set of stakeholders across the broader, global Cimpress organization.
* Own and Deliver a Bold Feature Roadmap: Translate partner pain points and emerging tech opportunities into a prioritized, high\-impact backlog. You will balance rapid, high\-value wins with long\-term architectural scalability.
* Measure What Matters: Track and analyze key performance metrics regarding catalogue health, content accuracy, and partner onboarding efficiency to relentlessly iterate on your product space.
* Learn, Build, and Scale: Work hand\-in\-hand with our engineering and business teams. We don't believe in copy\-pasting solutions just because they worked elsewhere; we want an entrepreneurial PM eager to experiment, raise the bar, and learn from every milestone.

### **Required Skill Sets**


* 7\+ years of experience in product management, ideally within e\-commerce (experience working in a large e\-commerce organisation such as Amazon or Flipkart is a plus), SaaS, digital design, or marketplace platforms.
* A strong technical curiosity, with hands\-on experience using Generative AI and AI/ML automation tools, and a real interest in applying them to content and merchandising workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with structured product data \- complex data structures, product catalogues, data mapping, Content Management Systems (CMS) at scale, or marketplace operations.
* Exceptional stakeholder and relationship management skills \- you know how to influence, align, and collaborate with engineering peers, senior product leaders, and diverse business teams.
* Top\-tier communication skills, with the unique ability to translate complex data mapping and technical AI concepts into simple, crystal\-clear product requirements.
* A thriving startup mindset: You are highly comfortable with ambiguity, proactive about taking initiative, and excited to wear multiple hats in a fast\-paced, greenfield environment.

### **Why You'll Love Working Here**



Cimpress Open offers an inclusive, growth\-oriented environment where your impact is felt immediately. We work remotely, fostering a culture of high accountability and true autonomy. Join us to play a foundational role in a greenfield initiative that leverages cutting\-edge technology to shape customer expectations and the future of Cimpress Open.


We would love to hear from you if you're ready to make a massive impact on our journey and grow hand in hand with us every step of the way.

 **Skills**  

  

**About Cimpress**  

Founded in 1995, Cimpress empowers millions of customers around the world to make an impression through personalized, high\-quality printed and custom products. A global leader in mass customization, Cimpress builds technology and supply chain capabilities that enable customized print, signage, packaging, and apparel products at scale through its family of customer\-focused businesses. Cimpress India is a strategic talent hub that enables Cimpress businesses to build and scale teams in India. The organization operates a centralized talent container model that removes operational complexity and provides end\-to\-end support across hiring, HR, finance, compliance, and administration. With 2,500\+ team members across Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, and Mumbai, Cimpress India delivers technology, graphics services, shared capabilities, analytics, and business operations that advance Cimpress’ long\-term strategy. Join us on a journey to help millions of businesses build brands, stand out, and grow.
company_description: We empower millions of people to make an impression through personally-meaningful, customized products.

title: Head of ER Advisory - GCN India
description:
**Some careers have more impact than others.**

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role **Head of Employee Relations Advisory – Global Capability Network India**

 **Location\- Hyderabad and Bengaluru**

 **Overview of the team**

* HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
* Employee Relations Advisory (ERA) team is accountable to deliver the Employee Relations strategy around Policies \& Procedures, Conduct and Concerns Management, Business Change and Transformation, People Risk and Governance, Employment Law and Litigation \& Industrial Relations by applying appropriate judgement in making decisions taken are compliant with local legislations and Group's guidelines that apply.
* This role will be part of the Employee Relations Advisory Team of Infrastructure that manages Employee Relations Advisory related aspects for Global Capability Networks across 8 countries supporting Global Capability Network in India comprising of c.30k employees and reports in Head of Employee Relations Advisory – Infrastructure.

 **In this role, you will:**

* Lead Employee Relations Advisory for Global Capability Network India, aligning the agenda with business strategy, workforce priorities, organisational culture, risk appetite and the broader People strategy. Provide strategic counsel and constructive challenge to HR and business leadership on complex employee, workforce and organisational matters, balancing employee experience, business needs, legal and regulatory considerations.
* Own the ER (Employee Relations) risk agenda by proactively identifying litigation, conduct and workforce risks; establish appropriate mitigation strategies and ensure risks remain within the organisation’s risk appetite.
* Lead the development, governance and continuous improvement of ER policies, frameworks and practices, ensuring alignment with Indian employment legislation, regulatory requirements, Group frameworks and evolving business needs.
* Own the governance and resolution of complex and high\-risk ER matters, including disciplinary cases, grievances, whistleblowing, investigations and performance matters, ensuring consistency, fairness, procedural robustness and appropriate risk management.
* Lead the India approach to employment litigation and disputes, partnering with Internal Legal and external counsel on litigation strategy with clear accountability for outcomes. Provide strategic advice on workforce transformation and business change, outsourcing, operating\-model changes and other complex workforce interventions.
* Provide guidance on Industrial Relations and employee representation matters, including the management of emerging industrial relations risks where applicable. Anticipate and interpret changes in Indian employment legislation, regulatory expectations and market practice, translating these into implications, recommendations and proactive changes to strategy, policies and business practices.
* Establish robust governance and oversight, providing senior leadership with meaningful trends, risk indicators, case insights and recommendations to support informed workforce decisions. Ensure appropriate quality assurance, consolidation and reporting of India ER activity, including material cases, risk themes, litigation, workforce change and service delivery metrics.
* Drive an insight\-led ER agenda using case data, ER metrics, employee trends and thematic analysis to identify systemic issues, emerging risks and opportunities for preventative interventions. Oversee, track and monitor Employee Relations Advisory service delivery metrics and provide trends and insights to Entity, Regional and Global Governance Forums.
* Own the effectiveness of the India ER operating model, ensuring appropriate prioritisation, capacity, service standards, escalation mechanisms, quality assurance and consistent delivery of ER advisory services. Lead continuous improvement and simplification of ER processes, leveraging technology, data and innovative approaches to improve manager and employee experience, strengthen controls and increase the effectiveness of ER delivery.
* Build and lead a high\-performing Employee Relations team, developing capability in strategic advisory, employment law, investigations, workforce transformation, industrial relations, risk management and stakeholder influence. Coach and enable the ER Advisory Team, HRBPs and people managers to strengthen ER capability, improve manager effectiveness and promote consistent, fair and accountable practices. Build strong strategic partnerships with HRBPs (Human Resource Business partners), business leaders, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Reward and other specialist functions; represent Employee Relations in governance and leadership forums; embed ER considerations into organisational and workforce strategy; and role\-model the organisation’s leadership behaviours and values to support high performance, responsible leadership, employee trust and sustainable business outcomes.

 **To be successful you will:**

* Post Graduation in Human Resources, Employee Relations, Law or related disciple, with 15\+ years of experience in progressive experience, including significant experience i.e., 10 years leading Employee Relations in a complex, large scale organization.
* Proven track record of leading an Employee Relations Advisory function, shaping ER strategy, policies, frameworks, and practices that enable business outcomes while maintaining appropriate employee, regulatory and reputational risk controls.
* Deep expertise in Indian employment, labor and industrial relations legislations, with the ability to translate evolving regulatory requirements into practical, commercially sound ER strategies, policies and interventions.
* Strong experience managing complex and high\-risk ER issues, including investigations, disciplinary actions, grievances, employee disputes, litigations, regulatory proceedings, industrial relations. Demonstrated expertise in advising on organizational transformation and workforce changes and other complex workforce interventions.
* Strong risk and governance mindset, with the ability to identify emerging people, legal, regulatory, employee relations risks to establish appropriate controls and provide clear recommendations for active risk mitigation.
* Exceptional influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to consult, challenge and influence stakeholders (across levels) across HR, Business Legal, Compliance, Risk and other control functions to achieve balanced and sustainable outcomes.
* Strong commercial and business acumen with ability to understand business strategy, operating models and workforce priorities and translating them into pragmatic ER solutions.
* Good communication, judgement and interpersonal skills, with the ability to handle highly sensitive and confidential matters with integrity, empathy and sound judgment.
* Strong leadership capability, including developing ER/ Advisory talent, building organizational capability, creating a high\-performance culture and establishing consistent ER standards across a complex organization.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and navigate complex, competing priorities, making sound and timely decisions with limited precedent while maintaining appropriate risk discipline.

 **You’ll achieve more at HSBC**

**Hsbc.Com/Careers**


HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: NAM Preboarding Specialist
description:
In this role, you will be responsible for processing the transactional components of the offer letter for our GE Vernova pre\-hires. You will follow a clear set of tasks to complete requests which will help to ensure a seamless transition for pre\-hires joining our business. Your attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and ability to collaborate with various teams will be critical for success in this role. This person will ensure a positive experience for pre\-hires while ensuring they are fully prepared to contribute effectively to the organization.
**Job Description**
===================


**Essential Responsibilities**

  

* Collaborate with the HR team, hiring managers, and Talent Acquisition team to gather necessary information for creating accurate and comprehensive offer letters.
* Ensure services are delivered in a timely manner with guidance from NAM Offer \& EA Team leader, while ensuring high standards of accuracy and quality are maintained, based on compliance with relevant legal and GE policy requirements.
* Follow GEV standards to generate offer letters, ensuring that all necessary details are included, such as compensation, position details, and other terms and conditions.
* Communicate with candidates regarding offer details, answering questions, and addressing concerns they may have about the offer letter.
* Upon acceptance of an offer by a candidate, ensuring that all pre\-hire tasks are provided to candidate in a timely manner to ensure that we meet agreed upon start date
* Partnering with vendors (i.e. Background check and Drug testing vendor, etc) to ensure pre\-hire tasks assigned to new hire are effectively assigned in a timely manner
* Monitor the progress of the tasks from offer letter submitted to employee start date
* Identify areas for improvement and propose solutions to enhance the candidate experience and overall offer/pre\-onboarding process.
* Ability to recognize when to escalate issues that would impact the experience for a new hire
* Coordinate video calls with new hires to review employee\-provided documents and verify identity and employment authorization
* Ensure timely completion of Section 1, and acceptable documentation is uploaded to WD employee record. Follow up with pre\-hire as necessary.
* Maintain organized and secure records of I\-9 forms and supporting documentation
* Coordinate with NAM Onboarding Leader to resolve any discrepancies or compliance issues
* Identify and communicate potential delays or issues proactively
* Demonstrated strong follow\-through by consistently meeting our established SLAs
* Proactively seeks clarification on ambiguous requests to mitigate risk and ensure high\-quality deliverables
* Working hours will follow the U.S. Eastern Time Zone to support the North America offer and preboarding process.
  

**Qualifications/Requirements**

  

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college in related area (or a high school graduate/GED or equivalent with at least 3 years of relevant work experience)
* Must be able to work during U.S. Eastern Time Zone business hours to support the North America offer and preboarding process
  

**Desired Characteristics**

  

* Strong customer service focus, with the ability to anticipate customer needs with a high level of responsiveness
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Prior experience in HR, or a similar role is preferred.
* Familiarity with Workday and document management tools.
* Applies solid judgment ensuring integrity, compliance, \& confidentiality
* Passion for continuous process improvement and simplification
* Ability to anticipate and resolve challenges
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes
company_description: GE Vernova is a purpose-built company, focused on our mission to electrify and decarbonize the world.

description:
**1\. Candidate:**
------------------


* **Skills:** Problem Solving, Good Communication, Critical and creative Thinking.
* **Personality:** Dynamism, Synergetic, Responsibility, Sense of Humour, Resourcefulness.
* **Attitude:** Go\-getter, proactive, diligent and meticulous, hardworking, ready to go the extra mile.
**2\. Selection Procedure:We are very selective recruiters and hence our selection process is rigorous and has stringent quality standards.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


* **Step 1:** Apply through our career portal for either open opportunity or send us your resume
* **Step 2:** Resume shortlisting and preliminary screening
* **Step 3:** Written Test
* **Step 4:** Technical Interview with panel.
* **Step 5:** HR Round.
* **Step 6:** Medical Test, Document Verification, Final Offer.
* **Step 7:** Onboarding.

  
Deputy Manager \-SCM
**Experience:** 10 to 12 year in SCM Manage end\-to\-end SCM operations including SAP/ERP updates and inter\-departmental material movement with full ownership  

* Coordinate with Planning, Production \& S\&OP teams to ensure production adherence, timely dispatches, and accurate EDD commitments
* Drive alignment with finishing and packing teams and oversee month\-end dispatch reporting in coordination with Sales
* Handle import\-export documentation and ensure compliance with logistics and statutory requirements
* Ensure effective cross\-functional coordination to maintain smooth supply chain flow and operational efficiency
**Skills Required:** Import \& Export Documentation, SAP, MS Office, Google Workspace, Good communication skills (English, Hindi, Kannada)

title: HR Manager - Office Operations [T500-28873]
description:
**About Suffolk:** 




 Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. Suffolk is an end\-to\-end business that provides value throughout the entire project lifecycle by leveraging its core construction management services with vertical service lines that include real estate capital investment, design, self\-perform construction services, material procurement services, technology start\-up investment (Suffolk Technologies), and innovative research/development.
 



 Suffolk is a national company with more than $8\.0 billion in annual revenue, 3,100 employees, and main offices in Boston (headquarters), New York City, Miami, West Palm Beach, Tampa, Estero, Dallas, Las Vegas, Los Angeles, San Francisco, San Diego, and the US Virgin Islands. Suffolk manages many of the most complex, sophisticated projects in the United States, serving clients in every major industry sector, including healthcare, life sciences, education, gaming, transportation/aviation, government, mission critical and commercial. Suffolk is privately held and is led by Founder, Chairman and CEO John Fish. Suffolk is ranked \#10 on ENR’s list of “Top CM\-at\-Risk Contractors.”
 



  





**About Suffolk Global:** 




 Suffolk Global is a strategic extension of Suffolk Construction, established to unlock the full potential of a globally integrated delivery model. Based in Bangalore, India, Suffolk Global brings together world\-class talent, advanced technology, and innovative processes to enhance how Suffolk designs, plans, and builds.
 



 As a critical part of Suffolk’s long\-term growth strategy, Suffolk Global enables greater speed, scalability, and technical rigor across the business. At the intersection of process standardization, AI\-enabled innovation, and global talent, Suffolk Global is redefining how work is executed, embedding consistent workflows, leveraging technology to drive efficiency, and building high\-performing teams aligned to Suffolk’s evolving needs.
 



 By embedding deeply with U.S.\-based teams, the platform supports high\-impact work across design, digital delivery, and corporate functions. Powered by India’s exceptional talent pool, Suffolk Global is building a next\-generation capability that combines deep technical expertise with a relentless focus on quality, efficiency, and continuous innovation, helping redefine what’s possible in the built environment.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 Suffolk Global is seeking a Human Resources Business Partner to help establish and scale people operations across multiple functions and business units in Bengaluru, India. As the primary HR partner for the India office, this individual will support the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to employee experience, HR operations, and ongoing people programs.
 



 In the near term, the HR Business Partner will work closely with Suffolk's U.S. HR organization and external partners to implement HR policies, talent acquisition activities, employee programs, and operational processes. As Suffolk Global grows, this role will help shape the long\-term HR strategy, identifying opportunities to build internal capabilities and transition key HR functions in\-house.
 



 Success in this role requires a collaborative, hands\-on leader who is comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment and partnering across global teams. This position offers a unique opportunity to build the HR foundation for a rapidly expanding organization while growing into a broader HR leadership role as Suffolk Global scales.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**HR Operations \& Employee Experience:** 



* Serve as the primary HR Business Partner for the Suffolk Global India office.
* Manage the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, orientation, employee records, benefits administration, and leave management.
* Serve as a trusted resource for employees, responding to HR inquiries and supporting a positive employee experience.
* Support performance management, employee development, talent review, and engagement initiatives.
* Maintain accurate HR data and documentation across HR systems.



  





**HR Strategy \& Business Partnership:** 



* Partner closely with U.S.\-based HR Business Partners, business leaders, and external partners to execute HR programs and organizational initiatives.
* Support implementation of HR policies, processes, and best practices across the India organization.
* Identify opportunities to standardize, improve, and gradually transition HR capabilities in\-house as Suffolk Global scales.
* Support organizational growth, workforce planning, and other strategic people initiatives.



  





**Compliance \& Governance:** 



* Help ensure compliance with Indian labor laws, employment regulations, and company policies.
* Coordinate with legal, finance, payroll, and external partners on HR compliance and employee administration.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure proper handling of sensitive employee information.



  





**Office Operations \& Workplace Experience:** 



* Oversee day\-to\-day office operations to ensure a safe, productive, and engaging workplace.
* Coordinate with facilities, IT, security, and third\-party vendors to support office operations.
* Manage workspace readiness, office access, visitor coordination, and administrative services.
* Plan and coordinate employee events, town halls, executive visits, and team activities that foster a strong office culture.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 6 to 10 years of progressive Human Resources experience.
* Experience supporting employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, employee relations, HR operations, and talent acquisition.
* Working knowledge of Indian employment laws and HR best practices.
* Experience partnering with business leaders and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* High level of professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and HRIS platforms.
* Experience supporting a Global Capability Center (GCC), multinational organization, or high\-growth company.
* Experience working with outsourced HR service providers or HR consulting partners.
* Familiarity with HR systems such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or similar platforms.
* Experience helping build or scale HR operations in a growing organization.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive process improvements across global teams.

title: HR Manager – US Operations
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced HR Manager to manage US HR operations from our Hyderabad office. The role covers core HR, US payroll through Rippling, employee benefits administration, finance coordination, and partial support for talent acquisition.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be comfortable independently managing day\-to\-day operations, maintaining accurate employee and payroll records, and coordinating with US employees, leadership, finance teams, and external service providers.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Core HR Operations
   

  

* Manage the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes, documentation, and offboarding.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR policies, and standard operating procedures.
* Handle employee queries related to payroll, benefits, leave, and company policies.
* Coordinate applicable US employment compliance requirements with internal stakeholders and external advisors.
* Prepare HR reports and maintain confidential employee information.


 US Payroll and Rippling
   

  

* Independently manage US payroll processing through Rippling, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
* Validate payroll inputs, including salary changes, variable pay, deductions, leave adjustments, and final settlements.
* Manage employee information, payroll workflows, and reporting within Rippling.
* Resolve payroll discrepancies and coordinate with Rippling support and finance teams.
* Maintain payroll records and support reconciliations, audits, and year\-end activities.


 Benefits Administration
   

  

* Administer US employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans, and other company offerings.
* Coordinate benefit enrollments, qualifying life event changes, and employee exits.
* Support open enrollment and communicate benefit information clearly to employees.
* Work with benefits brokers and providers to resolve employee queries and reconcile benefit invoices.


 Finance Coordination
   

  

* Partner with finance on payroll funding, payroll reconciliation, benefits costs, and employee reimbursements.
* Review HR\-related invoices and coordinate approvals and payment tracking.
* Maintain supporting documentation for payroll expenses, reporting, and audits.
* Support headcount and employee cost reporting.


 Talent Acquisition Support
   

  

* Support recruitment for selected roles through sourcing, screening, and interview coordination.
* Work with hiring managers to understand requirements and track hiring progress.
* Coordinate offers, background verification, and onboarding handoffs.
* Maintain candidate records and provide a positive candidate experience.


**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Prior experience independently managing US HR operations is mandatory.
* Hands\-on experience processing US payroll using Rippling is mandatory.
* Strong working knowledge of US payroll processes, employee benefits, and HR administration.
* Experience coordinating payroll and benefits reconciliations with finance teams.
* Familiarity with US federal and state employment requirements and the ability to coordinate specialist guidance when needed.
* Experience supporting recruitment and managing hiring coordination.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, attention to detail, and data accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage confidential information and work independently with US stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
* Willingness to work from the Hyderabad office during the 2:00 PM–10:00 PM IST shift.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting employees across multiple US states.
* Experience managing benefits renewals, open enrollment, and payroll audits.
* Relevant HR or payroll certifications.

**We're Hiring for Intralink – A Global Business Development Consultancy** 




  





 We are excited to be recruiting on behalf of Intralink, an international business development and innovation consultancy that specializes in helping companies expand into global markets. With over 36 years of experience and a presence in more than 28 locations across Asia, Europe, and North America, Intralink partners with startups, scaleups, multinationals, and government agencies to drive international growth, innovation, and sustainability.
 



  





 Intralink has been recognized with prestigious awards, including the UK's King's Award for Enterprise and the US President's E Award, for its exceptional work in facilitating international business expansion.
 



  





**Finance \& HR Manager, Intralink India** 




**Background** 




 Are you someone who enjoys bringing structure, clarity and financial discipline to a fast\-moving, international work environment?
 



  





 Do you thrive at the intersection of finance and people operations?
 



  





 And, do you want to play a pivotal role in supporting a globally connected consulting firm as it grows its footprint in India?
 



  





 If that’s yes, yes and yes, you may be who we are looking for to join our team.
 



  





 Intralink is a global business development consultancy specialising in international markets. With over 25 offices worldwide and more than 200 multilingual professionals, we support companies across technology, industrial, consumer and sustainability\-driven sectors to expand internationally.
 



  





 As we continue to grow our India presence, we are looking for a Finance \& HR Manager to take ownership of the India office’s financial operations, HR administration and broader office management. You’ll report directly to the India Managing Director and work closely with our UK headquarters, playing a trusted role in ensuring smooth, compliant and efficient operations on the ground.
 



  





**What you’ll be doing** 




 You’ll be responsible for managing the financial health and HR operations of Intralink’s India office.
 



 Acting as a key point of contact between local operations and UK headquarters, you’ll ensure robust financial controls, accurate reporting, and seamless coordination with external partners.
 



  





**Accounting \& Finance** 




 In your day\-to\-day, you’ll manage daily bank operations, oversee staff expense claims and reimbursements, and monitor expenditure against approved budgets. You’ll prepare and report monthly management accounts to headquarters, support annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting, and provide sound financial advice to the India Managing Director.
 



  





 You’ll coordinate closely with vendors, external accountants and auditors on GST, manage corporate income tax filings and statutory audits, assist in implementing standard accounting policies, and ensure all financial records are properly maintained. You’ll also manage locally issued client invoices, credit control processes, and staff severance and pension arrangements where applicable.
 



  





**HR \& Payroll Support** 




 You’ll support core HR operations including payroll processing, withholding tax filings and year\-end tax settlements. This will include assisting with staff onboarding and offboarding, benefits enrolment, annual health insurance renewals and responding to employee queries related to salaries and administrative matters.
 



  





 You’ll maintain accurate personnel and leave records, support recruitment\-related logistics such as interviews or job fairs when required, provide documentation for staff visas, and organise mandatory annual training or health check\-ups. Ensuring HR compliance and supporting ad\-hoc people\-related initiatives will also form part of your role.
 



  





 You’ll also stay aware of changes to Indian labour laws to ensure ongoing compliance and help organise board meetings on a quarterly basis.
 



  





**What you’ll be getting** 




 ● Competitive and negotiable salary, depending on experience
 



 ● 20 days of paid annual leave per year
 



 ● Health insurance coverage
 



 ● A multinational working environment with close collaboration across global offices
 



 ● Exposure to international business operations and senior stakeholders
 



 ● A trusted, high\-impact role supporting leadership and business growth in India
 



  





**What you’ll need** 




 • 5\+ years of relevant work experience in accounting or finance, strongly preferred
 



 • Hands\-on experience with accounting systems (NetSuite experience highly desirable)
 



 • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls and administrative procedures
 



 • Solid understanding of office management systems and HR administration
 



 • Excellent organisational, planning and multitasking skills, with strong attention to detail
 



 • Ability to prioritise effectively and work independently in a fast\-paced environment
 



 • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
 



 • Advanced spoken and written English skills
 



 • Native or fluent Hindi
 



  





 This position is based in India and will require regular interaction with Intralink’s UK headquarters and local stakeholders.
 



 Please submit a CV and Cover Letter detailing your experience and motivations for applying to this role.

title: Content Research & Audience Insights Executive
description:
**Content Intelligence \| Audience Research \| Market Research \| Content Risk Assessment**

**Company:** Meclusions Studio

**Location:** Andheri East, Mumbai

**Experience:** Fresher to 3 Years

**Candidates:** Mumbai / Mumbai Metropolitan Region ONLY

**ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY**

Meclusions Studio is developing a new digital streaming and original\-content platform focused on **Sanatana, Hinduism, Bharat's culture, traditions, history, spirituality and lesser\-explored Indian stories.**

Hindustan ki Desi Kahaniyaan — High Production Quality ke tadke ke saath.

We are looking for a Content Research \& Audience Insights Executive who can help our creative and management team make better\-informed decisions before investing time and money into a content idea.

This is an important role.

Before we spend any amount of money on a show, documentary, animation series or other production, we want someone to ask:

\- Who will watch this?

\- Why will they watch it?

\- Is there genuine audience interest?

\- Who are the competing videos/shows?

\- Is the subject already saturated?

\- Is there a better angle?

\- Can this become a series?

\- Can it attract subscribers or advertisers?

\- What are the risks?

\- And what evidence supports the decision?

You will help the team separate **interesting ideas from commercially and strategically viable content opportunities.**

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**YOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITY**

Your primary responsibility will be to **research, analyse and report before production decisions are made.**

You will NOT be expected to guarantee that a show will become profitable.

Instead, you will provide the best available evidence, audience signals, competition analysis and risk assessment so that the Creative Head / Management can make an informed decision.

**BEFORE WE INVEST IN A PROJECT, YOU MAY BE ASKED TO STUDY:**

\- Audience demand

\- Search interest

\- YouTube viewing patterns

\- Existing OTT / digital content

\- Competitor channels

\- Successful and unsuccessful formats

\- Audience comments and reactions

\- Social\-media discussions

\- Content saturation

\- Potential audience size

\- Regional interest

\- Age\-group relevance

\- Language opportunities

\- Episode / series potential

\- Monetisation possibilities

\- Sponsorship possibilities

\- Production complexity

\- Potential controversy or factual\-risk areas

\- Availability of credible research material

\- Whether the subject can sustain multiple episodes

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**CONTENT OPPORTUNITY RESEARCH**

You will help discover potential subjects for:

\- Sanatana / Hinduism documentaries

\- Temple and pilgrimage programming

\- Historical stories

\- Indian civilisation and heritage

\- Spirituality and philosophy

\- Hindu festivals and traditions

\- Lesser\-known personalities

\- Saints, scholars and thinkers

\- Ancient Indian knowledge systems

\- Regional traditions

\- Interviews

\- Yatra / travel formats

\- Animated stories

\- Children's and youth\-oriented content

\- AI\-assisted episodes

\- Explainer series

\- Short\-form digital content

\- Original factual entertainment

You may also be asked:

“Find 20 subjects we could potentially develop into shows.” Your job will be to research those subjects and identify which ones deserve deeper development.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**AUDIENCE INSIGHTS**

You will study what audiences are actually interested in—not simply what we personally believe they will like.

Research may include:

\- YouTube search and viewing behaviour

\- Google Trends

\- Social\-media conversations

\- Comments and audience questions

\- Existing successful channels

\- OTT programming

\- Competitor content

\- Audience demographics where reliable data is available

\- Regional and language demand

\- Frequently requested topics

\- Recurring audience problems/questions

\- Emerging content trends

For example:

If we are considering:

**“A 10\-episode series about a particular Hindu tradition”**

you may be asked to determine:

\- Is there existing audience interest?

\- How much content already exists?

\- Which videos performed well?

\- What did audiences respond to?

\- What is missing?

\- What could make our version different?

\- Should it be documentary, interview, animation, travel, explainer or another format?

\- Could the idea support 10 episodes?

\- Is there enough evidence to justify developing a pilot?

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**CONTENT RISK ASSESSMENT**

One of the most important parts of this position is identifying risk before money is spent.

You should be comfortable telling the Creative Head:

**“This is an interesting subject, but our research does not currently provide enough evidence to justify a large production.”**

You may identify risks such as:

\- Very small apparent audience

\- Extremely saturated subject

\- Strong existing competition

\- Weak search/viewing signals

\- Limited episode potential

\- Expensive production requirements

\- Difficulty obtaining credible information

\- Factual uncertainty

\- Dependence on one personality/location

\- Potential copyright/IP issues

\- Potential historical or cultural inaccuracies

\- Difficulty finding reliable experts

\- Weak monetisation opportunities

\- Audience interest limited to a very small region

\- Subject appearing attractive internally but showing weak external demand

**Your job is not to reject ideas automatically.**

Your job is to identify the **evidence, opportunities and risks** before we commit significant resources.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**FINDING PROFITABLE CONTENT OPPORTUNITIES**

You will also actively search for opportunities.

For promising subjects, research:

**Audience**

Who could watch it?

**Competition**

Who is already producing similar content?

**Differentiation**

What can we do differently?

**Format**

Documentary? Yatra? Interview? Animation? Explainer? Series? Short\-form?

**Scale**

Can we produce it economically?

**Monetisation**

Could the content potentially support:

\- OTT subscriptions

\- Advertising

\- Sponsorship

\- Brand partnerships

\- YouTube distribution

\- Licensing

\- Events

\- Educational use

\- Other commercial opportunities

You must clearly distinguish between **evidence of audience interest** and **your own hypothesis about monetisation.**

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**COMPETITOR \& CONTENT ANALYSIS**

You will regularly study:

\- YouTube channels

\- OTT platforms

\- Digital publishers

\- Religious/cultural channels

\- Documentary channels

\- Animation channels

\- Podcast/interview channels

\- Instagram/Facebook content

\- Emerging creators

You may prepare simple reports such as:

**Subject**: Temple Yatra Series

**Existing competition**: 15 significant channels identified

**Audience signals**: Strong / Moderate / Weak — with evidence

**Content gap**: \_\_\_

**Possible differentiation**: \_\_\_

**Estimated production difficulty**: Low / Medium / High

**Potential formats**: \_\_\_

**Key risks**: \_\_\_

**Recommendation to management**: Proceed to pilot research / investigate further / hold for now

The final production decision will remain with management.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**RESEARCH REPORTING**

You should be able to turn research into **short, understandable decision documents.**

We do not need complicated corporate presentations for everything.

Sometimes one useful page containing:

**Opportunity → Evidence → Competition → Audience → Risk → Cost Considerations → Suggested Next Step**

may be more valuable than a 30\-page report.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**AI WILL BE AN IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE**

We are interested in candidates who understand how **AI can make research faster and more economical.**

You may use AI for:

\- Initial research organisation

\- Summarising large amounts of information

\- Comparing content topics

\- Extracting recurring audience questions

\- Categorising comments

\- Generating research questions

\- Building content databases

\- Creating research briefs

\- Analysing large datasets

\- Preparing first drafts of reports

\- Finding patterns across multiple sources

However:

AI\-generated information must NOT automatically be treated as fact.

You will be expected to verify important claims using appropriate sources.

For historical, religious, cultural and factual programming, accuracy is extremely important.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**WHO CAN APPLY?**

We welcome:

\- Freshers

\- 1–3 years experienced candidates

\- Research graduates

\- Mass Media / Journalism / Communications graduates

\- Marketing / Digital Marketing candidates

\- Business / Market Research candidates

\- Content researchers

\- YouTube / digital\-content analysts

\- Candidates with strong independent research experience

Candidates with knowledge or interest in **Sanatana, Hindu culture, Indian history, temples, traditions and Indic subjects** will have an advantage.

However, deep religious knowledge is **not mandatory** if you are an excellent researcher who is willing to learn.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**WHAT WE LOOK FOR**

\- Strong curiosity

\- Excellent internet research ability

\- Analytical thinking

\- Ability to distinguish evidence from assumption

\- Good written English

\- Good Hindi is highly useful

\- Ability to organise information

\- Ability to compare competing content

Most importantly:

WE WANT SOMEONE WHO CAN SAY:

“Before we spend money on this idea, let's first find out what the evidence says.”

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**A BIG ADVANTAGE**

If you have personally:

\- Studied YouTube analytics

\- Researched content ideas

\- Used Google Trends

\- Used AI research tools

please mention this in your application.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**WHAT YOU WILL LEARN**

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**MUMBAI ONLY**

title: Founder's Team — Take Rate Specialist
description:
**Company Overview** 




 ITILITE is a leading global brand in Business Travel, Expense \& Card Management. We operate a B2B SaaS platform serving customers across the US and India, helping companies simplify travel and expense while making it an enjoyable experience for employees.
 



 We are Series C funded, having raised \~$50M from global Tier 1 investors including Tiger Global, Z47, Greenoaks, and Dharana Capital.
 



  





**Function:** 
 Revenue, Supplier Relations \& Commercial Strategy
 



**Level:** 
 Junior–Mid (1–2 years experience) \|
 



**Reports To:** 
 Founder / CXO
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a sharp, data\-driven and commercially minded professional to join our Founder's Team as a Take Rate Specialist. This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role at the intersection of revenue analytics, supplier commissions, supplier relations and commercial strategy. You will work directly with the founding team to identify revenue leakage, optimize supplier commissions, strengthen supplier relationships and unlock new commercial opportunities across our supplier and partner ecosystem.
 



 This is not a back\-office role. You will be expected to get hands\-on with data, engage directly with suppliers, support and drive negotiations, solve commercial and operational issues, and make things happen.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Revenue \& Supplier Commission Analysis** 



* Deep\-dive into historical spend patterns, financial reports, transaction data and supplier performance to identify where supplier commission revenue is being missed.
* Build and maintain dashboards and models that surface supplier commission trends, anomalies and optimization opportunities.
* Identify gaps in deal\-code application and commercial\-rule implementation; flag instances where the correct codes or terms are not being applied and work cross\-functionally to fix them.
* Analyze inventory utilization, supplier mix and underperforming categories or routes to identify
* opportunities for revenue and margin improvement.
* Benchmark supplier commissions against industry norms, competitive data and internal performance to identify opportunities to improve commercial outcomes.



  





**Supplier Relations \& Commercial Management** 



* Build and maintain strong working relationships with key suppliers and partners, acting as a commercial and analytical point of contact.
* Track supplier performance, commercial commitments, commission structures, rebates and other
* agreed terms to ensure delivery against expectations.
* Proactively identify supplier issues, revenue leakage, service gaps and commercial opportunities, and drive them to resolution.
* Maintain supplier performance scorecards and use data to identify suppliers that are performing well, require intervention or should be renegotiated or replaced.
* Work closely with internal teams and suppliers to improve content, inventory availability, pricing,
* commercial terms and overall supplier performance.



  





**Supplier Strategy and Negotiation** 



* Research and map potential new supplier and partner relationships that can deliver better commission structures, stronger economics or improved content and inventory.
* Prepare supplier proposals, comparison matrices, business cases and negotiation briefs to support commercial discussions.
* Lead or co\-lead supplier calls and negotiations, working to improve commission rates, rebate structures and other commercial terms.
* Support the founding team in evaluating supplier opportunities and making data\-backed commercial decisions.



  





**Insight \& Reporting** 



* Translate complex data findings into clear, concise recommendations for the founding team and relevant business stakeholders.
* Proactively flag revenue risks, supplier risks and commercial opportunities — do not wait to be asked.
* Prepare regular supplier commission and supplier performance reports, highlighting trends, issues, opportunities and actionable next steps.
* Develop concise executive\-level updates that make commercial performance easy to understand and act upon.



  





**Who You Are** 




  





**Must\-Have** 



* MBA and/or Engineering degree from a top\-tier college or university.
* 1–2 years of work experience in consulting, investment banking, fintech, e\-commerce, travel, revenue operations, commercial strategy or a high\-growth startup.
* Strong analytical mindset — you enjoy digging into numbers, spotting patterns and connecting dots others miss.
* Proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets; exposure to SQL or BI tools such as Tableau, Metabase or Looker is a strong plus.
* Excellent communication skills, including written, verbal and data storytelling.
* Comfortable interacting with suppliers and internal stakeholders and owning end\-to\-end tasks with minimal hand\-holding.
* High ownership mentality, bias for action and willingness to work hands\-on in a fast\-moving
* environment.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Prior exposure to revenue operations, supplier commission management, commercial finance or
* marketplace economics.
* Experience with supplier, vendor or partnership management.
* Familiarity with commission structures, rebates, commercial contracts or marketplace economics.
* Experience working with transaction\-level data or building commercial dashboards.
* Ability to juggle multiple workstreams without dropping the ball.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Supplier commission leakage is identified quickly and reduced through data, process improvements and supplier action.
* Supplier relationships become more structured, proactive and commercially productive.
* Supplier performance and commercial terms are consistently tracked and improved.
* The founding team has clear, reliable visibility into supplier commission performance and commercial opportunities.
* New supplier opportunities are evaluated rigorously and converted into measurable revenue or margin improvement.



  





**Why Join** 



* Direct access to the founding team — your work will be seen, discussed and acted upon quickly.
* A steep learning curve across revenue, supplier relations, analytics, negotiations and commercial
* strategy.
* An opportunity to work directly with external suppliers while developing strong business and negotiation skills.
* A clear path to grow into a senior revenue, supplier strategy, commercial or business strategy role.
* The opportunity to make a measurable, visible impact on company revenue from day one.



  





**Candidates from top\-tier management institutions with a strong analytical foundation, commercial** 




**curiosity and the hunger to move fast are strongly encouraged to apply.**

title: Senior AI Automation & Systems Engineer
description:
**AI Automation \& Systems Engineer**

Semifront Technologies \| Kolkata (Work from Office) \| Full\-Time

**About Semifront**

Semifront is a deep\-tech VLSI startup building a scalable PCIe Controller IP (Gen1 to Gen5\), focused on high\-performance digital design and protocol\-level implementation.

We are part of the NASSCOM DeepTech Launchpad initiative and were incubated under FABCI (Fabless Chip Design Incubator), IIT Hyderabad, supported by the Ministry of Electronics \& Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India.

We engage in advanced architectural discussions with faculty members from leading IITs in semiconductor design domains. In parallel, we maintain established business and marketing connections across the Bay Area (USA), Europe, and the Middle East to support global outreach and commercialization efforts.

**Why This Role Is Different**

Most AI roles automate generic business tasks. This one puts you at the intersection of AI and silicon design — building AI systems that help engineers verify a PCIe controller IP, one of the most complex protocols in the industry. You will be the person who defines how AI is used across Semifront: in engineering, in HR and marketing, and in the infrastructure everything runs on. You will own it from the first conversation to the tool people rely on every day.

**What You Will Own**

**1\. AI for the VLSI Front\-End Team**

You will work directly with our design and verification engineers to find where time is lost, then design, build, test, and roll out AI\-driven solutions.

* Sit with the front\-end team to understand their design verification debug and regression workflows, and identify what can be automated
* Design the automation flow — using AI agent skills, LLM pipelines, scripts, or whatever medium fits the problem best
* Build AI\-assisted regression flows: running, monitoring, and summarizing regressions, and triaging failures to likely root cause
* Build AI\-assisted debug tools: log and simulation\-output analysis, lint/error summarization, and debug guidance
* Build verification support tools: checklist extraction from the PCIe specification, coverage\-gap analysis, and testbench/collateral assistance
* Test every flow with the team before rollout, with clear quality checks so engineers can trust the output
* Measure impact (time saved, faster debug) and keep improving the tools after deployment

**2\. AI Automation for HR and Marketing**

* Work with HR and Marketing to identify repetitive processes and automate them — e.g., candidate screening support, onboarding workflows, document and report generation, content drafting, campaign and lead tracking
* Set up and connect automation platforms and AI tools with the systems these teams already use
* Debug, maintain, and improve these automations so they keep running reliably

**3\. Systems Administration**

* Handle day\-to\-day IT support for laptops and desktops (Windows/Linux) — setup, upgrades, and troubleshooting
* Maintain Linux servers and user accounts, NFS shares, and Git repositories for the engineering team
* Support the regression compute setup and job scheduling (e.g., Slurm)
* Handle network, internet, and VPN issues, and coordinate with ISPs and service vendors
* Install and test tools for engineering teams, and keep system documentation up to date

**What We Are Looking For**

* Diploma in IT/ Computer Science or Bachelor's (Mandatory), B Tech/ BE in IT/ CSE/ any relevant stream (Preferred)
* 3\+ years of experience(or exceptional fresher can be considered), including hands\-on work building AI/LLM\-based automation (intensive recent project work counts, not just job titles)
* Strong Python; Perl, Shell, or Make scripting is a plus
* Practical experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar), AI agents, and automation platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n, or custom\-built)
* Working Linux administration skills: users, permissions, NFS, basic networking and troubleshooting
* Ability to talk to engineers, HR, and marketing alike, understand their problems, and turn them into working solutions
* A habit of testing thoroughly and measuring whether automation actually saves time

**Nice to Have**

* Basic understanding of Verilog/ System Verilog and verification concepts — we will teach you the VLSI domain
* Experience in a semiconductor, EDA, or VLSI environment
* Familiarity with simulators, lint tools (e.g., Verilator), and regression flows
* Experience building agent skills, MCP tool integrations, or internal developer tools

**Important Context**

We license proprietary silicon IP, so confidentiality is non\-negotiable. You will design AI workflows that follow strict rules about which data can go to which tools.

**What Is In It for You**

* A rare career profile: hands\-on AI experience inside semiconductor IP design — a combination very few engineers have
* Full ownership: you define how AI is used across the company, with direct access to the founder
* Growth path to lead AI \& Automation as the team grows
* Access to leading AI models and tools, with budget to experiment
* Your tools are used every day by every team
* Reports to Founder

**How to Apply**

Please fill the application form at https://semifront.com/apply\-form/ and include a link to something you have built with AI — an agent, an automation, a tool, or a short write\-up. It matters more to us than your resume format.

**Location**

Kolkata (Work from Office)
