We are also globally partnered with the Big 6 Advisory firms and have direct delivery partnerships wit Oracle, IBM, Infor, Adobe and Microsoft.
 



  





 CURRENT FOCUS\-AREAS
 



 DataMTX is currently engaged in the acceleration of multiple AI Software Engineering Transformational projects that is enabling our clients to institutionalize an AI\-first software delivery model in\-sync with modern product stack. Our current engagements focus on practical adoption of Claude Code and complementary AI capabilities across business analysis, architecture, database engineering, full\-stack development, quality engineering, documentation, and DevOps.
 



 Our AI\-centric methodologies is intended to reduce avoidable manual effort and sprint friction, not to remove engineering accountability. AI\-generated requirements, schemas, code, tests, and documentation will remain subject to defined human review, automated validation, security controls, and repository governance.
 



  




 The Role
 
 As a Business Analyst at DataMTX, you'll play a key role in shaping product direction by analyzing, documenting, prototyping, and validating software requirements within an AI\-first delivery model. You will work closely with Product, UX, Engineering, and QA to translate business needs into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, Storybook component specifications, and AI\-ready development artifacts.
 



 You will leverage modern AI tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and other approved AI technologies to accelerate requirements analysis, impact assessments, test design, documentation, and delivery planning while maintaining strong human accountability and governance.
 



 A key aspect of this role is helping establish a
 **Storybook\-driven design\-to\-code workflow** 
 , ensuring UI requirements, states, behaviors, accessibility standards, and component specifications can be efficiently translated into production\-ready React components and supporting engineering assets. This aligns directly with the client's Storybook\-to\-React acceleration strategy.
 



  




 AI\-Enabled Analysis \& Product Definition
 * Utilize approved AI tools to accelerate requirements gathering, impact analysis, user story creation, acceptance criteria generation, and business process documentation while ensuring completeness and accuracy.
* Create AI\-ready requirements packages that provide sufficient context for engineering teams and AI\-assisted development workflows.
* Develop structured prompts, templates, and reusable business analysis artifacts to improve consistency and quality across product delivery.
* Collaborate with technical leadership to define business rules, workflows, edge cases, and non\-functional requirements suitable for AI\-assisted implementation.


 Storybook\-Driven Product Delivery
 * Define UI requirements through Storybook stories, states, variants, interaction flows, accessibility requirements, and component behaviors.
* Work with Product Designers and Developers to establish traceability between requirements, Storybook assets, React components, automated tests, and acceptance criteria.
* Create detailed component specifications covering empty states, loading states, error states, validation scenarios, responsive behavior, and accessibility considerations.
* Assist in establishing a design\-to\-code workflow where approved Storybook artifacts can be leveraged to accelerate front\-end development.


 AI\-First SDLC Participation
 * Partner with Development and QA teams to create traceable links between user stories, acceptance criteria, implementation tasks, automated tests, and deployment outcomes.
* Support AI\-assisted backlog refinement, sprint planning, UAT preparation, test scenario generation, and release readiness activities.
* Contribute to AI governance practices by ensuring generated artifacts maintain business accuracy, traceability, compliance, and auditability.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to AI adoption, delivery acceleration, and quality metrics.


 Technical Collaboration
 * Review Storybook specifications, React components, API contracts, and data models sufficiently to validate alignment with business requirements.
* Collaborate with developers to refine prompts, implementation approaches, and generated outputs during feature delivery.
* Facilitate workshops with stakeholders to validate business outcomes using interactive prototypes, Storybook stories, and AI\-generated mockups where appropriate.


 Required Skills and Experience
 * Experience defining and documenting software requirements within Agile product development teams.
* Strong understanding of modern web application architecture including APIs, frontend frameworks, and cloud\-based SaaS solutions.
* Experience working with component\-based UI frameworks and design systems.
* Experience using Storybook or similar tools to document and validate UI requirements preferred.
* Experience working with React\-based development teams strongly preferred.
* Ability to understand source control concepts, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software delivery practices.
* Since this role has direct 1:1 client interaction in Australia and/or the USA, we expect candidates to have the ability to communicate in near\-flawless English at both the spoken and written levels.






 AI \& Modern Delivery Skills
 * Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar technologies to improve analysis and delivery outcomes.
* Ability to create structured prompts and workflows that generate high\-quality requirements, test scenarios, user stories, acceptance criteria, and documentation.
* Understanding of AI\-assisted software development lifecycles and human review responsibilities.
* Experience working within AI\-enabled engineering organizations strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with AI governance, validation practices, and responsible use of generative AI tools.


 Storybook \& Design\-to\-Code Skills
 * Experience documenting UI functionality through component specifications, state definitions, and user interaction flows.
* Ability to define comprehensive Storybook scenarios including:
* Default states
* Loading states
* Empty states
* Error states
* Validation states
* Responsive behavior
* Accessibility considerations
* Experience supporting design\-system adoption and component\-library governance preferred.
* Understanding of design\-to\-code workflows and how UI specifications are transformed into production\-ready front\-end components.


 Highly Desirable
 * Construction Management, Field Service Management, Claims Management, ERP, or Project Management software experience.
* Experience with Storybook, Figma, React, TypeScript, or component\-based front\-end architectures.
* Experience working in organizations utilizing AI\-assisted SDLC practices.
* Familiarity with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar developer AI platforms.
* Experience creating traceability across requirements, UI components, automated tests, and released functionality.
* Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG) and UX best practices.

title: User Interface Designer
description:
At CaratLane, design is how trust gets built. Someone deciding on a ₹80,000 solitaire on their phone needs the same confidence they'd feel holding it under a store light. Every pixel between them and that decision is either building that confidence or quietly eroding it.
 



 You'll own the visual and interaction layer of that journey \- across our website, our app, and the tools our store teams use every day. And you'll build the design system that lets the whole team move faster without the experience fragmenting.
 



**What you'll own** 




**Design system** 



* Build a scalable, component\-based design system from the ground up, or mature what exists, across web, Android, and iOS
* Define tokens, patterns, and documentation that let designers and engineers ship consistent UI faster
* Grow into governance \-what enters the system, how it's versioned, how adoption spreads across squads
* Partner with frontend and design engineering on the live component library (Storybook or equivalent)
* Understand each platform's paradigms rather than flattening them \- iOS, Android, desktop web, and tablet each have their own grammar



**Craft** 



* Become the leader of UI design for our highest\-traffic surfaces, and hold jewellery and luxury to the standard it deserves
* Generate pixel\-perfect production assets with obsessive attention to detail
* Set the visual and interaction quality bar, and raise the work around you through review
* Micro Motion where it earns its place \- micro\-interactions, transitions, and how the product feels in the hand



**Scale and leverage** 



* Use AI tools to scale design output: component variants, automated documentation, faster engineering handoff, less repetitive production work for the team
* Build AI\-assisted workflows the whole team can use, not just your own shortcuts
* Work with product and engineering to validate designs against real usage data and iterate after launch
* Collab with product designers on how ux journeys can be part of visually enriched flows, including how they build AI into their process
* Represent design in cross\-functional planning, and make the build\-vs\-reuse\-from\-system call



**How you'll work** 




 You'll work closely with almost everyone here \- product, tech, merchandising, retail, and the CXOs. That access is real, and it comes with an expectation: bring the thinking behind the work, document your decisions, and see a feature through from inception to live.
 



 You'll be expected to communicate proactively and persuasively \- verbally and in writing. Keeping stakeholders in the loop as your work progresses isn't a nice\-to\-have here; it's most of what separates designers who succeed at CaratLane from those who don't.
 



 Over time, you'll become one of the gatekeepers for experience quality before anything hits production.
 



**A few honest things about this role** 




 Most of what you design will not be trivial. You'll take a lot of feedback, explore a lot of dead ends, and iterate more than feels comfortable. You'll juggle several projects and help decide what gets dropped. The team is ego\-free and highly collaborative, and it only works if you are too.
 



**What you'll bring** 




**Must\-have** 



* A portfolio that shows meticulous visual craft \- spacing, type, hierarchy, restraint
* 2–3 years in UI design, including hands\-on work building or scaling a design system
* A strong instinct for colour, typography, and composition
* B2C or e\-commerce experience at meaningful scale \- high\-traffic, conversion\-driven surfaces
* Strong command of Figma: component architecture, variants, tokens, auto layout
* Practical use of AI tools (Figma AI, Claude, Midjourney, or similar) to speed up production, ideation, or documentation
* Proven consistency across web and native mobile
* Comfort with data \- funnel metrics, heatmaps, and A/B results as design inputs



**Good to have** 



* Fashion, luxury, lifestyle, or high\-consideration retail experience
* Figma Motion and animation skills are brownie points (After Effects, Rive, Framer, or similar)
* Illustration or bespoke iconography
* Omnichannel exposure, where the same customer moves between store and app
* Any experience mentoring designers, however informal



**Why us** 




 CaratLane serves customers across 400\+ stores and a digital business growing faster than ever. The system you build will touch every one of those journeys. Real traffic, real stakes, leadership visibility, and a category where beautiful work actually shows
 



 .While you're at it, we'll make sure you do some of the best work of your career

title: Content Writer
description:
2Base Technologies is building out its marketing function, and this role is the entry point into the content team.
 



 We are a custom software development company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working as an enterprise solutions partner for clients across the United States, the United Kingdom and other global markets. Our work spans AI implementation, custom software development, legacy system modernisation and operational transformation.
 



 This is a writing role for someone at the start of their career who wants to become genuinely good at explaining technology in plain English. You will produce real published work from your first month, and you will be edited closely while you do it.
 



  





**What This Role Exists to Do** 




 The content team publishes to an audience of technical leaders and business decision\-makers: CTOs and IT Directors who evaluate architecture decisions, and Founders, COOs and Operations leaders who are accountable for technology outcomes without a technical background of their own.
 



 This role produces the first drafts that sit underneath that output. You take a written brief, do the reading, and deliver a draft that is clean, on topic, and written for the reader named in the brief. The brief comes to you. The voice is already defined. Your job is to write well inside both.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* First drafts of blog posts and long\-form articles, written from briefs set by the Content and Thought Leadership Specialist
* Client case studies and project write\-ups, working from delivery team inputs
* Social media copy for the 2Base company channels
* Website page copy and updates
* Research and source gathering behind longer pieces, including reading the technical material well enough to summarise it accurately
* Publishing and scheduling support once a piece has cleared the quality gate



  





**What You Will Not Own** 



* **The 2Base content voice:** 
 it is already defined and documented, and you write within it
* **Content briefs:** 
 the Content and Thought Leadership Specialist writes them, you write to them
* **SEO keyword selection:** 
 the Organic Growth and SEO Specialist sets this
* **Visual design of content assets:** 
 the Visual Designer owns this
* **Distribution and channel decisions:** 
 the Marketing and Growth Lead owns this
* **Final publishing approval:** 
 nothing goes live without passing the content quality gate



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Experience** 



* 0 to 2 years of writing experience. Fresh graduates are welcome and are a core part of the target profile.
* Any discipline. We do not require a journalism, English or communications degree.
* Evidence of writing, in whatever form you have it: an internship, freelance work, a campus publication, a personal blog, a newsletter, or a piece written for a university project.
* If you have no published work at all, the application instructions below tell you what to send instead.



**Writing Ability** 



* Writes clean, correct English. Grammar, punctuation and sentence construction are sound before an editor sees the work.
* Can write to a brief: hits the topic, the named reader and the length asked for, without being chased.
* Can explain something to a reader who does not already understand it, without either talking down to them or hiding behind jargon.
* Reads their own work back and fixes it before submitting.



**Mindset** 



* Genuinely interested in technology. You do not need to know how software is built. You do need to want to find out.
* Takes edits without taking them personally. This role is heavily edited by design for the first 90 days.
* Reliable on deadlines, and says so early when something will be late.
* Uses AI tools as a drafting aid and can say clearly where the tool stopped and their own thinking started.



**What We Are Not Looking For** 



* Writing that has been generated and lightly edited. We check for this, and it is the fastest route to a decline.
* Candidates who are interested in writing in the abstract but have no curiosity about the subject matter.
* Anyone who cannot accept a rewrite.
* Candidates looking for a short engagement to add a line to a CV. This role assumes you are here to learn the craft properly.



  





**An Honest Note on This Role** 




 This is an entry\-level role with real output. It is not a shadowing role and it is not an observation period. You will be given briefs and you will be expected to deliver against them.
 



 It is also closely supervised. The brief structure, the voice standard and the quality gate already exist, so you learn inside a working system rather than inventing one. Expect a great deal of editing in your first three months, and expect the reasoning behind each edit to be explained to you.
 



 If you want to be an accomplished technology writer in two years and you are willing to be edited hard to get there, this is a good place to start. If you want to publish your own work largely unchanged, it is not.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your CV and one writing sample to
 **careers@2basetechnologies.com** 
 with the subject line: Content Writer, followed by your name.
 



 If you have no published sample, send a 200 word piece instead, explaining one benefit of automated software testing to an operations head at a client company who does not write code.

title: Software Development Intern - Full Stack / Backend Focus
description:
This role is with our client, a Bengaluru\-based technology company that helps small and growing businesses turn their ideas into practical, scalable digital solutions. They work across custom software development, web and mobile applications, UI/UX, API integrations, and technology consulting.
   

  

 The company is
 **Software Development Intern** 
 with a strong interest in modern web development who wants to work on real\-world applications and production\-oriented systems.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with a
 **full\-stack / backend focus** 
 , where you will work with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, REST APIs, databases, integrations, debugging, and existing codebases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to understand how different layers of a web application work together.
   

  

* Job Type: Internship
* Work Mode: On\-site
* Location: HRBR Layout, Kalyan Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka
* Duration: 6 months
* Experience: Students / Freshers / Candidates with relevant project experience


**What You Will Work With**
* Frontend: React.js / Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS
* Backend: Node.js, Express.js / NestJS
* APIs: REST APIs, HTTP methods, request/response lifecycle, middleware, authentication and authorization
* Databases: MongoDB and PostgreSQL
* ORM / Data Access: Prisma or similar tools
* Authentication: JWT, cookies, sessions, role\-based access
* Development: Git, GitHub, npm/yarn, environment configuration
* Integrations: Third\-party APIs, file uploads, email services, and external services


**What You Will Do**
* Build and maintain REST APIs using Node.js
* Develop frontend features using React / Next.js
* Connect frontend applications with backend APIs
* Implement authentication, authorization, validation, and error handling
* Work with databases and write efficient queries
* Debug and fix issues across frontend and backend
* Integrate third\-party APIs and services
* Work with existing codebases and understand their architecture
* Participate in code reviews and follow established coding practices
* Write reusable and maintainable components and services
* Test APIs and application functionality
* Work with Git and collaborate with the development team


**What We're Looking For**
* Strong fundamentals in JavaScript
* Working knowledge of Node.js and React.js
* Basic\-to\-good understanding of REST APIs
* Basic understanding of databases, including CRUD operations, relationships, and indexing
* Understanding of Node.js asynchronous programming, promises, async/await, and the event loop
* Understanding of routing, controllers, services, middleware, validation, and error handling
* Basic understanding of authentication and authorization
* Understanding of how frontend applications communicate with backend APIs
* Basic TypeScript knowledge and understanding of why it is used in larger applications
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub, including commits, branches, pull requests, and resolving conflicts
* Ability to read, understand, debug, and modify existing code
* Ability to use logs, browser developer tools, and API testing tools such as Postman
* Strong problem\-solving skills and willingness to learn


**Good to Have**
 Experience with any of the following will be an advantage:
   

  

* Next.js or NestJS
* Prisma
* MongoDB aggregation and indexes
* PostgreSQL
* JWT authentication and role\-based access control
* Redis / caching
* Background jobs or queues
* WebSockets / Socket.IO
* Docker
* Basic cloud or deployment knowledge
* Third\-party API integrations
* File storage and upload systems
* GitHub Actions or basic CI/CD concepts


**The Kind of Developer We're Looking For**
 We are not looking for someone who only knows how to follow tutorials or YouTube projects. You should be able to explain the fundamentals behind what you build.
   

  

 You should have a basic understanding of questions such as:
   

  

* What happens when a request reaches a Node.js server?
* How does Express middleware work?
* How does a React application communicate with an API?
* What happens between a frontend button click and a database update?
* What is the difference between authentication and authorization?
* Why do we use controllers, services, and modules in a backend?
* How does asynchronous code work in Node.js?
* What happens when an API returns an error?
* How would you structure a small backend application?
* How do databases and indexes affect API performance?


 You don't need to know everything.
 **Strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to understand an existing codebase are more important than knowing a long list of technologies.**
 If you enjoy understanding how systems work, building features, debugging problems, and learning through real\-world development, this internship will give you the opportunity to work with a development team and build practical software engineering skills.
   

  

**Note:** 
 This is a paid internship.Skills: databases,authentication,node.js,rest,react,api

 **India** 
 . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in
 **India.**

 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

title: React Native Developer
description:
**Role :\- React Native Developer** 




**Location :\- Bangalore (WFO)** 




  





**About Company :\-** 




 We've built India's first truly agentic AI that negotiates with banks, fixes credit reports, and saves people real money \- all autonomously. Our AI agent Dhruva doesn't just give advice; it stands for our users at each step and gets the job done with lenders, banks and credit bureaus.
 



  





**Must\-Have Skills :\-** 




 ● 3\+ years React Native with production apps shipped to both app stores
 



 ● Strong WebSocket integration experience — connection lifecycle, reconnection strategies, and event\-driven message handling on mobile
 



 ● Local data persistence using SQLite or WatermelonDB, including schema migrations and offline\-first patterns
 



 ● TypeScript proficiency — defining strict types from backend API contracts and maintaining type safety across the data layer
 



 ● Performance optimization on Android — FlatList tuning, memory profiling, and Hermes engine familiarity
 



 ● State management with Redux or equivalent — handling concurrent async state (network, WebSocket, local DB) without race conditions
 



 ● Experience rendering polymorphic UI components — mapping different message types (text, rich cards, suggestions, documents) to distinct components from a single data stream.
 



  





**Key Growth Areas :\-** 




 ● Implement the chat interface for following established architecture patterns and design specs from our UI/UX team.
 



 ● Design the real\-time communication layer — a transport\-agnostic message pipeline that works across WebSocket, HTTP polling, and future push notification channels without UI\-layer changes.
 



 ● Architect the local data layer — offline\-first storage, sync strategies, conflict resolution, and schema migration patterns that scale as Dhruva adds new capabilities.
 



 ● Build extensible rendering infrastructure for AI\-native features — streaming responses, polymorphic message types, inline actionable widgets (payment CTAs, score visualizations), and proactive nudge surfaces.
 



 ● Handle mobile\-specific edge cases — app backgrounding/foregrounding, token refresh, graceful degradation on network loss, and error recovery UX.
 



 ● Write well\-tested, documented code that the team can maintain and extend as Dhruva’s capabilities grow.

**Company Description** 




**About Veoci** 




 Veoci Inc. is a SaaS company that develops and sells solutions for Emergency Management and Business Continuity Planning, with the building blocks required for building applications that require complex process digitization. Using a no\-code front end, our 500\+ customers create applications across a diverse spectrum of industries and application segments. Our four\-week Agile cycle ensures that customers receive new features and new code regularly. Our embedded AI agent (VIA) is a groundbreaking achievement, enhancing a very deep\-tech product.
 



 https://veoci.com/blog/via\-ai\-impact/
 



 https://veoci.com/via\-ai/via\-faq/
 



  





**About iPrime** 




 iPrime is Veoci Inc.'s partner in India, supporting the Veoci platform in QA, mobile development, and more, with a team of over 50 engineers. We have been in the Information Technology business since 1989, starting as partners for Wipro, IBM, EMC, and other leading players, and for over 10 years have supported Veoci with backend development services. The mobile product is a 100% iPrime contribution, as is the QA team.
 



 www.veoci.com
 



 www.iprimeserv.com
 



  





**Position Summary and Role Overview** 




  





 We're looking for a Software Application Quality Assurance Engineer who can own test automation end\-to\-end across web and mobile, work comfortably in an enterprise product environment, and bring modern AI tooling into the testing workflow. You'll maintain scalable automation frameworks, dig into complex system issues, and help ship high\-quality releases faster.
 



  





 You'll report to the Engineering Manager, Quality Engineering, depending on your skill set — Mobile or Web.
 



  





 As part of the QA team, you will actively contribute to identifying bugs across the entire production cycle. Our goal is to reduce bugs in the production environment to zero. The current Agile release cycle is five weeks, and we want to reduce this to one release every four weeks. Our current release is No. 331\. The QA function has the following teams:
 


* **Web** 
 – Manual regression testing, including writing scripts for new features
* **Web Automation** 
 – Using Playwright; a large transition from Selenium is a top priority here, along with maintenance of existing scripts due to possible changes in each release
* **Mobile QA** 
 – iOS and Android, including backward compatibility, with a focus on iOS on iPads. The automation tool here is Appium.
* **Accessibility** 
 – A key component, mandatory for US delivery



  





**What You'll Do** 



* 
* Maintain and extend automated test suites for web (Playwright) and mobile (Appium) applications
* Write clean, maintainable automation code in TypeScript, Java, and Python
* Test enterprise\-grade features including workflow engines, dashboards, and dynamic form creation, ensuring correctness across complex user journeys and configurations
* Investigate failures across the stack — application, API, and data layers — to isolate root causes and drive them to resolution
* Integrate AI\-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude and agent\-based skills/workflows) into test design, test generation, debugging, and documentation
* Contribute to CI/CD pipeline integration and reporting for automated tests



  





**Required Skills** 




*Technical* 



* Strong hands\-on experience with TypeScript and Java
* Proven experience building automation with Appium (mobile) and Playwright (web)
* Solid understanding of test design patterns, framework architecture, and maintainable test code
* Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
* Comfort debugging across the stack: application, API, and data



  





*Nice to Have* 



* Exposure to API testing and accessibility testing (WCAG, TalkBack/VoiceOver)
* Domain experience in the airline or emergency response system space
* Experience integrating AI/LLM\-based tools into engineering or QA workflows



  





**Education** 



* Over 85% in 12th Boards (CBSE)
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science Engineering, with a CGPA above 8\.0


- 


**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* **Education:** 
 B.E. / B.Tech or higher degree in CSE, CE, BCA, or MCA, with a strong academic track record from a renowned Tier\-1 institution
* **Overall Experience:** 
 2–3 years of demonstrated professional engineering experience in QA/Frontend Development
* **Team Collaboration:** 
 Proven experience successfully working with and resolving issues alongside cross\-functional teams — mainly AI, UI/UX, new feature development, and ticket resolution — under a tight deadline, given our strict five\-week Agile build process



  





**Growth** 




 You will be working on a Gartner MQ product with a top\-tier engineering team, developing a no\-code platform for process digitization that incorporates GIS and a full communication suite. Please visit our website for more information.
 



  





**Compensation \& Benefits** 




**Salary:** 
 We are looking for top\-tier talent, and compensation will not be an issue for the right candidate.
 



  





**MUST READ: Selection Process** 




 i. We shortlist candidates based on their resumes and a short form sent based on LinkedIn AI results. This form will not contain any exercises, but you will need to upload a short video of yourself explaining why you believe you are qualified for this job and how it will contribute to your career goals.
 



 ii. Based on the forms and your video, we will call selected candidates for a face\-to\-face technical interview. This will take a minimum of four hours and will be conducted at our Noida office in Sector 63\.
 



 iii. Once you clear the technical interview, a short HR assessment will be set up the same day as the technical interview.
 



 iv. The next step will be an interview with the Front End Lead in the US, or the HOD, followed by a panel interview to finalize the hiring decision.
 



  





 We expect this entire process to be completed within 14 days of your submitting the form mentioned above.
 



  





**MANDATORY :** 




 Please apply only if you want to be challenged.
 



 Please apply
 **only** 
 if you scored 85%\+ in your 12th Boards.
 



 Please apply only if you are technically very sound in the stack mentioned above.
 



 We advise you to apply
 **only** 
 if you meet the criteria above.
 



 Wishing you the best.

title: Information Technology Hardware Technician
description:
**Company Description** 
 At Nallam Digitals, we deliver tailored information technology services that address the specific needs of modern enterprises. Our core expertise includes cybersecurity, system optimization, and cloud integration, helping organizations operate efficiently and securely. We focus on building long\-term partnerships by providing reliable support and robust technical solutions. Applicants joining Nallam Digitals can expect to work with an experienced team that values professionalism, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
 



  





**Job Summary** 





 We are looking for a skilled and responsible IT Hardware Technician to handle computer hardware, networking, operating system, and software\-related technical issues. The candidate should be capable of diagnosing and resolving both routine and critical hardware and software problems efficiently.
 




  





**Role Description** 
 The Information Technology Hardware Technician is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Hyderabad. This role is responsible for installing, configuring, and maintaining desktops, laptops, servers, and peripheral devices such as printers, routers, and switches. The technician will diagnose and resolve hardware issues, replace faulty components, and perform routine preventive maintenance to reduce downtime. Daily tasks include responding to support requests, documenting hardware configurations and repairs, coordinating with vendors for hardware procurement and warranty services, and ensuring that all equipment complies with company security and performance standards. The role may also involve assisting with hardware upgrades for system optimization and supporting project rollouts across the organization.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong knowledge of computer hardware components, peripherals, and basic networking devices (desktops, laptops, printers, routers, switches).
* Experience with hardware installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance in an enterprise or small business environment.
* Familiarity with operating systems (Windows, Linux), basic system setup, and hardware\-related OS configuration tasks.
* Ability to diagnose issues using hardware diagnostic tools and interpret logs or error codes to identify root causes.
* Understanding of safe handling practices for electronic components and adherence to IT security and data protection guidelines.
* Effective communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues in clear, accessible language to non\-technical users.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple on\-site support requests.
* Relevant technical certification (such as CompTIA A\+, hardware\-focused diploma, or equivalent) is preferred.
* Previous experience in an IT support or hardware technician role, particularly within a corporate or service\-provider environment, is an advantage.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 





 \* Diagnose and repair desktop computers, laptops, printers, and other IT hardware.
 





 \* Troubleshoot critical hardware issues, including motherboard, RAM, hard disk/SSD, power supply, display, and peripheral problems.
 





 \* Install, configure, and maintain Windows operating systems and required software.
 





 \* Troubleshoot software errors, application issues, driver problems, and system performance issues.
 





 \* Perform hardware upgrades, replacements, and preventive maintenance.
 





 \* Troubleshoot basic LAN, Wi\-Fi, internet, and networking\-related issues.
 





 \* Install and configure printers, scanners, and other peripherals.
 





 \* Perform data backup, system formatting, OS installation, and software configuration when required.
 





 \* Identify the root cause of recurring technical problems and implement suitable solutions.
 





 \* Maintain records of hardware, software, repairs, replacements, and service activities.
 





 \* Provide technical support to employees/users and resolve issues within the required time.
 





 \* Escalate issues to senior technical teams or vendors when necessary.
 




  





**Required Skills** 





 \* Strong knowledge of computer hardware and troubleshooting.
 





 \* Good knowledge of Windows operating systems and software troubleshooting.
 





 \* Ability to diagnose and resolve critical hardware failures.
 





 \* Knowledge of hardware installation, replacement, and maintenance.
 





 \* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
 





 \* Ability to work independently and handle multiple technical issues.
 





 \* Good communication and customer/user\-support skills.
 




  





**Educational Qualification** 





 \* Diploma / ITI /
 
 B.Tech
 
 / B.E. /
 
 B.Sc
 
 . / BCA / relevant technical qualification in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field.
 




  





**Preferred Experience** 





 \* 1–3 years of experience in IT hardware support or technical support is preferred.
 





 \* Freshers with strong practical hardware troubleshooting knowledge may also be considered.
 




  





**Additional Requirements** 





 \* Willingness to handle urgent and critical technical issues.
 





 \* Willingness to travel to client/branch locations if required.
 





 \* Valid driving licence would be an advantage, if field support is part of the role.
 




  





**Key Performance Expectations** 




*The selected candidate will be expected to:* 





 \* Resolve hardware and software issues efficiently.
 





 \* Minimize system downtime.
 





 \* Maintain proper documentation of technical issues and solutions.
 





 \* Ensure IT equipment is maintained properly and remains operational.
 





 \* Provide professional and timely technical support to users.

title: Technology Operations and Support Associate, Retail Store Systems Support
description:
Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.
   

  

 At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education \& Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.
   

  

 ,
   

  

 The Associate, Retail Store Systems Support provides dedicated technical support for Ralph Lauren Retail Stores, covering POS computer systems, hardware, and software via telephone, email, and chat tools. This position is fast\-paced and multi\-task intensive, requiring excellent decision making and top\-notch customer service skills. Strong expertise in Windows systems and the ability to confidently troubleshoot over the phone are essential to success in this role.
   

  

 Working as part of a team, successful candidates will share our values and have an interest in working with the latest technologies to provide exceptional customer service to all Retail Stores in North America, EMEA, and some countries in APAC.
   

  

 ,
   

  

**General**
* Serve as the first point of contact for Retail Stores seeking assistance with POS hardware, software, workstations, printers, time clocks, UPS units, mobile devices, interactive screens, or other retail technology issues.
* Deliver clear, confident troubleshooting over the phone, guiding non\-technical store users step by step to resolution.
* Provide 24x7 support of applications for Retail Stores and participate in a rotating on\-call schedule for off\-hour and weekend coverage.
* Apply a logical approach and structured process to problem solving.
* Participate in product and process updates, and create documentation for the same.
* Proactively drive issues to closure and collaborate with peers to resolve them.
* Communicate problems clearly to your team and colleagues, and understand how issues affect other areas of the organization beyond IT.
* Acknowledge and action proactive monitoring alerts as a first responder, escalating where required.
* Take independent action – do things before being asked or forced by events – and contribute creative solutions and innovative ideas.


**Operational**
* Be an advocate for customer requests; maintain ownership of each request and follow through consistently to resolution.
* Increase Retail Store satisfaction by improving the First Contact Resolution (FCR) rate.
* Review open ticket queues and close tickets upon resolution daily.
* Triage and prioritize issues appropriately, and escalate problems to management when needed.
* Stay current with system information, changes, and updates.


 Applications \& Technology Expertise
   

  

**Must Have**
* High expertise in Windows 10 troubleshooting, with a strong overall understanding of both Windows and iOS platforms.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot over the phone and through remote support channels.
* Azure Active Directory – hands\-on experience.
* Networking – basic knowledge (connectivity, Wi\-Fi, and store network fundamentals).
* ITIL – basic knowledge of incident, request, and escalation processes, including an understanding of ticket prioritization and parent/child ticket relationships.
* ServiceNow – basic to intermediate (ticket logging, categorization, routing, and queue management).
* Retail hardware and POS setup – basic to intermediate (registers, receipt printers, barcode scanners, PIN pads, UPS units).
* Xstore POS – working knowledge of Level 1 troubleshooting (login, register, receipt printing, and open/close issues).
* Microsoft 365, Outlook, and SharePoint – working knowledge, with strong Excel skills.


**Good To Have**
* Exposure to proactive POS monitoring tools (e.g., HAWK) for alert acknowledgement and first response.
* Adyen and payment device troubleshooting – basic knowledge.
* Intune MDM – basic knowledge.
* IBM iSeries – foundation skills.
* TrueVue / RFID – basic knowledge.
* Exposure to connected retail applications such as Mad Mobile, Concierge, RetailNext, or Yoobic.
* SQL / Oracle – basic query and troubleshooting knowledge.


 ,
   

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to support store users across global regions over the phone.
* Strong customer service orientation and sound decision making in a fast\-paced, multi\-task environment.
* Logical problem\-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
* Collaborative team player who builds strong working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
* Proactive mindset with a “can do” attitude.
* Strong time management and prioritization skills.


 Mandatory Requirements
   

  

* Minimum 1 year of experience in ITES operations.
* Adaptability to work in rotational shifts as part of a 24x7 support model, which can include nights and weekends.

description:
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a motivated OT Network Engineer (L1\) to support our industrial network infrastructure. The candidate will assist in implementing and maintaining firewalls, SCADA systems and ensuring basic operational continuity in OT environments. This role requires frequent travelling to the plants for network activities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Assist in the installation, configuration, monitoring and maintenance of SCADA servers, desktops, and network devices (including routers, switches, and firewalls) across multiple site locations, ensuring compliance with project specifications and adherence to industry standards.
* Perform basic troubleshooting for SCADA systems and OT network connectivity issues.
* Ensure network security best practices in collaboration with IT \& OT Security team.
* Monitor firewall logs and raise alerts for anomalies.
* Track network changes, ensure change management process is followed. Regularly maintain and update documentation related to network architecture.
* Track/maintain documentation related to license expiry and renewals, asset details.
* Ensure the network infrastructure is aligned with the existing IT and cybersecurity policies and procedures.
* Coordinate with vendors and OEMs for L1\-level support and issue escalation.
* Follow SOPs for all the updates/upgrades in OT environments.
* Undertake mandatory travel to site locations for new projects and for ongoing projects, ensuring timely and efficient deployment and support.


**Key Skills \& Qualifications**
* Basic understanding of SCADA network architecture / IT network architecture and OT protocols (Modbus, OPC, etc.).
* Familiarity with firewall technologies (FortiGate, Sophos, Palo Alto, or equivalent).
* Good understanding of IP networking (VLANs, subnetting, routing basics).
* Exposure to industrial automation systems is a plus.
* Willingness to work in plant/industrial environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Computer Science, or related field.

 Hyderabad

 In\-office

 Full\-time

 1–3 years preferred
 



  





**About StepsAI** 




  





 StepsAI builds AI agents that help businesses sell, support, capture leads, book appointments, recommend products, answer questions and automate customer conversations.
 



  





 Our agents work across channels including websites, Shopify, WhatsApp, Instagram and other customer touchpoints.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who can help every new StepsAI customer get set up properly, see value quickly and continue getting better results over time.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 This is a customer\-facing role combining
 **Customer Success, Onboarding, and Implementation** 




  





**Technical Support** 
 .
 


1. You will own the early customer journey.
2. When a customer signs up, you will understand their business, identify what they want the AI agent to accomplish, configure the agent, connect the required channels, test it thoroughly and help them go live.



  





 But your job doesn't end at onboarding.
 



  





 You will continue to monitor how the agent is performing, talk to the customer, identify areas for improvement, tune the setup and make sure they are getting real value from StepsAI.
 



  





**Customer happiness is the highest priority.** 




  





 We want customers to feel that there is someone at StepsAI who understands their business and genuinely wants them to succeed.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Customer Onboarding** 




  





 Own the onboarding process from signup to successful go\-live.
 



  





 You will:
 


* Conduct approximately
 **5–6 customer onboarding sessions per day** 
 .
* Understand each customer's business, customers, goals and use cases.
* Identify what they want their AI agent to accomplish.
* Help customers set up their StepsAI account.
* Build and configure AI agents based on their business requirements.
* Train the agent using their website, product information, FAQs, documents and other business knowledge.
* Configure instructions, workflows and agent behaviour.
* Test the agent before launch.
* Help customers understand how to use the StepsAI platform.
* Make sure every customer has a clear path to going live.



  





 The objective is not simply to complete an onboarding call.
 



  





 The objective is to get the customer to their
 **first successful outcome as quickly as possible.** 




  





**Build \& Configure AI Agents** 




  





 You will work hands\-on with StepsAI to create effective agents for customers.
 



  





 This may include:
 


* Understanding the customer's business and customer journey.
* Identifying the most important questions customers ask.
* Structuring the right knowledge for the agent.
* Configuring agent instructions and behaviour.
* Setting up lead\-capture flows.
* Setting up product recommendation flows.
* Setting up customer\-support workflows.
* Configuring appointment or meeting booking.
* Setting up order\-tracking experiences.
* Configuring automation and workflows.
* Testing different customer questions and scenarios.
* Identifying gaps in the agent's responses.
* Continuously tuning the agent for better performance.



 You should enjoy experimenting until the agent works well.
 



  





**Integrations \& Channel Setup** 




  





 Help customers connect StepsAI to the channels and tools they already use.
 



 Depending on the customer, this could include:
 



  





**Websites** 



* WordPress
* Custom websites
* Other website platforms



  





**E\-commerce** 



* Shopify
* WooCommerce



  





**Messaging \& Social** 



* WhatsApp
* Instagram
* Facebook / Messenger



  





 You do not need to be a software engineer.
 



  





 But you should be
 **technically curious and comfortable learning how integrations work.** 




  





**Troubleshooting \& Customer Support** 




  





 You will be one of the first people customers contact when something isn't working.
 



  





 You will:
 


* Understand the problem clearly.
* Reproduce issues whenever possible.
* Identify whether the issue comes from configuration, data, integration or the product.
* Solve problems that can be handled directly.
* Guide customers through fixes.
* Escalate product or engineering issues with clear documentation.
* Coordinate with the technical team until the issue is resolved.
* Keep the customer updated throughout the process.
* Follow up after resolution to ensure everything is working properly.



  





 We care about
 **ownership** 
 , not simply forwarding tickets.
 



  





 If a customer has a problem, you should feel responsible for making sure it reaches a resolution.
 



  





**Customer Success** 




  





 Onboarding is only the beginning.
 



  





 After customers go live, you will proactively check how things are going.
 



  





**You will:** 



* Touch base with customers regularly.
* Understand whether StepsAI is achieving what they expected.
* Review conversations and agent performance.
* Identify unanswered or poorly answered questions.
* Identify opportunities to improve the agent.
* Recommend new features or workflows that could help them.
* Help customers adopt more of the platform.
* Identify customers who are not using the product effectively.
* Proactively reach out before customers become unhappy.
* Celebrate customer wins and understand what created them.



  





 Your goal is to move customers from:
 



  





**"We bought StepsAI."** 




 to:
 



**"StepsAI is actually helping our business."** 




  





**Monitor \& Improve Agent Performance** 




  





 AI agents need continuous improvement.
 



  





 You will regularly review how customer agents are performing and ask:
 


* Are questions being answered correctly?
* Where is the agent getting confused?
* What questions are customers asking repeatedly?
* Are leads being captured properly?
* Are products being recommended appropriately?
* Are integrations working correctly?
* Are workflows triggering as expected?
* Where are conversations dropping off?
* What additional knowledge should be added?
* What can we change to create a better customer experience?



  





 You will make changes and recommendations based on what you observe.
 



  





**Be the Voice of the Customer** 




  





 You will work closely with the Product and Engineering teams.
 



  





 You will:
 


* Collect recurring customer feedback.
* Identify common onboarding problems.
* Identify recurring bugs.
* Document feature requests.
* Surface friction in the product.
* Explain customer use cases to the product team.
* Identify opportunities to simplify onboarding.
* Suggest features or improvements based on real customer behaviour.



  





 Because you will speak with customers every day, you will have some of the best insights in the company about what customers actually need.
 



  





 We expect you to share them.
 



  





**Improve Our Systems** 




  





 We don't just want you to follow the onboarding process.
 



  





 We want you to help us
 **improve it** 
 .
 



  





 If 20 customers ask the same question, we shouldn't answer it manually 20 times forever.
 



  





 You will help us create:
 


* Better onboarding checklists.
* Standard implementation templates.
* Industry\-specific agent templates.
* Setup guides.
* FAQs.
* Troubleshooting guides.
* Video tutorials.
* Customer training material.
* Internal documentation.
* Standard operating procedures.
* Better follow\-up processes.
* Customer health tracking.
* Automated onboarding wherever appropriate.



  





 The goal is to make every future customer easier to onboard and more successful than the previous one.
 



  





**What a Typical Customer Journey Might Look Like** 




  





 A Shopify brand signs up for StepsAI.
 



  





 You:
 



**1\. Understand the business** 




 What do they sell?
 



 Who are their customers?
 



 What do they want StepsAI to accomplish?
 



**2\. Build the agent** 




 Train it on their products, policies, FAQs and website.
 



 Configure how it should respond.
 



 Set up product recommendations, support and lead\-capture use cases.
 



**3\. Connect the channels** 




 Install StepsAI on Shopify.
 



 Connect WhatsApp or Instagram if required.
 



 Test everything.
 



**4\. Go live** 




 Make sure the customer understands the platform and feels confident using it.
 



**5\. Monitor** 




 Review real conversations and performance.
 



**6\. Improve** 




 Tune responses, fix gaps and recommend improvements.
 



**7\. Follow up** 




 Talk to the customer and understand whether they are seeing value.
 



 That's the role.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers.
 



  





 You should be:
 



  





**Customer\-obsessed** 




 You care whether the customer actually succeeds.
 



 You don't think:
 



*"I finished my call."* 




 You think:
 



*"Did this customer get what they needed?"* 




  





**A strong communicator** 




 You should be comfortable speaking with business owners, marketers, e\-commerce teams and non\-technical customers.
 



 You should be able to explain technical concepts in simple language.
 



  





**A problem solver** 




 When something doesn't work, your first reaction should be:
 



**"Let me figure out why."** 




  





**Technically curious** 




 You don't need to code, but you should be comfortable understanding software, integrations, AI agents, websites and business tools.
 



  





**Organized** 




 You may work with multiple new and existing customers every day.
 



 You should be able to manage onboarding sessions, follow\-ups, open issues and customer commitments without losing track.
 



  





**Proactive** 




 You should not wait for customers to complain.
 



 If you see that something isn't working well, reach out and fix it.
 



  





**Comfortable with a fast\-moving startup** 




 Processes will improve.
 



 Products will change.
 



 New integrations will launch.
 



 New customer use cases will appear.
 



 You should be comfortable learning continuously.
 



  





**Preferred Background** 




  





 We would ideally like someone with
 **1–3 years of experience** 
 in one or more of the following:
 


* Customer Success
* SaaS Customer Onboarding
* Implementation
* Technical Support
* Product Support
* Client Success
* Customer Experience



 Experience with B2B SaaS, e\-commerce, Shopify, WhatsApp, chatbots is a strong advantage.
 



 Fresh graduates with exceptional communication, problem\-solving ability, and technical curiosity may also be considered.
 



  





**Skills That Will Help** 



* Strong customer communication.
* Troubleshooting and problem\-solving.
* Basic understanding of SaaS products.
* Ability to learn technical products quickly.
* Understanding of e\-commerce workflows.
* Familiarity with Shopify or WordPress.
* Familiarity with WhatsApp Business or Meta products.
* Strong documentation skills.
* Comfort working with AI tools.



  





**How Success Will Be Measured** 




  





 We care about both
 **speed and customer outcomes** 
 .
 



  





 Key metrics may include:
 


* Customers onboarded per day.
* Time from signup to go\-live.
* Successful onboarding / activation rate.
* Customer satisfaction after onboarding.
* First response and issue\-resolution time.
* Product and feature adoption.
* Customer engagement after onboarding.



 Agent performance and quality.

title: Employee Relations Manager, Employee Experience and Relations (EXR)
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, we’re working to be the "Earth's Best Employer and Earth's Safest Place to Work." To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright and driven people. If you would like to help us make history, here’s your chance to accelerate our growth and ability to serve our employees and associates by joining the India Operations Employee Relations (ER) Team.
   

  

 The India Operations ER team supports Field Operations organizations across fulfilment and logistics business lines. The central objective of our team is to ensure treatment of employees and associates that is fair, respectful, and consistent with our framework of our core business values and objectives. To support that objective, ER team’s responsibilities fall into proactive and reactive categories.
   

  

 INOPS ER team is part of the Global Employee Relations vertical within Amazon, and works closely with the Field People eXperience and Technology (PXT / HR) teams and Operations teams in advising and enabling them to provide a seamless employee and associate experience.
   

  

 As an Employee Relations Manager (ERM), you will drive positive employee relations and enable positive associate and employee experience in your region and line of business.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates with who possess communication and interpersonal skills that let them communicate with ease, across levels from shop floor employees to senior leaders. The role will set in motion and advance numerous programs that develop and nurture a positive work environment, and advancing our work towards being the earth’s best employer. This position requires an individual who has employee relations experience. Experience and exposure to Indian statutory labor compliance laws will be helpful. Successful candidate will be able to independently own and drive broad spectrum of employee relations programs and handle issues. This role requires considerable domestic travel.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The individual will be responsible for the following types of proactive work:
   

  

* Problem Solve: Work independently with minimal supervision, in ambiguous situations, and persevere over internal and external barriers to drive resolutions. Analyze, diagnose, design, and revise people programs, policies, and practices to sustain positive employee relations
* Communicate Effectively: Rapidly produce high\-quality written communications that concisely analyze problems and recommends solutions; design and deliver highly\-engaging training sessions. Partner to engage in continuous improvement in communication vehicles and practices
* Analyze and Interpret Data: Exercise analytical skills using data and anecdotes to develop persuasive narratives and recommendations; demonstrated ability to define and measure success of programs. Design, collect, and analyze multiple levels of employee feedback
* Detect and Mitigate Risks: Apply employee and labor relations expertise to successfully identify trends, gaps, and challenges; execute solution\-focused strategies and programs to mitigate risks
* Project Management: Independently own large\-scale, network\-wide projects delivered on time that improve associate experience at a site and network level. Conduct and oversee employee relations vulnerability assessment programs


 The individual also will work on critical employee relations issues that are crisis oriented and typically can only be successfully completed with limited time while exercising judgment. Time management between proactive and reactive responsibilities is a critical component for success in the position.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 5\+ years of employee relations, labor relations, human resources, operations or related field experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources Management or a related field
* 6\+ years of relevant professional experience

title: Director of Human Resources - Signia by Hilton Jaipur
description:
**Job Description**
**Welcome to Signia Jaipur!**
 This is a rare opportunity to lead the launch of Signia Jaipur, the first Signia by Hilton hotel in Asia Pacific and a landmark addition to Hilton’s rapidly expanding luxury portfolio in India. The 293\-room hotel, including 2 restaurants and 2 bars will represent the regional debut of one of Hilton’s newest and most innovative luxury brands, offering a unique platform to shape the guest experience, culture, commercial strategy, and market positioning from the ground up.
   

  

**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
 Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive human resources strategy that supports the company's long\-term business objectives and culture. As a
 **Director of Human Resources** 
 , you’re not just leading the hotel’s HR function – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
   

  

* Lead HR strategy and operations: Develop and execute HR strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives, ensuring compliance with corporate HR policies and local regulations
* Drive talent acquisition and workforce planning: Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and workforce planning to attract and retain top talent while optimizing labor costs
* Develop and engage talent: Oversee training programs, performance evaluations, and succession planning to support career growth and leadership development
* Manage team member relations: Guide employee relations, conflict resolution, and labor contract compliance, including grievance handling and negotiations
* Oversee HR policies and compliance: Establish and enforce HR policies, ensuring adherence to employment laws, wage and benefit administration, and workplace safety regulations
* Support financial goals: Develop and manage the HR budget, ensuring efficient use of resources while supporting hotel operations
* Cultivate a high\-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs


**Qualifications**
 At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
   

  

 A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
 **Hospitality** 
 . Acting with
 **Integrity** 
 and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
 **Leadership** 
 . A belief that
 **Teamwork** 
 drives the best outcomes. A sense of
 **Ownership** 
 and accountability. And a focus on the
 **Now** 
 , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
   

  

**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**
* Proven Director of Human Resources experience in luxury / upper\-upscale hotels
* Strong experience in managing pre\-opening luxury hotels
* Extensive HR experience across key functions—recruitment, training, performance management, and employee relations.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* Strong understanding of labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance standards.
* Commitment to professional ethics, confidentiality, and transparent practices.
* Proven ability to lead HR teams and influence organizational culture.
* Familiarity with HRIS systems and other HR\-related software.
* Excellent interpersonal and strategic communication abilities.
* Able to adapt to a dynamic hotel environment and support operational needs.


**About Us**
**Join an Award\-Winning Workplace Culture**
 At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world\-class brands , and a company\-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
   

  

 Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
   

  

 Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Product Analyst supports the Product Team and their client business processes and operations by maintaining and enhancing existing products and creating new ones. This role requires a strong analytical mindset and technical expertise to work with large datasets, derive insights, and deliver value to stakeholders as well as product management and development experience. The Product Analyst combines operational, technical, and analytic skills with problem\-solving and communication abilities. You will collaborate with and work closely with Senior Data Analyst and/or Product Owner(s) to ensure successful project execution.
   

  

**Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:**
* Operational Execution:
+ Understand and communicate client business needs and issues, operating rules, data structures, and standard operating procedures.
+ Execute and suggest improvements to pre\-defined operational procedures.
+ Implement process improvement in operational workflows, working with Senior Data Analysts and Product Owners.
+ Assist Product Owners to streamline the ideas to development processes, and the technical requirements processes.

* Product Development:
+ Enhance and maintain data products by understanding the data, product(s)/offering(s), client needs, and business goals.
+ Collaborate with stakeholders regarding business objectives.
+ Support product management with product development, and execution.
+ Partner with Product management to create, maintain and update roadmap documentation
+ Assist teams towards common objectives and document the solutions/decisions made.
+ Create technical requirements, user stories and test plans as part of an Agile methodological approach.

* Data Analysis:
+ Compare datasets / various inputs to ensure data quality and derive actionable insights.
+ Apply quality checks and validations to the product delivery, reporting results and elaborative summary for internal team and important stakeholders.

* Stakeholder collaboration:
+ Coordinate with stakeholders across different time zones to ensure smooth working within timelines.
+ Assist engineering teams with knowledge transfer and testing of new operational procedures and enhancements.
+ Facilitate knowledge transfer and overall product knowledge for engineering, Engagement and other teams.
+ Partner with stakeholders e.g. Engagement and Product Owners to understand client business needs and pain points with the intention to write user stories that address those needs.
+ Work closely with product team: Owners, developers and testers to ensure that written requirements are clearly stated, and comprehensive.

* Knowledge development:
+ Build subject matter expertise in operational processes, data tools, content, and necessary technology, and Scrum / Agile methodologies
+ Remain updated on tools, techniques, and working models to enhance processes.
+ Develop functional understanding of the product offering via the technology and deployment stack, to facilitate writing effective user stories, requirements and user acceptance criteria.

* Project Management:
+ Work on multiple client tasks simultaneously, strengthening analytical, task management, and communication skills.
+ Keep track of unplanned internal and clients’ tasks arising from any developments to existing or new products.
+ Maximize time management skills to balance workload in order to complete multiple deadline driven projects with a minimum of supervisory input.

* Coordinate meetings and prepare status update documentation / meetings for ongoing projects Research and Problem\-Solving
+ Conduct secondary research e.g. marketplace conditions, competitive environment, best practices to keep the product quality best\-in class while being able to address clients’ questions related to the same.
+ Coordinate and co lead design sessions to document feature requirements and guide stakeholders towards decision\-making.
+ Investigate issues and recommend solutions to improve processes.


**Qualifications**
**Minimum Required \-**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electronics/Communication, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.
* 1 – 2 years of experience using data mining languages/tools like SQL (for analysts), Excel. Exposure to stored procedures is a plus.
* Detail orientation with a strong focus on quality, analytics, and operations.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals, Managed Markets Consulting or Analytics Consulting with broad based experience in, managed care, and/or analytics will be an advantage.
* Proven ability to work with global teams across different time\-zones.


**Preferred**
* Masters in these disciplines OR MBA/PGDM/Equivalent
* Experience in product development, management, or operations.
* Strong knowledge of US Healthcare, payer/provider datasets, and managed care analytics.
* Familiarity with tools like Retool, Power BI and Power Query.


**Competencies**
* Operational Outlook:
+ Translate macro tasks into actionable steps and document, execute, and track them efficiently.
+ Seek opportunities for automation and process improvements while transferring knowledge to team members.

* Analytical Skills:
+ Thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
+ Strong problem\-solving and critical\-thinking capabilities.

* Communication Skills: Written, Verbal, and Presentation.
+ Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.
+ Ability to simplify complex processes for diverse audiences and respond promptly to inquiries.

* Collaboration and Teamwork:
+ Work effectively across teams and cultures, sharing constructive feedback to achieve team goals.
+ Demonstrate sound judgement, task management, and conflict resolution skills.

title: Associate Field effectiveness
description:
At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission \- to serve patients living with serious illnesses \- drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Let's do this. Let's change the world. In this vital role, the Associate, Field Effectiveness will provide hands\-on analytical and operational support that helps improve the productivity and effectiveness of the sales force. The role sits at the intersection of data analytics, commercial operations, and field strategy, with a focus on accurate execution, actionable insights, and reliable field enablement.
   

  

 This position reports to a Senior Manager within Field Excellence and works closely with field leadership, analytics, reporting, incentive compensation, data\-management, and cross\-system partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Field Data Analysis and Insights
   

  

* Analyze data from Veeva CRM, distribution partners, claims, patient services, and other approved commercial sources.
* Assess reach, frequency, HCP engagement, call\-plan adherence, account performance, and targeting effectiveness for field sales teams.
* Prepare recurring and ad hoc analyses that translate complex datasets into clear observations and practical actions for business partners.


 Operational Execution and Field Enablement
   

  

* Support territory alignments, roster updates, targeting cycles, and call\-plan execution in accordance with agreed timelines and controls.
* Coordinate operational delivery of field tools and outputs, including Veeva CRM, Next Best Action dashboards, digital companion tools, alerts, and call\-plan refreshes.
* Respond to routine field or stakeholder questions, investigate issues, document findings, and escalate risks or dependencies promptly.


 Sales Force Size, Structure, and Deployment
   

  

* Assist with analyses of field\-force size, structure, coverage, deployment, territory design, and workload balance.
* Support evaluations of customer and account potential, targeting logic, call frequency, capacity, and affordable coverage scenarios.
* Prepare data, scenarios, and quality checks required for alignment updates driven by market dynamics and business priorities.


 Field Force Effectiveness
   

  

* Support call planning, coverage optimization, targeting, valuation, and execution audits across applicable brands and field forces.
* Conduct periodic analyses of workload balance, reach and frequency, engagement quality, and performance trends under the guidance of senior team members.
* Develop clear summaries, charts, and supporting documentation for leadership reviews and cross\-functional discussions.


 Compliance, Quality, and Process Optimization
   

  

* Execute defined quality\-control checks and ensure analytics, reports, and field outputs follow approved business rules and applicable engagement\-compliance requirements.
* Document data sources, assumptions, methodologies, process steps, and validation evidence to support audit readiness, repeatability, and knowledge transfer.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate recurring work and support implementation of approved improvements.


 Project Support and Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Track deliverables, issues, dependencies, decisions, and action items using tools such as Jira and ServiceNow; maintain clear ownership and timely status updates.
* Maintain project documentation, including timelines, decision logs, issue trackers, validation files, and closure summaries.
* Collaborate effectively with Field Reporting, Incentive Compensation, iDNA/data teams, analytics, cross\-system operations, and field stakeholders to deliver agreed priorities.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree or Bachelor's degree and 1 \- 3 years of experience in sales analytics, sales operations, commercial analytics, and/or field effectiveness.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in the bio/pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Hands\-on ability to write SQL queries and perform data analysis, data visualization, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Experience with sales\-planning or operations platforms used for targeting, alignment, roster management, and call planning.
* Familiarity with CRM systems such as Veeva and with commercial data such as sales, activity, claims, and customer/account data.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to identify data\-quality issues and explain findings clearly.
* Effective written and verbal communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.


**What You Can Expect Of Us**
