title: Product Manager
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
 WisdomAI builds AI\-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
   

  

 We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

**About WisdomAI**
 WisdomAI is on a mission to make working with data delightful. We empower businesses to unlock insights, drive innovation, and make data\-driven decisions at scale. Join our rapidly growing team and be a part of a company that is shaping the future of enterprise data. We are a fast\-paced, early\-stage startup, currently \~30 people and growing.
   

  

**The Role: A Builder, An Empath, and An Executor**
 This is not a traditional Product Manager position; it is a dynamic, hands\-on function built for the age of AI\-native product development. We are a build\-first company that values execution and rapid iteration over lengthy documentation.
   

  

 At WisdomAI, the Product Manager acts as a catalyst for collective intelligence, empowering engineers and designers to propose and build, keenly capture customer feedback, and continuously strive for improvement. This role requires a minimum of 4\+ years of relevant experience and a deep balance of technical understanding and customer empathy.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
 The PM role serves as the glue that connects the customer's needs, the market's demands, and our team's creative and technical capabilities.
   

  

* Customer Empathy and Data Mastery
* Cultivate deep customer empathy by spending time with prospects and users, observing workflows, and understanding their business context.
* Translate customer pain points into clear and actionable problem statements for the development team.
* Leverage your technical and data understanding to evaluate product performance, interpret complex analytics, and inform strategic decisions.
* Proactively track qualitative and quantitative feedback by monitoring support channels, listening to sales calls, and checking in with customer\-facing teams.
* Technical Depth and Execution Orientation
* Guide the team in choosing the right development approach for the task at hand (PM\-first, Design\-first, or Dev\-first), relying on your technical understanding of our platform.
* Define the problem and its constraints, allowing engineers to write robust solution proposals.
* Maintain a relentless execution oriented focus, seeing yourself as an extension of the development team, unblocking them and consistently following through on commitments to drive features to launch.
* Work effectively in our fast\-paced environment, balancing immediate user needs with long\-term strategic goals.
* Strategic Communication
* Facilitate discussions, lead brainstorms, and articulate a compelling product vision to align the entire organization.
* Act as a product evangelist, collaborating with sales, marketing, and customer success to clearly articulate the product’s value.
* Proactively close the feedback loop, ensuring insights from users and the market are constantly flowing back into the development process.


**What You'll Bring: Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience in Product Management, specifically within B2B SaaS, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related AI\-native platforms.
* Proven track record of successful product delivery and strategic execution in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated technical and data understanding—you must be comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, model performance, and architectural trade\-offs with customers and engineers.
* Deeply rooted customer empathy and proficiency in interpreting user analytics and business metrics to guide product strategy.
* Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Our CRAFT**
 CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
   

  

**C — Customer trust.** 
 Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
   

  

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** 
 We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
   

  

**A — Authenticity.** 
 We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
   

  

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.** 
 We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real\-world results decide.
   

  

**T — Transparency.** 
 We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
   

  

**Equal opportunity employer**
 WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

**Work from office expectations:** 
 This role requires you to operate from office all 5 days in a week.
 



**Diversity \& Inclusion**

 We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the actions of our leadership, global teams and individual team members. We are resolute in our belief that each team member has an equal responsibility to mold and uphold our culture.  
 



 project44 is an equal opportunity employer seeking to enrich our work environment by creating opportunities for individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to thrive. If you share our values and our passion for helping the way the world moves, we’d love to review your application!  
 



 For any needed accommodations during the hiring process, please email recruiting@project44\.com. title: Junior Field Applications Engineer, ASIC Design
description:
Alternate Job Titles
   

  

* Application Engineer, Physical Design
* Associate Applications Engineer, Silicon Design
* Junior Field Applications Engineer, ASIC Design
* Technical Support Engineer, Physical Design
* Applications Engineer, Digital Implementation


 We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 You are early in your career but already know that the most interesting problems in chip design are not the ones in the textbook, they are the ones that show up when a customer is three weeks from tapeout and their timing is not closing. You have spent time in internships or academic projects working with ASIC flows, and you learned that understanding the theory is only half the job. The other half is figuring out what went wrong, why the tool did what it did, and how to explain it clearly enough that the person on the other end of the call can actually fix it.
   

  

 You are curious. When something breaks, you do not just escalate it, you dig in. You look at the logs, reproduce the issue, and try to understand the root cause before asking for help. You are comfortable learning new tools and flows without perfect documentation because you know how to read through examples, ask smart questions, and connect the dots. At Synopsys, you will work directly with customers and internal teams on real chip design challenges, learning from experienced engineers while solving problems that matter. This is where you build the foundation that turns you into the engineer customers call when things get hard.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Provide technical support to customers using Synopsys Physical Design tools, helping them resolve issues in their ASIC development flows
* Diagnose and troubleshoot customer problems by analyzing design data, tool logs, and flow configurations to isolate root causes
* Work closely with internal product engineering and R\&D teams to reproduce issues, suggest workarounds, and escalate bugs that need fixes
* Respond to customer requests during critical design schedules, providing timely solutions or workarounds that keep projects moving
* Build working knowledge of Synopsys Physical Design tools and methodologies through hands\-on customer engagements and internal training
* Participate in customer deployments and training sessions, helping teams adopt Synopsys tools and best practices
* Document technical issues, solutions, and customer feedback to improve internal knowledge bases and inform product improvements


 The Impact You Will Have
   

  

* Help customers meet their tapeout schedules by resolving technical issues that would otherwise block their progress
* Improve the quality and usability of Synopsys tools by surfacing real customer pain points to product engineering and R\&D
* Build customer confidence in Synopsys solutions by delivering reliable, timely technical support during critical project phases
* Contribute to the development of better methodologies and reference flows based on what you learn from customer deployments
* Accelerate your own technical growth by working on diverse customer designs across different process nodes and design styles
* Strengthen customer relationships by being responsive, thorough, and solution\-oriented even when the problem is not straightforward
* Support the broader Applications Engineering team by taking ownership of support cases and learning to handle more complex issues over time


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering or related field
* At least 6 months to 1 year of internship or contractor experience in a global or multinational company, ideally in semiconductor or EDA
* Solid understanding of Physical Design flow, including placement, routing, timing, and basic optimization concepts
* Strong foundation in digital circuits, CMOS fundamentals, and ASIC design flow from RTL to GDSII
* Working knowledge of Unix/Linux environments and basic scripting for automation and debugging
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to customers and colleagues
* Experience with Synopsys Physical Design tools such as Fusion Compiler, IC Compiler II, PrimeTime, or StarRC is a plus but not required


 Who You Are
   

  

* You can take a vague customer description like "the tool is crashing" and turn it into a specific reproducer with logs and data
* Comfortable asking questions when you do not know something, but you also try to figure it out yourself first
* You stay organized when managing multiple support cases and know which ones need immediate attention versus which can wait
* You do not get frustrated when the answer is not obvious, you treat it as a puzzle worth solving
* Reliable enough that when you say you will follow up with a customer by end of day, it actually happens
* Open to domestic and international travel for customer visits, training, and onsite support when needed


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will join the Silicon Design \& Verification Applications Engineering team, working with experienced engineers who support customers on Physical Design flows and tools. This team collaborates closely with R\&D, product engineering, and global AE teams to solve customer problems and improve Synopsys solutions. Your recruiter will share more about team structure, mentorship, and growth opportunities during the interview process.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Program Associate - BIM
description:
📍 Atrium Place, Udyog Vihar
 



  





**About the role** 




 AEC is changing quickly. The way projects are designed, coordinated and delivered today is very different from what many of us were exposed to during our education.
 



  





 At Novatr, we're working to bridge that gap by helping AEC professionals understand and work with the future of the industry.
 



  





 As a Program Associate \- BIM, you'll be part of the team building that experience.
 



 This isn't a role where you'll simply work on BIM projects. You'll work closely with industry mentors, learners and internal teams to help create learning experiences that are practical, relevant and connected to how the industry is actually evolving.
 



  





 You'll bring your understanding of AEC and BIM into learning, research, program execution and problem\-solving, while getting a much broader view of the industry and the people shaping its future.
 



  





**What you'll work on:** 




**Build better learning experiences** 



* Work with mentors and internal teams to create assignments, activities, resources and other learning materials.
* Help translate technical and industry concepts into learning experiences that are clear and useful for professionals.
* Contribute to curriculum structuring, presentations and documentation.
* Review and improve learning experiences based on learner feedback and industry needs.



  





**Stay close to where AEC is heading** 



* Research how AEC teams are working today and how those workflows are evolving.
* Explore emerging technologies, tools and approaches that could influence the industry.
* Bring relevant industry observations and ideas into our programs.
* Help us experiment with better ways of teaching and delivering programs.



  





**Work closely with people** 



* Collaborate with industry mentors and professionals to bring real\-world context into our programs.
* Interact with learners and understand the challenges they face.
* Coordinate with internal teams to keep programs moving smoothly.
* Help resolve learner and program\-related challenges with ownership.



  





**Own program execution** 



* Support the end\-to\-end execution of learning programs.
* Track milestones, deliverables and timelines.
* Coordinate across mentors, learners and internal teams.
* Identify gaps, solve problems and improve processes along the way.



  





**What you must bring:** 




**A strong foundation in BIM** 




 You should have genuine, hands\-on familiarity with:
 


* BIM workflows
* Revit
* Navisworks



 You don't need to know everything about BIM. We care more about whether you understand how these tools and workflows are actually used and can apply that understanding thoughtfully.
 



  





**How you think and work:** 




**We're looking for someone who** 



* Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.
* Is curious about how the AEC industry is changing.
* Can break down a problem and figure out a way forward.
* Communicates clearly with different kinds of people.
* Is comfortable researching, learning, and working with incomplete information.
* Can manage multiple priorities without losing attention to detail.
* Enjoys building things, improving processes, and making things work better.



  





**Good to have:** 




**These aren't requirements, but they would be a great addition:** 



* Experience with Civil 3D
* Experience with ETABS
* Experience with STAAD.Pro
* Exposure to BIM coordination
* Understanding of construction documentation
* Experience working on real\-world AEC projects
* Experience creating presentations, documentation, or learning content
* Exposure to AI or productivity tools
* Experience coordinating projects, teams or stakeholders



  





**Who could be a great fit?** 




 You could be an architect, civil engineer, structural engineer, or someone from a related built\-environment background.
 



  





 You may have spent your career working on projects and are now curious about what lies beyond the traditional project role.
 



  





 Or you may be earlier in your career and already have a strong foundation in BIM, along with the curiosity to understand the industry beyond the software you use.
 



  





 We're not looking for someone who checks every box.
 



  





 We're looking for someone who can bring their AEC perspective, learn quickly, take ownership, and help us build something that didn't exist in the same way when we were students.
 



  





**What you'll gain:** 



* Exposure to real\-world AEC workflows and the people shaping them.
* Hands\-on experience in program and project execution.
* The opportunity to work closely with experienced AEC mentors and professionals.
* Exposure across learning, content, operations, product, and industry partnerships.
* Experience building systems and processes in a fast\-moving startup environment.
* A chance to contribute to how the next generation of AEC professionals prepares for the industry.

Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

With an integrated suite of cloud\-based solutions, Proofpoint helps companies around the world stop targeted threats, safeguard their data, and make their users more resilient against cyber\-attacks. Leading organizations of all sizes, including more than half of the Fortune 1000, rely on Proofpoint for people\-centric security and compliance solutions mitigating their most critical risks across email, the cloud, social media, and the web.
   

  

 We are singularly devoted to helping our customers protect their greatest assets and biggest security risk their people. That’s why we’re a leader in next\-generation cybersecurity.
   

  

 Protection Starts with People. Proofpoint.
   

  

**Job Description**
 About the role
   

  

 We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our team and work on scalable, production\-grade systems built with Go. You will contribute to the development of microservices that power core product features, while gaining hands\-on experience with modern backend architectures. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building efficient systems, solving performance challenges, and working closely in real\-world production environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Design and implement features end to end
   

  

 Develop and maintain microservices using Golang
   

  

 Contribute to API design and service\-to\-service communication
   

  

 Debug and resolve issues across distributed systems
   

  

 Write clean, maintainable, and well\-tested code
   

  

 Collaborate with engineers across product and infrastructure teams
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science or related field
   

  

 Experience with Go or strong willingness to learn it quickly
   

  

 Understanding of backend fundamentals (APIs, databases, concurrency, networking)
   

  

 Contribute to system design discussions and technical decisions
   

  

 Familiarity with microservices architecture or distributed systems concepts
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail
   

  

 Proactive mindset and eagerness to learn in a fast\-paced environment
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 Experience with REST APIs, or messaging systems
   

  

 Familiarity with Goroutine and asynchronous development techniques
   

  

 Familiarity with Docker or containerization
   

  

 Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

 Protecting people is at the heart of our award\-winning lineup of cybersecurity solutions, and the people who work here are the key to our success. We’re a customer\-focused and a driven\-to\-win organization with leading\-edge products. We are an inclusive, diverse, multinational company that believes in culture fit, but more importantly ‘culture\-add’, and we strongly encourage people from all walks of life to apply.
   

  

 We believe in hiring the best and the brightest to help cultivate our culture of collaboration and appreciation. Apply today and explore your future at Proofpoint!

 At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us
   

  

* Competitive compensation

title: Hardware Engineer - RF and Electronics
description:
This is a hardware job. You will lay out boards, populate and bring them up on a bench, tune a radio link and go outside to measure what its range actually is, and climb a mast at a helipad to make the thing work.
 



  





 WE ARE NOT HIRING A SOFTWARE ENGINEER. The firmware architecture and the ground\-station software sit with our founding innovator and will continue to. You will write firmware — plenty of it, bare\-metal and RTOS, against a datasheet and a scope, because that is part of hardware engineering. You will not own the software stack. If what you want is to write code for a living, this role will disappoint you inside a month and we would rather say so now.
 



  





 2–4 years. Hyderabad. First two months at Gandhinagar, Gujarat, on a live deployment.
 



  





 ABOUT US
 



  





 BharatVijay Nexgen Innovation Private Limited is a DPIIT\-recognised Indian startup (DIPP260346\) in aeronautics, aerospace and defence equipment, founded by Lt Col Shailendra Thapliyal (Retd).
 



  





 Our product is the Digital Windsock — an Automatic Helipad Weather Reporting System. It is solar\-powered and fully autonomous, measures wind speed and direction, temperature, humidity, pressure and rainfall, and delivers that weather to pilots through six independent channels: VHF/UHF radio broadcast out to roughly 10 km, an aviation data link that aircraft decode on approach, ATIS\-style local audio at the pad, a remote display in the operations office, SMS, and network integration over 4G with store\-and\-forward. It is built to run unattended for months, off\-grid, where nobody is coming to reset it.
 



  





 We are five people. Bootstrapped, no funding round.
 



  





 WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH
 



  





 One person currently does all of it — mechanics, PCB, firmware, software, commissioning. Everything in our products has come off his bench. This role exists to build a hardware capability around him. You will sit next to the person who built the product and take real ownership of its physical layers.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL OWN
 



  





 From month three: the RF and antenna chain and the power system, end to end. Antenna selection and siting, matching, link budget, the measured range at each site, and the solar and battery sizing that keeps a unit alive between them. You are the person on the phone when a link degrades at a customer site.
 



  





 At around month four: you commission a unit end to end, on site, on your own. Clear that and your first salary review is brought forward and uncapped.
 



  





 By around month six: one board revision end to end — schematic, layout, fabrication files, bring\-up and test record.
 



  





 WHAT WE NEED YOU TO HAVE EVIDENCED
 



  





 At least three of the following, and at least one from the first two:
 



  





 1\. PCB design — schematic and layout in KiCad, Altium, Eagle, OrCAD or EasyEDA, fabricated, populated and debugged by you
 



 2\. Board bring\-up and component\-level fault\-finding — bare board to working, faults found with a scope, meter and logic analyser
 



 3\. RF and wireless — a link you designed, matched or tuned, with range, RSSI or packet loss you measured outdoors
 



 4\. Sensor integration and calibration against a reference instrument
 



 5\. DC and solar power — panels, charge controller, battery, load budget, proven autonomy
 



 6\. Mechanical design and fabrication — enclosures, brackets, mounts or masts from CAD through fabrication, with weatherproofing and ingress protection
 



 7\. Qualification testing — EMI/EMC, thermal, vibration or environmental, with the documentation
 



 8\. Field installation and commissioning of equipment at a customer or field site
 



  





 Useful, and not a substitute for any of the above: embedded C and C\+\+, Python for tools and test scripts, bare\-metal and RTOS firmware, Linux command line, practical networking, version control.

A breadboard project or an Arduino build is not that.
 



  





 TERMS
 



  





 ₹6,00,000–₹9,00,000 per annum, fixed. One hundred per cent fixed pay, no variable component, paid on a fixed date every month. EPF from day one. ₹5,00,000 family medical floater including your parents, plus personal accident cover. Written salary review at 12 months with a committed minimum increase stated in your offer letter. Retention payments at 12 and 24 months. Annual tools and components budget. Field expenses reimbursed within seven days. Safety equipment provided and replaced when worn.
 



  





 First two months at Gandhinagar on an active deployment — stay and travel paid by us over and above salary, plus a deployment allowance paid fortnightly in advance, one paid home trip, and a relocation allowance on return. The return date goes into your offer letter as a calendar date.
 



  





 NOT FOR YOU IF you want a large structured corporate environment, a defined ticket queue, or a route into a software role. There is no ESOP at this stage and no work\-from\-home — the bench is in Hyderabad and the mast is in the field.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ. Applications are only accepted through this form: https://forms.gle/KVrQLFub1w4wu7RJ7
 



  





 CVs emailed to us will not be read. The form takes about twelve minutes and asks for a link to photographs of hardware you have built, and for the last fault you found with a test instrument.

description:
**Location:** 
 Sector\-132, Noida, (involves travelling with the team to various test sites across India)

 ₹6\-8 LPA
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time, On\-site
   

  

**About Zoid\-**
 ZOID is a deep\-tech R\&D startup developing advanced defence and aerospace technologies for the Indian Military and UAV manufacturers. Our work spans AI, electronics, robotics, autonomous systems and UAV platforms.
   

  

 Our current projects include AI\-based FOD detection for naval air stations, GNSS\-denied navigation, aerial intelligent mapping, reusable off\-board missile decoys, vision\-based kinetic strike systems and drone swarming solutions.
   

  

**Role Overview\-**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Systems Engineer** 
 to support the end\-to\-end design, integration, testing, flight operations and deployment of UAV systems.
   

  

 The role requires strong practical knowledge of drone hardware, avionics, flight controllers, power systems, communication links, payload integration and field testing. The candidate must be comfortable manually flying small to medium\-category UAVs and travelling to test locations across India.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities\-**
**UAV Systems \& Integration**
* Lead, design and assemble end\-to\-end integration of UAV subsystems: propulsion, avionics, control, payload and power.
* Hands\-on with various frame designs — Quad/Hex/Octa copters, fixed\-wing, VTOL, etc.
* Select suitable drives, electronic components, sensors and hardware.
* Knowledge of motors, ESCs, propellers — their specs and configuration.
* Configure, integrate, calibrate and auto\-tune flight controllers (Pixhawk, Cube Orange\+, PX4, etc.).
* Analyse flight logs using Mission Planner, QGroundControl or MAVLink tools for pre\- and post\-flight debugging.
* Knowledge of standard flight modes (stabilize, althold, poshold, loiter, land, rtl, guided, auto), fail\-safes (RC, GCS, battery, geofence, EKF) and mission planning.
* Familiar with standard Pixhawk Cube parameters and setting them via Mission Planner.


**Communication \& Networking**
* Ability to configure IP networks — IP addressing, subnet masks, gateways, routing — and get companion computers, flight controllers, payload processors, routers and ground stations talking on the same network.
* Knowledge of serial communication protocols: UART, SPI, I²C, CAN, RS\-232, including baud rates and debugging.
* Understanding of telemetry radios, RC links, video links, mesh networks, Ethernet, LTE/5G modems, VPN/routing and IP\-based payload communication.
* Understanding of MAVLink routing, UDP/TCP endpoints, packet loss, latency and link redundancy.


**Basic RF knowledge** 
 — understanding of what a signal is and the fundamentals behind it.
   

  

**Power System Design**
* Understanding of Li\-ion/LiPo packs, C\-rating, discharge curves, BMS, cell balancing and safe charging/discharging.
* Ability to calculate power Budget, current draw, endurance, payload power and voltage rail requirements.
* Knowledge of PDBs, DC\-DC converters, BECs, fuses, connectors, wire gauge selection and grounding.
* Troubleshoot brownouts, voltage drops, ESC desync, power noise and overheating.


**Sensor \& Payload Integration**
 Integrate EO/IR cameras, gimbals, LiDAR, rangefinders, GNSS/RTK modules, IMUs, magnetometers, payload controllers and RF payloads.
   

  

* Read sensor datasheets and understand interfaces, power needs, mounting constraints and calibration.
* Test payload data flow from sensor → onboard computer → ground station.
* Ability to read datasheets, schematics, pinouts and reference manuals to bring up and test embedded boards.


**Software \& Development**
* Python skills are mandatory for development, log analysis / visualization, automation and tooling.
* Working knowledge of Ubuntu / Linux is required, including basic commands (SSH, SCP, mkdir, cd, rm, etc.) and day\-to\-day use of a Linux environment.
* Basic firmware development, flashing, debugging and peripheral interfacing on microcontrollers such as STM32, ESP32, Arduino or similar.


**Qualifications**
**Education:** 
 Diploma or degree in Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or a related field. Equivalent experience also considered.
   

  

**Experience**
* Minimum 3 years in a Avionics Systems Engineer preferably in a startup, R\&D or defence\-tech setup.
* Prior experience in defence/aerospace product testing and deployment.
* Experience building and operating drones from scratch and running day\-to\-day autonomous/semi\-autonomous flights.


**Hands\-on Skills**
* Integrating flight controllers with ESCs, GPS, power modules, telemetry, RF systems and onboard computers.
* Familiarity with aviation regulations and military standards for UAV development is a plus.


**Core Skills\-**
* Proficiency in MS Office, Canva, AI Tool like Claude.
* Strong problem\-solving — able to think critically and creatively about complex engineering challenges.
* Good communication skills for working with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in English is mandatory.


**Additional Requirements**
* Willingness to travel to test sites across India.
* Comfortable working outdoors for extended durations.


**Preferred Skills**
 Beyond the requirements above, any of the following is a big plus:
   

  

* Advanced software experience with C\+\+, ROS and Gazebo.
* Familiarity with embedded processors beyond standard computers — microcontrollers, SBCs, SoCs and FPGA\-based development boards.
* Basic familiarity with FPGA / SoC\-FPGA workflows: HDL, synthesis, bitstream generation, programming and hardware validation using tools like Vivado/Vitis or similar.
* Awareness of different RF architectures, with the judgement to do design and analysis of the subsystems in an RF chain.
* Understanding of antenna theory, types of signals, jamming signals and SDRs

title: User Experience Analyst
description:
**Role:** 
 UI/UX Analyst (D2C Product)
 



**Reports To:** 
 Lead D2C
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Work from Office)
 



  





**Nature of Business \& What You'll Own** 




 As UI/UX Analyst, you'll
 **diagnose friction, design better user experiences, and validate improvements through data.** 




 You're not a pure designer. You're not a pure analyst. You're the
 **bridge** 
 – using session recordings, heatmaps, and funnel data to identify
 *why* 
 customers drop off, and designing solutions to test.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



1. Session recording analysis \- watch session recordings 2–3x/week to spot friction and user behavior patterns
2. UX friction diagnosis – combine session data, heatmaps, and GA4 to build a prioritized list of improvements
3. A/B test variant design – sketch solutions in Figma based on your findings; collaborate with the product and design teams on testing strategy
4. Design system maintenance — collaborate with the design strategy team to document components and ensure consistency across the website
5. Insight reporting – weekly conversion updates to the team; monthly deep dives on major findings
6. Tool evaluation – research and recommend new UX testing tools (UserTesting, Maze, etc.) as you identify gaps in our workflow



 You'll collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to drive user\-centric improvements across the platform.
 



  





**Technical Capabilities Required:** 




**Design Tools \& Prototyping:** 



* **Figma proficiency** 
 (non\-negotiable) – component\-based design, design systems, interactive prototypes
* Ability to create A/B test variants quickly and hand off clean specs to engineering
* Understanding of mobile\-first design



**Analytics \& Data Tools( good to have):** 



* **GA4** 
 –funnel visualization, event tracking, custom reports (not deep SQL, but comfortable navigating the tool)
* **Session recording tools** 
 – session recording, heatmaps, and user behavior identification
* Ability to interpret data and translate findings into design improvements
* Basic statistical thinking (correlation vs. causation, sample size matters)



**Platform \& E\-Commerce Context:** 



* Familiarity of
 **e\-commerce platforms** 
 – enough to know what's possible and what's a technical constraint
* Familiarity with
 **conversion funnel** 
 – browse → add\-to\-cart → checkout → payment → confirmation



**Tools You Can Learn \& Suggest:** 



* You're encouraged to research and recommend new tools that fit your workflow –
 **UserTesting, Maze, Hotjar, Pendo** 
 , etc.
* You should stay current on UX testing and session recording tools



  





**Functional Capabilities Required:** 




**Conversion Psychology:** 



* Understand micro\-interactions that drive decision\-making (button color, copy, social proof, urgency)
* Know how to reduce friction (form fields, payment options, trust signals)
* Apply JTBD (Jobs to Be Done) thinking – what job is the customer hiring this product for?



**UX Research \& Data Literacy:** 



* Can read a session recording and identify 3–5 UX issues
* Can spot patterns in heatmap data (click clusters, scroll depth, attention areas)
* Comfortable asking "why" – always validate assumptions with data before designing



**A/B Testing \& Iteration:** 



* Design test variants based on hypothesis, not guesswork
* Understand statistical rigor (sample size, test duration, confidence levels)
* Iterate based on results – learn from losses, compound wins



**Communication \& Collaboration:** 



* Sketch ideas quickly in Figma and get feedback early
* Present findings to product and design teams in a structured way
* Comfortable with ambiguity — you'll be expected to own problems, not just execute specs



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 



* **2–3 years** 
 of UX/UI design or product analytics experience (agency, SaaS, e\-commerce, or D2C preferred)
* **Figma expertise** 
 \- can create designs, components, and interactive prototypes; not a designer by training, but by fluency
* **Conversion psychology** 
 – understand how small UX changes impact user behavior
* **Data literacy** 
 – comfortable with GA4 funnels, segment analysis, and session recording tools
* **Mobile\-first thinking** 
 – design for phones first, then desktop
* **India D2C context** 
 – nice\-to\-have but not mandatory. Understanding of Indian customer behavior, payment methods, and logistics is valuable
* **Written communication** 
 — can document findings clearly and present to non\-designers



  





**To apply , please complete the following 2 questions:** 




  





**Task 1 Description:** 




 Audit The Whole Truth Foods' website (thewholetruthfoods.com), specifically the
 **product browse → add\-to\-cart → checkout flow** 
 . Identify 4\-5 friction points or UX issues that could impact conversion rate. For 2 of these issues, design a proposed improvement in Figma or any free design tool (Penpot, Excalidraw, Figma free tier). Include a written analysis explaining:
 


* What friction you identified (and why it matters)
* How you'd measure the impact of your proposed change
* Hypothesis for what conversion lift you'd expect



  





**Task 2 Description:** 




 Your GA4 shows that 42% of users land on the homepage, but only 18% click into a category page. Of those who do, only 8% complete a purchase. Heatmap data shows the category navigation menu has low click\-through \- users instead using the search bar. Session recordings reveal users are confused about the difference between similar products (e.g., Whey Protein vs. Plant Protein, or different protein bar flavors). The exit rate on category pages is 35%."
 



**Candidate's Task:** 



1. **Diagnose the issue** 
 – Write 150–200 words on why category navigation is underperforming and how it impacts the funnel (consider: information overload, product differentiation, filtering options, trust signals)
2. **Propose 3 design/UX changes** 
 — Could include: improved category page layout, better filtering, comparison tools, simplified navigation, product badge/labeling, etc.
3. **Design 1 variant** 
 – Redesigned category page or navigation menu in Figma/free tool
4. **Testing \& insights plan** 
 – How would you test? What secondary metrics matter (e.g., time on category page, filter usage, comparison tool clicks)?

title: Graduate Engineering Trainee
description:
**Company Description** 
 Dunbar \& Boardman (D\&B), founded in the UK in 1981, is an independent specialist consultancy focused on Vertical Transportation and Façade Access advisory services across the UK, Middle East, India, and international markets. With over four decades of experience, D\&B supports clients throughout the building lifecycle, from feasibility and concept design through construction, commissioning, and ongoing asset management. The consultancy provides expert guidance on lifts, escalators, moving walkways, façade maintenance, and specialist access systems, integrating safety, performance, and maintainability from early design stages. D\&B works across sectors including high\-rise, residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, airports, transport infrastructure, and mixed\-use developments. As a manufacturer\-neutral firm, D\&B’s recommendations are driven by safety, operational efficiency, lifecycle needs, and client interests, helping create safe, efficient, future\-ready buildings.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Graduate Engineering Trainee will support senior engineers and consultants in delivering vertical transportation and façade access projects, with a focus on technical analysis, design coordination, and documentation. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include assisting with data collection, technical calculations, report preparation, and reviewing drawings and specifications for lifts, escalators, and façade access systems. The role involves collaborating with project teams, attending internal and external meetings, and contributing to project planning, tracking, and quality assurance activities. The Trainee will also help with research on standards, codes, and emerging technologies relevant to vertical transportation and façade access, and support site visits and inspections under supervision. This is a full\-time hybrid role, based in Bengaluru, with a combination of office\-based work and some work\-from\-home flexibility.

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear written reporting and effective interpersonal communication in multidisciplinary teams.
* Candidates should possess robust Analytical Skills to interpret technical data, perform calculations, and support engineering decision\-making.
* Candidates should possess foundational Project Management skills to assist with task planning, schedule tracking, and coordination of project deliverables.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of Manufacturing Engineering principles relevant to components, materials, and production processes used in vertical transportation and façade access systems.

title: Software Development Engineer (SDE) – Frontend Focused
description:
**Software Development Engineer (SDE) – Frontend Focused** 




*Steps AI  ·  On\-Site, Hyderabad, India  ·  Full\-Time, Paid* 




  





**Only apply if:** 

 You have at least 1–2 years of production frontend experience, you have shipped scalable React / TypeScript (Next.js preferred) interfaces, and you can point us to live, deployed products that show your UI craft \- not only a repository.
 




  






 This is a full\-time, on\-site role in Hyderabad, India. Occasional travel is required. This includes travel to on\-premises deployment locations and travel to client sites in Hyderabad for implementation, go\-live, reviews, or production support.
 




  





**Who We Are** 





 Steps AI is a product company building intelligent, AI\-powered software for modern businesses. We design and ship production systems that combine strong user experience, reliable backends, and data\-driven intelligence. We work with real customers, deploy to both cloud and on\-premises environments, and move from prototype to production with a high bar for security, access control, and operational quality.
 




  






 We are growing, shipping every week, and looking for engineers who can own a problem end to end \- interface, API, data, security, and deployment \- rather than a single layer of the stack.
 




  





**The Role** 





 We are hiring a Frontend\-focused SDE to own the quality of the product experience: structure, visual clarity, interaction, and performance. You will spend most of your time on the interface, but you will not throw work over the wall. You will integrate with real APIs, respect authentication and role\-based visibility, and help take a working demo to a polished, deployable product.
 




  






 You will work with full\-stack peers on the API and data model. You should be comfortable reading backend contracts, flagging when the UI needs a different API shape, and making design decisions when there is no finished Figma file.
 




  





**What You Will Do** 




**Core Frontend Development** 



* Build production\-grade applications using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS (Tailwind or equivalent). Next.js (App Router) is strongly preferred.
* Create reusable components and a consistent design language: type, spacing, density, and interaction states.
* Implement application shells, navigation, filters, tables, forms, and empty / error / loading states that hold up in daily use.
* Optimize performance: code\-splitting, list virtualization where needed, caching, and careful rendering.
* Ship responsive, accessible interfaces across common devices and browsers.



  





**Product UI \- Dashboards and Workflows** 



* Build complex operational UIs: dashboards, data\-heavy tables, charts, and interactive workflows.
* Implement map or location\-aware views when the product needs them, with clear legend, hover, and drill\-through behaviour.
* Build AI\-assisted surfaces when required (chat or assistant panels, streaming text, citations, structured actions) without sacrificing clarity.
* Ensure every view respects role\-based visibility: what a user can see and click must match their permissions.



  





**Design Responsibility** 



* Translate requirements and rough sketches into a coherent interface. Pixel\-perfect when a design exists; disciplined taste when it does not.
* Own visual consistency across the product. You are accountable for the look and feel, not only for “making it work”.
* Use industry\-standard UI tools (Figma or equivalent) to communicate proposals when that saves engineering time.
* Raise issues early when a workflow is confusing, overcrowded, or unsafe (for example, a destructive action without confirmation).



  





**APIs, Auth, and Working With the Rest of the Stack** 



* Integrate with REST APIs from Node or Python services. Handle pagination, errors, and stale data correctly.
* Work with session or JWT authentication and render the product differently by role without leaking privileged UI.
* Use TanStack Query (or equivalent) for server state and a small, explicit store for client state.
* Partner with backend engineers on contract changes. You should be able to read an OpenAPI spec or a FastAPI router and reason about it.
* Contribute to the last mile of deployment: environment\-specific configuration, build pipelines, and verifying the UI on staging and on\-premises installs.



  





**Engineering Quality** 



* Write maintainable TypeScript. Prefer explicit types and small components over large files.
* Participate in code review and keep the frontend testable (component tests and critical\-path E2E).
* Instrument the UI enough to debug production issues (meaningful errors, not silent empty screens).
* Travel occasionally to client or on\-premises locations in Hyderabad for UAT, go\-live support, or on\-site reviews.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's in Design, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–2\+ years of production frontend experience (more is welcome).
* Strong React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript.
* Confidence with CSS layout and a utility or design\-token approach (Tailwind or equivalent).
* Experience integrating authenticated APIs and handling real\-world data, not only mock JSON.
* A portfolio that shows visual judgement: spacing, hierarchy, and polish you personally shipped.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Hyderabad and to travel to client or on\-premises sites as required.



  





**Location, Work Mode, and Travel** 





 This is a full\-time, on\-site role in Hyderabad, India. You will work in person with the engineering team.
 





 Occasional travel is required. This includes travel to on\-premises deployment locations and travel to client sites in Hyderabad for implementation, go\-live, reviews, or production support. Travel is typically short\-duration and planned; willingness to travel within Hyderabad (and occasionally nearby) is a condition of the role.
 




  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive salary with a clear growth path.
* High\-ownership work: you will influence architecture, security, and how the product is shipped.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted products, enterprise\-grade access control, and real production deployments.
* Fast execution cycles and a culture that values demonstrated capability over credentials alone.
* Learning budget for courses and certifications.
* Collaborative in\-office engineering culture in Hyderabad.

title: Human Resources Lead
description:
**Note** 
 : This is an in\-office role based out of Mumbai, 6 days a week. An ideal candidate should have 4\-8 years of experience. Please apply if you meet the above criteria.
 



 HR Lead.
 



  





 Luma is building the future of fertility care in India — patient\-first, tech\-enabled, and unapologetically different from the clinical, impersonal experience that defines the category today. Backed by Peak XV, founded by a second\-time entrepreneur who has built and scaled before, Luma is past the idea stage and into the work of building a real organization around a real mission: better, more human healthcare for women, at scale.
 



 This role builds the people function from the ground up, inside a company trying to change what fertility care looks like in this country.
 



  





**What this role actually is** 




 Someone who can go from zero to one. You’ve built policy from nothing, set up payroll, made hiring work under real pressure. This is a hands\-on operator role — you do the work, not just direct others to do it. You’ll manage a small, growing team of your own.
 



 You’ll also design how the organization runs as it grows: clear roles, KRAs that mean something, a real sense of what good performance looks like at each level, and outcomes tied to the business as Luma expands into new clinics. Managing HR across a lean central team and a distributed, multi\-clinic footprint is core to this role, not an edge case.
 



  





**What you’ll own** 




     •    HR infrastructure — policy, process, and systems built from scratch
 



     •    Payroll and compliance, run cleanly and on time
 



     •    Hiring — sourcing, screening, and closing roles fast, across head office and clinical functions
 



     •    Organization design — role clarity, KRAs, and performance frameworks that hold up as the company scales across multiple clinics
 



     •    Training and learning calendars, including clinical staff training
 



     •    Employee engagement across a central team and a clinic floor with a different operating rhythm
 



     •    Onboarding and the day\-to\-day discipline that keeps a growing, multi\-location team functioning
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




 Real experience building HR inside an early\-stage, scaling startup, run lean and hands\-on. Healthcare, fertility care or clinic\-floor HR experience is a strong plus and will be prioritized.
 



  





**Why this role matters** 




 Fertility care in India has historically been clinical, transactional, and disempowering for the women going through it. Luma exists to change that — and the team you build, and the culture you set, will shape whether that mission is deliverable at scale. This is the chance to build the people foundation of a category\-defining, women\-led healthcare company early, not join one after the interesting decisions are already made.

title: SENIOR MANAGER – HUMAN RESOURCES  & PEOPLE OPERATIONS
description:
**Delhi NCR \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| 4–6 Years Experience**




 We are looking for a sharp, ambitious and highly dependable 
 **Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations** 
  to establish and run the core HR operating systems of our Delhi NCR headquarters.
 



 This is a broad, hands\-on management mandate covering 
 **recruitment, payroll management, employee lifecycle, HR systems, international personnel administration, work\-authorisation coordination, performance processes, HR compliance, employee records and management reporting** 
 .
 



 The person joining us will not simply inherit an existing HR desk. They will help build a disciplined and scalable People Operations function capable of supporting a growing Indian and international workforce.
   





 The Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations will be responsible for establishing and operating the 
 **Delhi HQ HR infrastructure** 
  and ensuring that employee administration is accurate, controlled, responsive and scalable.
 



 The role will include:
 


1. Establishing the core 
 **HR operating framework for the Delhi NCR headquarters** 
 , including HRIS, employee master data, personnel files, joining systems, attendance, leave, payroll controls, probation, performance\-cycle administration and separation processes.
2. Managing 
 **end\-to\-end payroll administration and payroll coordination** 
 , including monthly employee data, attendance and leave inputs, salary changes, approved deductions, reimbursements, variable\-pay inputs, new joiners, exits and payroll reconciliation.
3. Working with Finance, payroll vendors and management to ensure that payroll records reconcile with approved employment terms and employee master data.
4. Maintaining payroll calendars, change\-control records, salary/CTC documentation and payroll exception trackers.
5. Coordinating statutory and employee\-related payroll documentation with the appropriate Finance, Legal, payroll and professional advisers.
6. Managing end\-to\-end recruitment across multiple concurrent managerial, specialist, technical and administrative mandates.
7. Managing RPOs, recruitment agencies, LinkedIn, job portals, direct sourcing and referral channels.
8. Coordinating candidate assessment, interview scheduling, approvals, compensation discussions, offers and joining.
9. Managing BGV, references, pre\-employment documentation and controlled onboarding.
10. Creating and maintaining accurate employee records, organisation data, reporting relationships, designation/grade records and employment\-history documentation.
11. Managing attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, promotions, approved compensation changes, transfers and employee status changes.
12. Operationalising Board\- and management\-approved HR, workplace, travel, employee and administrative policies.
13. Maintaining policy acknowledgements, training evidence, compliance registers and HR audit documentation.
14. Supporting performance\-management administration, including 
 **30/60/90\-day reviews, probation reviews, confirmation documentation, performance records and management follow\-up** 
 .
15. Handling employee grievances, disciplinary documentation, difficult employee matters, resignations, handovers, separation processes and final\-clearance coordination.
16. Maintaining appropriate confidentiality and access controls for sensitive personnel and compensation data.
17. Coordinate 
 **international employee mobility** 
 , including visa/work\-authorisation, immigration, FRRO/FRO and renewal documentation through Legal/authorised advisers.
18. Maintain complete 
 **passport, visa, permit, registration and expiry controls** 
  for foreign personnel and international specialists.
19. Coordinate 
 **invitation letters, supporting documentation, relocation, accommodation and joining logistics** 
  for international employees.
20. Maintain an 
 **International Personnel \& Mobility Register** 
  covering status, expiries, pending actions and responsible owners.
21. Ensure required documentation and internal clearances are complete before international personnel commence regulated or approval\-dependent activities.
22. Support overseas deputation, travel and assignment documentation for Indian employees where required.
23. Establish and maintain the 
 **Delhi HQ HR operating system** 
 , including Employee Master, HRIS, recruitment pipeline, offers, BGV, joining, personnel files, attendance/leave and payroll controls.
24. Maintain 
 **compensation\-change, probation, confirmation, performance\-review, policy\-acknowledgement and training records** 
 .
25. Maintain 
 **grievance, disciplinary, separation, clearance, HR\-vendor and management\-MIS systems** 
 .
26. Own the 
 **HR\-side payroll process and reconciliation controls** 
  in coordination with Finance and authorised service providers.



  




 WHAT WE EXPECT IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS
 
 Within the first three months, the successful candidate should be able to demonstrate:
 


* a functioning Delhi HQ HR operating system;
* complete employee master and controlled personnel files;
* recruitment dashboard covering all approved vacancies;
* functioning HRIS or controlled interim HR database;
* reliable attendance and leave administration;
* documented monthly payroll process and reconciliation controls;
* BGV and onboarding tracker;
* probation and confirmation calendar;
* approved policy implementation and acknowledgement records;
* management HR dashboard;
* international personnel / visa / work\-authorisation tracker where applicable;
* HR vendor and recruiter controls;
* defined employee joining, lifecycle and separation workflows.


 THE PERSON WE WANT
 
 We are looking for somebody who can 
 **build systems and then operate them** 
 .
 



 A strong candidate will be equally comfortable interviewing a senior candidate in the morning, resolving a payroll discrepancy before lunch, checking the documentation of an international employee in the afternoon and preparing a concise management dashboard before the day ends.
 



 That breadth is intentional.
 



 The role suits an HR professional who wants genuine ownership and institutional\-building responsibility — not somebody looking for a narrowly defined recruitment, HRBP or employee\-engagement position.
 


 Particularly valuable experience
 
 Candidates who have previously helped establish a 
 **new corporate office, regional headquarters, business unit, plant, international office or rapidly expanding operation** 
  will be particularly relevant.
 



 Exposure to any combination of the following will be valuable:
 



***HRIS implementation • Payroll management • Multi\-agency recruitment • International employees • Employment visas / mobility administration • BGV • Employee lifecycle • HR compliance • Performance administration • Office mobilisation • Regulated or industrial environments***




 This addition makes the position substantially stronger. It now reads as the 
 **person responsible for establishing the Delhi HQ People Operations infrastructure** 
 , rather than simply a Senior HR recruitment manager.

title: Senior Manager, HR and Business Operations
description:
**Role: Senior Manager, HR and Business Operations** 




  





**Company:** 
 STEPS Talent Consulting Private Limited
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana
 



**Position Type:** 
 Full\-time · Remote, based in Delhi NCR
 



**Reports to:** 
 Director of India Operations, with direct work for the CEO (US)
 



**Manages:** 
 People \& Operations Specialist; the operations function as it grows
 



**Hours:** 
 India business hours with a fixed daily overlap into US morning hours (Arizona)
 



**Start:** 
 immediate
 



  





 STEPS Talent is an enterprise technology staffing company operating in the United States and India. We hire for the hardest roles in ERP, Cloud, Data and AI, Cybersecurity, and Engineering. Our India business runs its own client delivery alongside the work we do for clients in the US.
 



  





 We are looking for an operations leader to own HR and business operations for our India company, and the staffing back office behind our client delivery in both markets. You will set the processes, manage one direct report, and be accountable for compliance, payroll, invoicing and the monthly close being right and on time. You will have run this full cycle yourself, month after month, and you will know where it breaks.
 



  





**What you will own:** 




  





**People operations** 



* First point of contact for employees on all HR matters, handled confidentially and documented properly.
* HR policy and process: handbook, leave, probation and confirmation, performance documentation, exits.
* Indian statutory compliance: Provident Fund, Employees' State Insurance, Shops and Establishments, Professional Tax, Gratuity, POSH and the Maternity Benefit Act. You own the compliance calendar and manage the external firm that prepares and files.
* Onboarding and offboarding for employees and interns, the HRMS, attendance and the leave calendar.
* Managing and developing one direct report.



  





**Staffing operations** 



* Onboarding of billing consultants and contractors: agreements, background checks, work authorization documents and client portal registration.
* Consultant timesheets every cycle: collection, entry, tracking and follow\-up before gaps become billing problems.
* Placement records in the system of record, and communication with employer\-of\-record partners and vendors.



  





**Billing and India finance operations** 



* Client invoicing on each client's cycle, including through client portals, and receivables follow\-up.
* Accounts payable with TDS applied correctly.
* India payroll cycle and inputs.
* India books in Zoho Books, bank and card reconciliations, and the monthly close with our Chartered Accountant.
* Monthly intercompany invoicing under our services agreement, and the supporting documentation behind it.



  





**Required experience** 



* 8 to 12 years in HR operations and business operations.
* **Has run a full back office end to end** 
 : HR, compliance, payroll, invoicing, vendors and books, at a company of roughly 30 to 150 people. You will have done these yourself rather than managed people who did them. If each of these sat in a separate department where you have worked, this is likely not the right seat.
* At least 4 years running the back office of a staffing company serving US clients. Corporate HR alone does not qualify for this seat.
* At least 2 years managing a direct report whose work you were accountable for.
* Has personally run monthly payroll and month\-end close for an Indian entity, working directly with a Chartered Accountant.
* Has managed Provident Fund and Employees' State Insurance registrations and the monthly filing cycle.



  





**Required skills** 



* **Indian labor law, hands\-on:** 
 registrations, monthly and annual filings, inspections, notices and assessments, and which obligations are triggered by headcount, wage thresholds and worker classification.
* **TDS:** 
 deduction at the correct section and rate, deposit, quarterly returns and certificates.
* **US staffing back office:** 
 consultant timesheets, W2 and C2C consultants, client invoicing cycles, and client portals such as SAP Ariba or SAP Fieldglass.
* **Zoho, hands\-on.** 
 Zoho Books and Zoho People at a minimum, configured and used day to day rather than viewed. Zoho Recruit is an advantage.
* Written English that is plain and precise.
* Discretion with confidential information, and the confidence to say no when the process says no.
* **Based in Delhi NCR** 
 , or relocating there before you start. We work remotely, and this role includes in\-person work in Gurugram as needed, typically a few days a month, for banking, our Chartered Accountant and statutory matters. You schedule that yourself. Able to work a daily overlap with US morning hours (Arizona).



  





**Good to have** 



* QuickBooks, Tally, employer\-of\-record platforms, or operations across two related companies in different countries working under an intercompany services agreement.
* US HR basics: I\-9, the W\-2 and 1099 distinction, workers' compensation.



  





**What we offer** 



* A defined path to Associate Director at six months, measured against criteria agreed with you on day one, covering both the operations half of the job and the people half.
* Remote working, as the whole of our India team does.
* A direct working relationship with the founder and the India leadership team.
* Compensation matched to your experience.



  





**How to apply** 




 Apply on LinkedIn, or email your resume to Sunny.Patel@stepstalent.com with the subject line "Senior Manager, HR and Business Operations \- \[Your Name]".

**Job Description \& Summary**
 A career within Data and Analytics services will provide you with the opportunity to help organisations uncover enterprise insights and drive business results using smarter data analytics. We focus on a collection of organisational technology capabilities, including business intelligence, data management, and data assurance that help our clients drive innovation, growth, and change within their organisations in order to keep up with the changing nature of customers and technology. We make impactful decisions by mixing mind and machine to leverage data, understand and navigate risk, and help our clients gain a competitive edge.
   

  

 Creating business intelligence from data requires an understanding of the business, the data, and the technology used to store and analyse that data. Using our Rapid Business Intelligence Solutions, data visualisation and integrated reporting dashboards, we can deliver agile, highly interactive reporting and analytics that help our clients to more effectively run their business and understand what business questions can be answered and how to unlock the answers.
   

  

  

 Hiring Chartered Accountants
   

 Faster, better, and stronger finance functions significantly contribute to organization\-
   

 wide agility, results and effectiveness. Finance has been in the midst of a digital
   

 revolution coupled with new\-age operating models and capabilities. These value levers
   

 have increasingly led to bigger and more sustained outcomes from Finance
   

 Transformation. We believe these are irreversible trends in the medium term and
   

 finance teams must take advantage of this opportune time to transform. We work
   

 closely with finance leaders and draw on industry trends, insights, accelerators, and our
   

 body of work to reimagine their people, processes and technology with a clear roadmap
   

 of how value can be realised. We look well beyond the obvious and partner with clients
   

 to frame the potential value, levers and then help implement the roadmap in a credible
   

 way that builds confidence and buy\-in from all stakeholders. We work in small cross\-
   

 functional and efficient teams and run iterative sprints to enable incremental and rapid
   

 change delivering fast results.
   

 Managing business performance in today’s complex and rapidly changing business
   

 environment is crucial for any organization’s short\-term and long\-term success. But
   

 ensuring compliance with the continual changes to regulatory requirements, and the
   

 ability to plan and monitor performance against plans and budgets, is quite challenging.
   

 As part of the Technology Consulting –Data \& Analytics Practice, we leverage
   

 opportunities around digital disruption to deliver technology enabled transformation to
   

 our clients .
   

 Within the Technology Consulting practice, our FS D\&A competency \- Risk, Reg \&
   

 Finance Data team works on transformational engagements from strategy through
   

 execution, helping our clients solve business problems using Data \& Analytics
   

 technology as an enabler. Some of our key focus areas include:
   

  

  Ind AS 109 / IFRS9 implementation covering ECL, EIR
   

  Profitability analysis and Cost Management covering areas such as Activity
   

 based Costing, Segmental reporting, Dupont analysis, CFO digital playbook
   

  ALM \& FTP engine
   

  Regulatory and Risk Reporting Implementation \& Risk analytics
   

  Regulatory \& Risk Change Management (IRAC, BCBS, Exposure, NSFR, LCR,
   

 RWA, Risk based supervision)
   

  Global Markets Change Management
   

  Reconciliation Management \& Automation
   

  Pricing Analytics
   

 Roles and responsibilities
   

 The Consultant will be working for the Technology Consulting \- FS D\&A competency
   

 \- Risk, Reg \& Finance Data team of PwC India in a Business Analyst (BA) role. As a
   

 BA with PwC India, you will play a key client\-facing role in the engagement execution by
   

  

 working closely with client teams for defining business requirements, understanding
   

 regulatory \& financial needs \& helping the technology teams during solution
   

 implementation. You will be provided with varied responsibilities including client
   

 acquisition support, assisting in solution design, contributing to engagement execution
   

 as a team member and on\-ground client management. We also provide our BAs with
   

 opportunities to contribute to various thought leadership initiatives. Our BAs are
   

 excellent generalists and have a strong ability to work with managers with diverse
   

 backgrounds.
   

  

 Essential Skills:
   

  Understands Finance processes. Knowledge of other business functions will be
   

 an added advantage
   

  Basic problem solving skills with an ability to use data to draw business insights
   

  Excellent communication skills including proficiency in English language
   

  Proficiency in excel and power point
   

  Self\-disciplined and self \-motivated
   

  Strong team building, partnership and collaboration skills
   

  Ability to innovate, create lasting relationships and work independently with little
   

 supervision
   

 The role can be based out of any location where PwC India has its offices with preferred

title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable**
* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)
* Familiarity with project management or change management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, Prosci, Kotter)
* Familiarity with technology concepts such as workflow automation, system integration, APIs, and cloud\-based platforms
* Business analysis certification (e.g., BCS, IIBA/CBAP) or Agile/Scrum certification (CSM, CSPO) a plus
* Undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a leading institution, ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a field with role\-relevant transferable skills


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
