**Who We Are**
 Colgate\-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
   

  

 Join Colgate\-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.
   

  

**The Experience:**
 As an trainee in a Colgate IT organization, you are stepping onto a stage of innovation and large\-scale impact. The experience you'll gain is multifaceted, designed to be immersive, and will provide a realistic preview of what a full\-time role in such a company entails.
   

  

 Our highly technical and innovative team is dedicated to driving growth for Colgate Palmolive in this constantly evolving landscape.
   

  

**What role will you play as a member of the Colgate’s Information Technology team?**
 In this company as a global product\-based IT organization, you would not just play a single, generic role. Instead, you are typically assigned to a specific team and your role is to contribute as a junior member of that team, learning the ropes while delivering tangible value. You are part of an engineering team responsible for building and maintaining a specific product or service.
   

  

**Who Are You…**
**You are a function expert \-**
 As a functional expert your development will be focused on becoming a bridge between the product and the real\-world problems it solves for customers.
   

  

 A functional expert's value comes from understanding the "why" behind a customer's request. You will develop expertise in a specific business vertical or domain that the product serves.
   

  

**You connect the dots \-**
* Connecting User Problems to Product Features
* Connecting Technical Decisions to Business Impact
* Connecting Different Modules of the System
* Connecting Your Daily Task to the Company's Strategic Goals


**What You’ll Need…(Required)**
* Learning Agility \- This is arguably the most important skill of all. A passionate desire and ability to learn new technologies, processes, and concepts quickly.
* Accountability \& Professionalism: Taking complete ownership of your work, meeting your commitments, and demonstrating a strong, positive work ethic.
* Bachelor's degree required
* Programming Fundamentals : A solid grasp of at least one relevant programming language (Python is a versatile choice) and basic web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
* Knowledge of React, Node, APIs, and cloud technologies.
* Cybersecurity Awareness
* Well versed with AI Tools
* Strong documentation skills for crafting comprehensive documentation to facilitate knowledge sharing and adherence to industry standards.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.


**What you’ll need…(Preferred):**
**You are a collaborator \-**
* Through Immersion in the Team's Core Rhythm (Agile Processes) \- Daily Stand\-ups , Sprint Planning , Retrospectives
* Through Hands\-On Technical and Project Collaboration
* Through Cross\-Functional Interactions \- Working with QA (Quality Assurance) , Product Managers / Developers
* Through Mastering the Tools of Collaboration \- Google Suite / Jira / Git


**You are an innovator \-**
* By Leveraging your "Fresh Eyes" Advantage \- This is a trainee's single greatest innovative asset. You are not constrained by the phrase "we've always done it this way."
* Through Automation of Repetitive Work (Practical Innovation)
* Through Experimentation in a Safe Environment
* Data Analytics \& Databases: Strong proficiency in SQL is non\-negotiable. Familiarity with a scripting language like Python for data manipulation and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI) is highly valuable
* Curiosity \& a Questioning Mindset: Not just accepting things as they are, but asking "why?" to uncover opportunities for improvement
* A Bias for Action: A proactive drive to automate manual processes, build small prototypes to test ideas, and solve problems without waiting to be told exactly what to do.


**Our Commitment to Inclusion**
 Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Colgate is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status (United States positions), or any other characteristic protected by law.

* Working shift must be aligned to overlap with Pacific working hours

* Service owners and their teams

* Customer service teams

title: UI/UX Design Intern | Entry Level | Fresher | Figma, Wireframing, Prototyping, User Research | Remote
description:
UI/UX Design Intern \| Entry Level \| Fresher \| Figma, Wireframing, Prototyping, User Research \| Remote
 



  





 Company: Crossing Infotech
 



 Job Type: Full\-time Internship
 



 Work Mode: Virtual / Remote
 



 Location: India
 



 Internship Duration: 1–3 months
 



 Stipend: ₹16,500/month
 



 Application Deadline: 20 September 2026
 



  





 About the opportunity
 



  





 Crossing Infotech is offering a UI/UX Design Internship for freshers and entry\-level candidates interested in user interface design, user experience, wireframing, prototyping, design systems, and digital product design.
 



  





 This internship provides practical exposure to the UI/UX design process through user research, information architecture, wireframes, interactive prototypes, interface design, usability reviews, and design documentation under appropriate guidance.
 



  





 Key responsibilities
 



  





 • Assist in designing user interfaces for websites and digital applications.
 



 • Create wireframes and low\-fidelity design concepts.
 



 • Develop high\-fidelity UI designs using Figma or similar design tools.
 



 • Create interactive prototypes to demonstrate user flows.
 



 • Assist with user research and understanding user requirements.
 



 • Develop user flows and basic information architecture.
 



 • Apply design principles related to layout, typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
 



 • Ensure designs are consistent across different screens and devices.
 



 • Participate in usability reviews and incorporate design feedback.
 



 • Collaborate with developers to communicate design requirements.
 



 • Maintain design files, components, and project documentation.
 



 • Assist in creating and maintaining basic design systems.
 



 • Review existing interfaces and identify possible usability improvements.
 



 • Conduct basic competitor and design research.
 



 • Follow established brand and visual\-design guidelines.
 



  





 Who can apply
 



  





 • Freshers and recent graduates.
 



 • Candidates pursuing or having completed a degree or diploma in Design, UI/UX, Computer Science, IT, Fine Arts, Visual Communication, or related fields.
 



 • Candidates interested in UI/UX and digital product design.
 



 • Candidates with academic, personal, or portfolio design projects.
 



 • Candidates who can demonstrate basic design work through a portfolio are preferred.
 



  





 Required skills
 



  





 • Basic knowledge of UI/UX design principles.
 



 • Familiarity with Figma or similar design tools.
 



 • Understanding of wireframes and prototypes.
 



 • Good understanding of typography, spacing, alignment, and visual hierarchy.
 



 • Basic knowledge of user flows.
 



 • Strong attention to detail.
 



 • Ability to understand user requirements.
 



 • Good communication and collaboration skills.
 



 • Willingness to learn and accept design feedback.
 



  





 Preferred skills
 



  





 • Experience with Figma components and auto layout.
 



 • Basic understanding of responsive design.
 



 • Familiarity with design systems.
 



 • Knowledge of usability and user\-research fundamentals.
 



 • Basic understanding of accessibility in digital design.
 



 • Familiarity with Adobe XD, Sketch, Photoshop, or similar tools.
 



 • Experience designing websites or mobile applications.
 



 • Academic or personal UI/UX portfolio.
 



  





 What you will learn
 



  





 • Complete UI/UX design workflows.
 



 • User research and requirement understanding.
 



 • Wireframing and user\-flow creation.
 



 • High\-fidelity interface design.
 



 • Interactive prototyping using Figma.
 



 • Responsive and accessible design fundamentals.
 



 • Design systems and reusable components.
 



 • Usability testing and design iteration.
 



 • Collaboration between designers and developers.
 



  





 Ideal candidate profile
 



  





 We are looking for candidates who are:
 



  





 • Interested in building a career in UI/UX or product design.
 



 • Creative while also being comfortable with structured problem\-solving.
 



 • Curious about understanding user needs and behavior.
 



 • Detail\-oriented when working on visual interfaces.
 



 • Open to feedback and continuous design improvement.
 



 • Interested in creating practical digital\-product designs.
 



 • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
 



  





 Why join Crossing Infotech?
 



  





 • Remote internship opportunity.
 



 • Practical exposure to UI/UX and digital\-product design projects.
 



 • Opportunity to strengthen Figma and prototyping skills.
 



 • Experience with real\-world design workflows and developer collaboration.
 



 • Project\-based learning suitable for freshers.
 



 • Opportunity to build a practical UI/UX portfolio.
 



  





 Application deadline: 20 September 2026
 



  





 If you are a fresher interested in UI/UX design, Figma, wireframing, and digital products, this internship provides an opportunity to develop practical design skills through structured projects and supervised design activities.

title: Experience Designer -Senior Associate
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS MENA People Consulting Design Theatre: Experience Designer / Senior Associate**
**The opportunity**
 We are looking for an Experience Designer for EY MENA People Consulting Design Theatre team, in our Trivandrum/Kochi office.
   

  

 Design Theatre is about people and business outcomes. We design immersive programs that bring the right people together, giving them the mindset and collaborative tools to think differently. These days we are doing this both virtually and in\-person for clients around the world.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Design and produce digital content and branded materials that support interactive sessions
* Working with the Experience Leader/Manager, define strategy and design for customer experience, working closely with the Experience team to devise strategic solutions based on multiple forms and research and analysis
* Support clients in the use of collaboration software being used in the client experience
* Offer ideas on how to approach client challenges including industry trends and user experience
* Communicate complex technical concepts simply and effectively to all audiences using sketches, storytelling, mood boards/storyboards, wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and/or data visualizations
* Take a collaborative approach to work, with motivation to develop your skills by taking ownership of new challenges and have a genuine interest in solving complex business problems
* Help lead workshops with clients to understand needs, articulate vision, and support design strategies and experiences that meet their vision and needs


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and various collaboration software including Mural, Miro, white board etc.
* Skills to Visualize, draw, create meaningful documents, presentations etc.
* Experience with photography and video production
* Ability to live\-scribe / sketchnote
* Understanding of design thinking approach and working on agile teams


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Advanced degree preferred, 7\+ years professional experience in User Experience Design/ Product Design, or Visual Design.
* Past experience in consulting, CX Practice in a Fortune 500 firm, or agency in a media management or digital creative experience in a client facing role.
* Cross\-functional experience working with both internal and 3rd party development teams and project management experience working with both creative agencies, brands or in a consulting capacity. Experience interfacing with clients and Rich Media Vendors.
* Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, Axure, Mural, InVision, Keynote, OmniGraffle, Sketch or other design technologies.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Graphic Designer & Video editor
description:
**About the role** 




  






 Unique World Robotics (UWR) is seeking a creative and detail\-oriented
 

 Graphic Designer \& Video Editor
 

 to join our team. This role is ideal for freshers or candidates with up to 1 year of experience who have a strong passion for visual design and branding \& Video Editing. The primary responsibility of this role is to create high\-quality, engaging graphic content for digital platforms while ensuring consistency with brand guidelines.
 




  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \* Design creative content for social media, digital advertisements, and marketing campaigns
 



 \* Create banners, posters, brochures, presentations, and other promotional materials
 



 \* Edit short\-form and long\-form videos for social media, campaigns, events, and marketing activities
 



 \* Create engaging Reels, Stories, YouTube Shorts, and other video content
 



 \* Ensure consistency in brand identity across all visual and video content
 



 \* Collaborate with the marketing team to understand requirements and deliver creative outputs on time
 



 \* Revise and optimize designs and videos based on feedback
 



 \* Organize and maintain design assets, project files, and brand resources
 



 \* Stay updated with the latest design, video editing, social media, and AI tools
 



  





 Key Requirements
 



  





 \* Basic to intermediate proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator
 



 \* Proficiency in at least one video editing tool such as Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar
 



 \* Good understanding of design fundamentals, including color theory, typography, composition, and layout
 



 \* Creative thinking with strong attention to detail
 



 \* Ability to follow brand guidelines and maintain visual consistency
 



 \* Good understanding of social media content formats and trends
 



 \* Ability to manage multiple creative tasks and meet deadlines
 



 \* Good communication and teamwork skills
 



 \* Willingness to learn, adapt, and grow in a fast\-paced environment
 



  





 Preferred Qualifications / Added Advantages
 



  





 \* Basic knowledge of motion graphics and animation
 



 \* Experience creating Reels, Stories, YouTube Shorts, and promotional videos
 



 \* Basic knowledge of camera handling, framing, lighting, and shooting techniques
 



 \* Experience with DSLR, mirrorless, or professional video cameras is an added advantage
 



 \* Basic understanding of video production and content shooting
 



 \* Familiarity with AI tools for design, video editing, and content creation
 



 \* Experience working on social media campaigns or digital marketing projects
 



 \* Portfolio showcasing graphic design and video editing work, including academic, personal, freelance, or professional projects
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  





 A creative and versatile Graphic Designer \& Video Editor who can work across both static and video content, collaborate with the marketing team, and contribute to creating engaging digital content for our brand.

title: Associate STEM Content Analyst - Chemistry Patent Abstraction
description:
**Associate STEM Content Analyst \- CPI**
 We are looking for an Associate STEM Content Analyst to join our Abstraction team (IP Operations) in Chennai. This is an amazing opportunity to work on Derwent products. The team consists of 100 plus colleagues. We have a great skill set in Life sciences and Engineers; we would love to speak with you if you have skills in comprehensive knowledge in the respective technology domain.
   

  

**About You**
* Should be a graduate in MSc Chemistry (General, Organic, Inorganic, Physical \& Analytical, MSc Polymer Science) with good understanding of patents, ideally from Noida location.
* Can be a fresher (preferred) or a talent with one year of experience in content abstraction or editing.
* Must have strong domain knowledge in chemistry and related technology fields.


**It will be great if you also had…..**
* Certification in typing
* Extensive knowledge about patents and drafting
* Great English comprehension skills


**What will you be doing in this role?**
* Prepare abstract for patents in accordance with set rules defined in DWPI Abstracting policy document.
* Perform detailed analysis of patents to provide accurate and editorially enhanced technical information of the patents in the form of summary that includes descriptive title, uses, novel features, advantages, and other key information related to the invention.
* You will be capturing useful insights from the patent data to generate editorially enhanced technical summary of patent records.
* To perform the above functions you will be using Clarivate specific tools for content editing, abstraction and curation.


**About The Team**
 Abstraction Team in IP Operations is responsible for the enrichment and curation of high\-quality content sets, while adhering to individual and team goals, production targets, and defined quality standards. We analyze patents to create and deliver value\-added content that enhances the research value to Patent Intelligence products and customers of Clarivate.
   

  

**Hours of Work (Permanent role)**
 Full\-time – 9 am to 6 pm IST and some colleagues work from the rest of the world (UK, USA)
   

  

 At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non\-discrimination in all locations.

title: Architectural Writer
description:
BAM is looking for people who are genuinely curious about
 **architecture, design, media and the people behind them** 
 .
 



  





 We'd like to meet you if you are the kind of person who notices:
 


* Who designed a project.
* Where it was published.
* Who wrote about it.
* Which editor might care about it.
* Which studios are doing interesting work.
* What awards are opening.
* What conversations are happening in architecture.
* And how all of these people could be better connected.



  





 At BAM, you could eventually work across one of four areas:
 



**Studio Relations** 
 — discovering architecture practices, speaking with studios, helping them join BAM and making BAM part of how they share their projects with the media.
 



**Media \& Publications** 
 — building relationships with editors, journalists and publications around the world and developing BAM's intelligence about how architecture media works.
 



**Awards \& Events** 
 — following architecture awards, competitions, exhibitions, festivals and events globally, building relationships with organisers and helping build ArchAwards and ArchEvents.
 



**Brand \& Content** 
 — writing, researching and creating content that helps architects understand media, PR, visibility and BAM.
 



  





  





 What you'll actually spend your time doing
 



 Researching projects, studios, publications, editors, awards and events. Writing emails, short editorial copy and content. Speaking to architects, editors and industry professionals. Building relationships and following them up properly. Maintaining information that becomes useful intelligence for the whole BAM team. Looking at how people use BAM and suggesting ways the platform can work better.
 



  





 Some days you may be researching an architecture practice in Portugal. Another day you may be speaking with an editor in London, studying an awards programme in Japan or helping shape a BAM feature.
 



  





  





 We care much more about how you think than your CV.
 



 You may be a fresher or have around
 **1 year of experience** 
 in areas such as writing, architecture journalism, editorial, media, content, communications or research.
 



 What matters more:
 


* You genuinely enjoy architecture and design.
* You write clearly and naturally.
* You are comfortable starting conversations with people you don't know.
* You are curious and research deeply rather than stopping at the first Google result.
* You remember people and relationships.
* You follow up.
* You can think strategically about why one person should know another.
* You are organised enough to maintain information properly.
* You notice what others miss.
* You have opinions and ideas about how products and workflows could improve.



 Being naturally outgoing helps. But we're not looking for someone who simply talks a lot; we want someone who can
 **make people comfortable, understand what matters to them and build relationships that last.** 




  





  





 You may fit especially well if…
 



 You read architecture publications voluntarily.
 



 You follow architecture studios on Instagram.
 



 You know—or want to know—the difference between ArchDaily, Dezeen, Domus, Wallpaper\*, Architectural Digest and smaller independent publications.
 



 You enjoy interviews, podcasts and writing.
 



 You find yourself saving interesting projects, articles, studios, awards or events.
 



 You would enjoy knowing
 **what is happening across architecture before everyone else does.** 




  





  





 About BAM
 



 BAM — Bureau of Architecture Media — is building an infrastructure connecting architecture and design studios with media, publishing opportunities, awards and industry visibility.
 



 We are building BAM alongside platforms including
 **ArchAwards** 
 and
 **ArchEvents** 
 , with more industry intelligence products to come.
 



  





 This isn't a narrowly defined role.
 



  





 We will meet strong candidates first and decide where their strengths belong—
 **Studio Relations, Media \& Publications, Awards \& Events, or Brand \& Content.** 




  





 Interested? We’re not looking for a polished cover letter. We want to understand how you think, what you notice, and how naturally you engage with architecture, media and people.
 



  





 Write to yuvaraj@bampr.co

title: Associate- Enterprise Technology CoE (ET)
description:
**ABOUT US:**





 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
 





 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services. 
 





**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:** 






 This role is based in the Enterprise Technology Center of Excellence (ET CoE), part of Bain’s broader “Data \& Technology” umbrella within the BCN. The Enterprise Technology CoE provides specialized support on Tech Strategy, Transformation, and Roadmap projects for Bain clients across industries. The ET CoE team acts as the analytical and delivery arm of Bain’s ET Practice, providing expertise in:
 



* Building and deploying Enterprise Technology diagnostics
* Delivering core technology products for consulting teams
* Working directly with clients to support technology transformations
* Integrating new and emerging technologies such as AI and automation into diagnostics




  
 





**WHAT YOU’LL DO:** 





 Work closely with team leads to build and deploy ET diagnostic tools and contribute actively to IP development 
 
* Quick ramp up ability. Identify and employ relevant research sources and analytical tools
* Ensure timely, high quality, zero\-defect research, analysis and output produced by the analysts
* Understand client needs and situations and adapt to case expectations
* Generate and screen realistic answers based on sound reality checks and recommend actionable solutions
* Learn how to make businesses more valuable and responsible for generating specific industry or company insights, to support global Bain case teams, client development teams and industry practices

* Understand client needs and situations and adapt to case expectations
* Communicate data, knowledge and insight to the entire team. Generate and screen realistic solutions based on sound reality checks and recommend actionable solutions
* Deliver clear and professional presentations to the team/team leaders/managers

**ABOUT YOU:** 




* Candidates should be graduates / post\-graduates with strong academic record
* Work experience range in case highest qualification is undergraduate studies – 2\-5 years of relevant experience in a professional services context
* Work experience range in case highest qualification is postgraduate studies – 0\-3 years of relevant experience in a professional services context

* You’ll help design and deploy scalable technology solutions, leverage advanced LLMs like ChatGPT, and implement autonomous agents to drive measurable business value
* Knowledge of using and deploying automation in Digital transformation projects to improve efficiency. Knowledge of advanced GenAI is a plus
* Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, Alteryx and Tableau \& languages such as python, SQL is required
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure







  




**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK:** 






 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

description:
**About the Company** 




 The role is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and enhancing applications for First American. These applications are typically web\-based and are developed in accordance with established coding standards and guidelines using a continuous Build\-Integrate\-Test approach within an Agile environment.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




 Software Engineer II — Full Stack
 



 Location: Remote
 



**Role overview** 




  





 The Software Engineer II will work closely with the Engineering Manager, Architect, Product Manager and team to understand both stated and unstated needs and translate complex functional requirements into clear system requirements. The Software Engineer II will use a strong understanding of the business domain and software development practices to improve the functionality, performance, reliability, and maintainability of software applications.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Contribute across the full software development lifecycle—from requirements through design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of web\-based applications.
* Develop a sound understanding of the business, product, and domain; use that knowledge to recommend functional improvements and enhancements.
* Translate functional and business requirements into technical and system requirements; identify technical blind spots and clarify ambiguity in ideas and designs.
* Work with the Engineering Manager, Architect, and Product Manager to align on team goals; prioritize effectively and propose scope adjustments when necessary.
* Take ownership of assigned modules and independently develop features; act with urgency to deliver high\-quality work that adds value to the business and stakeholders.
* Create basic project plans for small projects and development initiatives.
* Follow organizational coding standards, development guidelines, quality assurance standards, and configuration management practices.
* Actively participate in code reviews, providing meaningful feedback; improve team processes, code, and work items.
* Design and develop basic database solutions; create and maintain database objects and support database performance tuning.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and address application performance bottlenecks; respond urgently to operational issues and own resolution within assigned scope.
* Develop an understanding of production infrastructure, application interfaces, integrations, and product dependencies.
* Participate in core team and Agile ceremonies; question the status quo and recommend practical improvements to team processes.
* Build relationships across teams and communicate requirements with partner groups to achieve positive outcomes.
* Ask questions, learn from others, receive feedback humbly, and seek help or decision support when needed.



  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





  




* Understands and meets the stated needs and requirements of stakeholders.
* Considers contextual and business nuances while delivering solutions and works as a trusted partner to stakeholders.
* Understands the importance of delivering work within agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards and raises concerns when deviations occur.
* Takes initiative to develop technical and behavioral skills.
* Reflects on and learns from personal experiences and the experiences of others.
* Is receptive to new ideas and different perspectives.
* Questions inefficient routines and procedures and suggests practical improvements.
* Adapts effectively to different cultures and unfamiliar situations.
* Thinks quickly and demonstrates urgency in completing deliverables.
* Encourages teamwork and collaboration by promoting openness and constructive dialogue.
* Works with focus to achieve assigned goals and targets.
* Seeks regular feedback and recommends ways to improve the efficiency and quality of work.
* Breaks complex problems into smaller components, evaluates available information, and selects an appropriate course of action.
* Demonstrates excellent verbal, written, interpersonal, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Has hands\-on experience using AI tools (cursor/ claude/ pi) and agentic coding assistants to support development, testing, and problem\-solving.



  





  





**Technical skills** 




  





 An ideal candidate should have knowledge of and hands\-on experience with the following technologies:
 



  




* Microsoft technologies: C\# (.NET Core, .NET Framework), TypeScript, NestJS, and Node.js
* Microservices and event\-driven architecture using Apache Kafka or other event processing services
* Modern UI frameworks: React.js or Angular
* Cloud platforms (AWS preferred): EC2, S3, Lambda, EFS, ECS, EKS, API Gateway, SQS, IAM, VPC
* Relational databases (MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, DocumentDB)
* Docker and Kubernetes
* CI/CD tools: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, YAML, PowerShell
* Observability tools: Splunk, ELK Stack, DataDog
* Testing strategies: Unit Testing, Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD), Test\-Driven Development (TDD)
* Git\-based source\-code management
* Jira and Agile/Scrum practices

description:

 Established in 1833, McKesson is a US Fortune 10 global leader in healthcare supply chain management solutions, retail pharmacy, healthcare technology, community oncology, and specialty care. We partner with life sciences companies, manufacturers, providers, pharmacies, governments, and other healthcare organizations to help provide the right medicines, medical products, and healthcare services to the right patients at the right time, safely and cost effectively.
   

  

 Based in Bangalore India, McKesson Compile’s data is a comprehensive, full linked system of record for the US Healthcare market, with intelligence on 2M\+ healthcare professionals (HCPs) and over 800K facilities. Compile’s data includes high capture medical and pharmacy claims, closed capture Medicare claims (100%), along with best\-in\-class provider affiliations and customer master.
   

  

 At McKesson we deliver careers with purpose and potential. Our focus on better health starts with creating an inclusive environment with strong values where you can build a fulfilling career. You can count on us to provide you with resources and opportunities to grow and be your best, while contributing to our pursuit of improving lives.
   

  

**Software Engineer – Full Stack (Java, Spring Boot, React)**
**Location:** 
 Bangaluru, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
   

  

**Domain:** 
 Healthcare Technology (Oncology / Clinical Platforms)
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Full Stack Software Engineer** 
 to design, build, and operate scalable, mission\-critical healthcare applications.
   

  

 This is a
 **backend\-first full\-stack role (:70% backend / 30% frontend)** 
 where you will primarily work on
 **Java \+ Spring Boot microservices** 
 , while contributing to
 **React\-based UI layers** 
 to deliver complete end\-to\-end features.
   

  

 You will also operate in an
 **AI\-first engineering environment** 
 , where tools like
 **GitHub Copilot and Windsurf, Claude** 
 are used to accelerate development — with a strong expectation that
 **you validate, refine, and productionize outputs to meet the security by design with enterprise\-grade standards**

**Key Responsibilities**
**Full Stack Development**

* Define clear API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger) with consistent error handling and versioning
* Implement event\-driven architectures using Kafka or equivalent messaging systems
* Build high\-performance data access layers using JPA/Hibernate and Oracle/Postgres
* Develop and enhance UI components using React.js and TypeScript
* Build integration layers and admin UIs to support backend workflows
* Ensure end\-to\-end flow validation (UI → API → DB → events)

* Accelerate coding, refactoring, and test generation
* Improve developer productivity without compromising maintainability
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated code for:
* Correctness and edge cases
* Security and data handling risks
* Performance and scalability
* Apply AI responsibly in:
* Code generation, debugging, and clear documentation
* Unit Test case creation and coverage improvement
* Design systems that are:
* AI\-friendly (clear APIs, structured data, consistent contracts)
* Observable and diagnosable using logs, metrics, and traces
* Security by design


**Engineering Quality \& Delivery**
* Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code (unit \+ integration tests)
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and architecture decisions
* Work in Agile teams with strong accountability \& ownership of delivery
* Diagnose and resolve production issues using observability tools, such as Dynatrace


**Platform \& System Thinking**
* Build services that are:
* Reusable
* Well\-documented
* Easy for other products to integrate
* Follow best practices in:
* API design
* Microservices architecture
* CI/CD and DevOps pipelines


**Minimum Requirement**
 Degree or equivalent relevant experience.
   

  

**Must\-Have Skills**
* 2–5 years of software development experience in product/enterprise environments
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Java (17\+) and Spring Boot
* REST API design and microservices architecture
* Experience with React.js \+ TypeScript (at least 1\-2 years)
* Solid experience with:
* SQL and relational databases (Oracle/Postgres)
* ORM tools (Hibernate/JPA)
* Experience with:
* Event\-driven systems (Kafka or similar)
* Caching (Redis or similar)
* CI/CD pipelines and Git\-based workflows
* Automated testing practices
* Strong debugging and production issue analysis skills

* Practical use of AI coding assistants in development workflow
* Ability to review, validate, and production\-harden AI\-generated code
* Understanding that:
* AI accelerates development
* Engineers are still accountable for design, correctness, and quality


 If someone blindly copies Copilot output, this role is

 .
   

  

**Foundational**

* Familiarity with:
* FHIR / HL7 / C\-CDA standards

* Databricks / data pipelines

* Improve team productivity using AI without degrading quality

title: Software Engineer, Portfolio Management Group, Analyst
description:
**About This Role**
**About Global Fixed Income Team**
 BlackRock’s active fixed income portfolio strategies stretch across a range of investment styles and segments of the fixed income universe. The breadth and depth of our platform puts us in a strong position to potentially deliver attractive returns in various market environments. With a focus on alpha generation and risk management, the team uses a top\-down view from lead portfolio managers and bottom\-up expertise from our sector specialists
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking to hire a an Analyst\-level Software Engineer who understands the software development lifecycle very well. The individual The individual will design, develop, test, and maintain backend\-focused software applications, APIs, data workflows, and analytical tools. The role will also involve working closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain software components in line with functional and technical requirements
* Develop backend services, APIs, data\-processing workflows, and automation solutions using Python.
* Contribute to full\-stack applications, with a primary focus on backend development and limited front\-end development.
* Work with structured and unstructured data to support analytics, reporting, and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, document use cases, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Investigate technical and data\-related issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and recommend scalable solutions.
* Support automation efforts by contributing to test scripts and reusable validation frameworks where applicable
* Monitor application behaviour, analyse root causes of issues, and recommend improvements to quality and reliability
* Use tools such as Git and defect tracking platforms to support collaborative delivery and testing processes


**Required Skills**
**Core Technical Skills**
* Strong programming fundamentals and hands\-on experience with Python and SQL are required.
* Knowledge of React/Java is a good to have.
* Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and software testing lifecycle (STLC)
* Knowledge of manual testing, defect tracking, and test case design
* Familiarity with test automation concepts and tools such as Selenium or similar frameworks
* Experience with version control systems and collaborative development workflows
* Awareness of API testing, integration testing concepts, and quality assurance best practices
* Understanding of REST APIs, databases, data pipelines, and application integration.
* Basic knowledge of React, JavaScript, TypeScript, or another front\-end technology is beneficial.
* Familiarity with data analysis, AI, machine learning, or generative AI concepts is beneficial.


**Education \& Qualifications**
* 1\-3 years of relevant work experience


**Problem\-Solving**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including root\-cause analysis.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: ASIC Digital Engineer (SOC Validation) with 3 to 5 years of experience
description:
**Company Description**
 Sandiskunderstands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.

These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthousesforbreakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world movingforward.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a SoC Validation/Verification Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our SoC designs. You will be responsible for:
   

  

* Understanding complex ASIC specifications to create comprehensive Verification/Validation plans for both pre\- and post\-silicon validation.
* Independently developing and executing tests for verification and validation.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to drive closure of verification and validation activities.
* Signing off on verification and validation deliverables.
* Debugging and root cause analysis of issues found during validation.
* Developing and maintaining automated test environments and regression suites.
* Contributing to the continuous improvement of verification methodologies and best practices.


 Your work will enable industry\-leading data storage control SoCs that are deployed in high\-volume consumer and enterprise products.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 At SanDisk, you’ll be part of a team of highly skilled engineers solving complex verification challenges and driving innovation in data storage solutions. Your work will directly impact the performance and reliability of next\-generation data solutions for both consumer and enterprise markets.
   

  

 Together, we’ll push the boundaries of technology, unlock the full potential of data, and shape the future of storage solutions.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications:**
**Required**
* BE or MS degreein Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering, with 4\-6years of experiencein SoC pre\-/post\-silicon verification and validation, and bring\-up.
* Deep understanding of C, embedded programming, and hardware/software co\-validation methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of SoC verification environments, SystemVerilog (SV), and UVM concepts.
* Proven history of developing and executing verification and validation strategies for complex SoCs.


**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Ownership:End\-to\-end ownership of one or more subsystems or SoC verification and validation flows, including planning, execution, and closure.
* Protocol Expertise:Experience in verification and validation of industry\-standard protocols such as DDR, PCIe, LPDDR, USB, Ethernet, I²C, I3C, SPI, AXI, AHB, and APB.
* Emulation Experience:Run complex SoC verification and validation scenarios on Palladium/Emulation platforms to accelerate debug and improve pre\-silicon coverage.
* Testbench Proficiency:Must understand and contribute to complex SoC\-level testbenches, including UVM, C, and SystemVerilog components.
* Simulation \& Debug:Execute verification and validation cases in simulation environments and perform initial debug and root cause analysis.
* Pre\-/Post\-Silicon Validation:Strong experience in bring\-up, including board initialization, power\-on sequences, processor boot, and system\-level debug for both pre\- and post\-silicon phases.
* Datapath Validation:Ability to understand and validate complex datapath flows of the controller, create datapath scenarios in SoC verification environments, and port them across pre\-silicon and post\-silicon environments.
* Post\-Silicon Experience:Hands\-on experience in post\-silicon ASIC bring\-up, validation, and debug.
* Firmware \& HAL Development:Develop firmware, bare\-metal tests, and Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) code to enable datapath, integration, and SoC\-level validation and verification.
* LanguageProficiency:Should have a very good understanding of C, Python, or Perl scripting languages for test automation, data analysis, and tool development
* Validation Infrastructure:Build and maintain validation infrastructure, including test content, regression automation, and lab equipment integration (oscilloscopes, analyzers, logic probes).
* Debug Expertise:Proficiency in debugging SoC issues across multiple domains (digital logic, firmware, timing, low\-power, DFT) using JTAG, trace, waveform capture, and performance counters.
* Power \& GLS Validation:Run and debug gate\-level simulations, power\-aware (UPF/CPF) validation, and validate ATE functional patterns.
* Performance \& Stress Testing:Validate and verify performance bottlenecks, traffic generation, and corner\-case stress scenarios at the SoC level.
* Verification Methodology:Apply advanced verification methodologies, including constrained\-random, coverage\-driven, and assertion\-based verification to ensure design quality and completeness.


**Additional Information**
 Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.

title: Game Designer
description:
We’re looking for a sharp, highly driven game designer who knows mobile free\-to\-play games inside out and is genuinely excited about building AI games. If you can take an idea from a rough prototype to a live game players love, we want to talk.
 



  





**Our mission:** 




 We want to build the first globally competitive games studio out of India, one that can go head to head with Timi/Tencent, Supercell, and Activision Blizzard.
 



 Greatness, for us, means taking on hard problems and refusing to settle. We care about it in the games we ship, and even more in the people and the company we’re building. We’re not there yet. We’re looking for someone exceptional to help us get there.
 



  





**Role \& key responsibilities:** 




 Veteran or up\-and\-comer. What we care about is your skill, your drive, and how much you love games.
 


* **Design for mobile free\-to\-play.** 
 Own gameplay, core loops, progression, and metagame for our mobile F2P games, across midcore, RPG, roguelike, and whatever genre fits the idea. Build systems that hook players in the first session and keep them coming back for months: retention, economy, and a session flow that feels right on a phone.
* **Take games from idea to live.** 
 Prototype fast, test, ship. You’ll be hands\-on across the whole arc, from early prototype through soft launch and into live operation, and you’ll drive the game from concept to live, not just individual features.
* **Build with AI by default.** 
 Use AI as a core part of how you work, not a bolt\-on. Prototype mechanics, generate and test content, and tighten your iteration loop with it. And because we build AI games, you’ll help design experiences that only work
 *because* 
 AI sits at the center of them. We expect you to stay ahead of what these tools can do.
* **Design documentation.** 
 Write clear specs and feature docs that tell the team exactly how a mechanic, system, control, or piece of content should work.
* **Quality \& polish.** 
 Hold the quality bar. Work closely with engineers and artists so every feature and asset feels great in players’ hands.
* **Market analysis.** 
 Study the top mobile F2P games across genres. Pull apart what makes them work, from monetization to live\-ops to feature design, and turn that into sharp breakdowns that feed our own decisions.
* **Playtesting \& feedback.** 
 Run internal and external playtests. Gather feedback and gameplay data, read what players are actually telling you, and iterate.



  





**What we’re looking for:** 



* **You live in mobile F2P.** 
 You play the best mobile F2P games and understand why they make money and why people stay. Economy, retention, and monetization aren’t mysteries; they’re how you think about design.
* **You’re a builder who ships.** 
 You’ve taken something from nothing to done. You’d rather get a rough version in front of players this week than polish a doc for a month.
* **You’re genuinely pro\-AI.** 
 You’re excited about AI in games and in the craft of making them. You try new tools, find where they give you an edge, and you’re drawn to the kinds of games AI now makes possible.
* **High IQ and problem\-solving.** 
 Serious intellectual horsepower. You take messy design problems apart and come back with smart, systematic answers.
* **Clear, organized writer.** 
 You write specs other people can actually follow.
* **Curious and growth\-oriented.** 
 You’re always learning: new techniques, new games, new tools. You treat feedback and hard problems as the reason you’re here.
* **Analytical.** 
 You’re comfortable with data. You can break down a system or a pile of player feedback, find the pattern, and back your calls with reasoning.
* **Detail\-oriented.** 
 You sweat the small stuff that turns a good game into a great one.
* **Show us what you’ve built.** 
 Junior or senior, you have to demonstrate real design ability: shipped games, personal projects, mods, game jam entries, writing, anything that shows how you think and what you can make.

description:
Job Title: Production Head

Location: XLNT Technology, Talawade

Department: Manufacturing / Production

Reports To: Director / Plant Head

Role Overview

The Production Head is responsible for end\-to\-end manufacturing operations, ensuring

maximum efficiency, minimum cost, zero defects, and on\-time delivery. This role demands

strong technical expertise, sharp decision\-making ability, and leadership to manage people,

machines, and processes under high\-pressure production environments.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Production Planning \& Execution

 Develop and execute daily, weekly, and monthly production plans.

 Ensure adherence to delivery timelines with optimal resource utilization.

 Coordinate with PPC, purchase, and stores to avoid shortages or delays.

 Drive capacity planning and load balancing across machines (CNC/VMC).

2\. Shop Floor Management

 Oversee all production activities including CNC, VMC, and manual operations.

 Ensure maximum machine utilization and minimum downtime.

 Monitor OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) and continuously improve it.

 Implement lean manufacturing practices (5S, Kaizen, waste reduction).

3\. Quality \& Rejection Control

 Ensure zero\-defect production mindset across teams.

 Work closely with Quality team to reduce rejection, rework, and scrap.

 Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for production issues and implement CAPA.

 Establish in\-process quality checks and poka\-yoke systems.

4\. Team Leadership \& Workforce Management

 Lead supervisors, engineers, operators, and contract workers.

 Drive discipline, accountability, and performance culture on shop floor.

 Conduct regular training for skill enhancement and multi\-skilling.

 Handle manpower planning, shift allocation, and productivity improvement.

5\. Process Improvement \& Cost Control

 Identify bottlenecks and improve cycle time and productivity.

 Optimize tooling, fixtures, and machining strategies.

 Reduce production cost through efficiency improvements and waste reduction.

 Implement automation wherever feasible (robotics, tool management systems).

6\. Inventory \& Resource Management

 Ensure proper coordination with stores for raw materials and tools.

 Avoid overstocking and shortages through effective planning.

 Monitor consumables, tooling life, and machine maintenance schedules.

7\. New Product Development (NPD) Support

 Work closely with design and NPD teams for smooth product launch.

 Ensure manufacturability and process readiness.

 Develop SOPs and process sheets for new components.

8\. Compliance \& Safety

 Ensure adherence to safety standards and regulatory requirements.

 Maintain safe working environment on shop floor.

 Implement and monitor safety protocols and audits.

Key Skills \& Competencies

Technical Skills

 Strong knowledge of CNC/VMC machining processes.

 Understanding of tooling, fixtures, cutting parameters, and cycle time optimization.

 Knowledge of production planning systems (ERP like Odoo/Tranzacht preferred).

 Familiarity with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement tools.

Leadership Skills

 Strong team management and conflict resolution ability.

 Ability to drive discipline and accountability in workforce.

 High ownership mindset with result\-oriented approach.

Decision\-Making Ability

 Ability to take quick decisions under production pressure.

 Strong analytical thinking for problem\-solving.

 Data\-driven decision\-making using production metrics (OEE, rejection %, downtime).

 Risk assessment and contingency planning skills.

Operational Intelligence

 Deep understanding of end\-to\-end manufacturing flow.

 Ability to balance quality, cost, and delivery simultaneously.

 Strong coordination with cross\-functional teams (Quality, Purchase, Stores, NPD).

Key KPIs (Performance Metrics)

 Production target achievement (%)

 Rejection and rework rate

 Machine utilization / OEE

 On\-time delivery (OTD)

 Cost reduction achieved

 Downtime reduction

 Manpower productivity

Experience \& Qualification

 BE,B.TECH ,Diploma (Mech)in Mechanical Engineering in the same field.

 Freshers or 0\-2 years of experience in manufacturing (CNC/VMC environment preferred).

title: Tech Lead – Full Stack (Web, Mobile & AI/WhatsApp Bots)
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a sharp, delivery\-focused, and hands\-on **Tech Lead – Full Stack Developer** to lead our engineering team across web, mobile, and intelligent automation systems. In this role, you will lead high\-level technical architecture, conduct rigorous code reviews, and provide hands\-on technical guidance and real\-time debugging for junior engineers.

A core focus of this position is architecting and integrating **conversational AI/ML bots and WhatsApp Cloud API chatbots** into production applications. If you excel at mentoring early\-career developers, identifying logic flaws and security vulnerabilities in AI\-generated code, optimizing relational databases, and deploying robust applications, this role is designed for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Hands\-on Architecture \& Full Stack Delivery:** Architect, build, and maintain production\-ready web platforms and cross\-platform mobile apps using **React.js, React Native, Node.js**, and **PostgreSQL**.
* **WhatsApp \& AI/ML Bot Engineering:** Design, build, and deploy conversational **WhatsApp chatbots** using the WhatsApp Business/Cloud API; integrate LLMs/AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, or custom ML pipelines) for intent recognition, structured JSON extraction, and automated workflow triggers.
* **Team Leadership \& Mentorship:** Actively lead, guide, and unblock a team of 5\+ junior/fresher developers through daily technical challenges, hands\-on pair debugging, and core programming coaching.
* **Rigorous Code Reviews \& Quality Control:** Perform thorough, line\-by\-line pull request (PR) reviews. Ensure code quality, clean architecture, and security best practices—specifically identifying edge\-case failures, unhandled exceptions, and hallucinations in code generated by AI tools.
* **Database Design \& Performance Tuning:** Manage **PostgreSQL on AWS RDS**, including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, ACID transactions, and connection pooling.
* **API Design \& Integration Pipelines:** Architect scalable RESTful APIs, manage asynchronous event queues, and implement reliable webhook receivers for third\-party platforms and messaging channels.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** Oversee deployment workflows using **Docker** and maintain cloud infrastructure on **AWS** (RDS, S3, EC2/ECS) alongside automated CI/CD pipelines.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 5–8 years of professional full\-stack engineering experience, including at least 1–2 years in a technical leadership or mentoring capacity.
* **AI/ML \& WhatsApp Bot Integration:** Proven hands\-on experience building, integrating, and deploying **WhatsApp chatbots** via the WhatsApp Cloud/Business API; demonstrated experience integrating LLM APIs or ML models into production backends with strict JSON outputs and asynchronous webhook processing.
* **Frontend \& Mobile Mastery:** Strong proficiency in **React.js** for web applications and **React Native** for cross\-platform mobile applications, state management (Redux/Zustand), and responsive UI implementation.
* **Backend Proficiency:** Deep hands\-on experience with **Node.js, Express.js**, TypeScript/JavaScript (ES6\+), event\-driven asynchronous programming, and secure REST API design.
* **Database Expertise:** Advanced knowledge of **PostgreSQL** (complex queries, indexing, query execution plans, transactions) and hands\-on management of **AWS RDS**.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** Practical experience with **AWS core services** (RDS, EC2, S3\), **Docker containerization**, Docker Compose, and Git workflows.
* **Debugging \& Problem Solving:** Exceptional ability to trace bugs, understand runtime behavior without relying solely on automated tools, and teach foundational programming concepts to junior engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with message queues (AWS SQS, RabbitMQ, or BullMQ) to handle high\-concurrency webhook traffic for chat platforms.
* Familiarity with vector search, semantic embeddings, or caching layers (Redis).
* Prior experience in early\-stage startups, fast\-paced product development, or SaaS delivery.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,637,412\.98 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

**Role Summary**

The Site Engineer (Passive Fire Protection) is responsible for supervising and executing all passive fire protection works at the project site, ensuring compliance with approved drawings, manufacturer guidelines, and relevant codes. The role involves coordinating with contractors, clients, and internal teams to ensure timely, safe, and quality installation of firestop systems, fireproofing, PFP coating, and related works.

* Monitor daily site progress and manage the workforce to achieve targets.

2\. Quality Assurance \& Compliance

* Ensure PFP installation meets manufacturer specifications, UL/ASTM listings, and local fire norms.
* Conduct inspections and prepare quality documentation (checklists, WIR, RFI, etc.).
* Check opening sizes, penetration details, service types, and substrate conditions before installation.

3\. Coordination

* Coordinate with client/site engineers, MEP teams, contractors, and consultants.

4\. Documentation

* Prepare daily progress reports, DPR, photographs, and installation logs.
* Maintain records of approved systems, drawings, and project documentation.

5\. Safety Management

* Ensure safety protocols are followed during installation activities.
* Conduct toolbox talks related to PFP works and safe handling of materials.

**Skills \& Competencies Required**

* Strong understanding of passive fire protection systems and firestopping standards.
* Ability to read and understand technical drawings.
* Knowledge of UL, ASTM, EN standards (preferred).
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Basic computer skills (MS Office, reporting, documentation).
* Problem\-solving attitude and site execution capability.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Diploma / Degree in Civil, Mechanical, Fire, or related engineering field.
* 1–5 years of experience in Passive Fire Protection / Firestop / MEP projects.
* Freshers with relevant training may also apply.
* Experience with sealants, mortars, wraps, collars, coatings, and fireproofing systems preferred.

**Additional Requirements**

* Willingness to travel and work at various project sites.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
* Candidates with relevant Passive Fire Protection / Firestop experience will be preferred.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Salary will be decided based on relevant experience, technical skills and interview performance.
* Company\-related travel expenses will be provided as per company policy.

Interested candidates can share their CV or contact us for further details.

* Manage non\-employee identity: vendors, travelers, locum tenens providers, students, and affiliate users outside the HR feed.

* Document standards, runbooks, and workflows; contribute to the IAM roadmap and automation backlog.


**Requirements**
* 3–5\+ years in identity and access management or systems administration with a heavy identity focus.

 We are looking for a Robotics Simulation Engineer to join our robotics software team, building the simulation environments used to develop and validate next\-generation autonomous mobile robot platforms for industrial mobility applications. In this role, you will model robots, sensors, and physical interactions in a physics\-based 3D simulation environment, and keep that simulation in step with our robot software stack.
 



 This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working close to both software and hardware — reproducing real\-world robot behaviour in simulation, and giving the navigation, perception, and control teams a fast, reliable place to test before anything runs on a physical robot.

* Debug simulation issues related to robot motion, physics, sensors, and software integration.

* Optimize simulation performance and maintain reusable assets, configurations, and documentation.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's or master's in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–5 years of experience in robotics simulation or robotics software development.
* Hands\-on experience with a physics\-based 3D robotics simulation platform such as Isaac Sim, and proficiency in Python.
* Working knowledge of robotics middleware and robot software integration.
* Familiarity with URDF and OpenUSD for importing and configuring robot assets.
* Understanding of robot kinematics, coordinate transformations, rigid\-body physics, collision modelling, and sensor simulation.
* Experience with Linux and Git, and strong debugging, problem\-solving, and communication skills.

 You won't be writing documentation nobody reads. You'll own a subsystem that ships.
 



  





**Autonomy \& Perception** 




 Perception on real orchard footage, VIO/SLAM in GPS\-denied rows, sensor fusion, Jetson deployment, ROS2\.
 



 Strong Python, C\+\+ comfortable, OpenCV/PyTorch work you can show us.
 



**Simulation** 




 Gazebo/Isaac Sim orchard worlds, URDF modelling, synthetic datasets, sim\-to\-real gap analysis, regression testing.
 



 Python \+ ROS2, transforms and quaternions, some physics\-engine experience.
 



**Hardware — Electronics** 




 PCB design in KiCad/Altium, power and BMS, LiDAR and RTK GNSS characterization, CAN, harnessing, STM32/ESP32 firmware.
 



 At least one PCB you've laid out and brought up yourself.
 



**Hardware — Mechanical** 




 Chassis, mounts, gantry and implement CAD, DFM with local vendors, drivetrain and suspension, hands\-on build and iteration.
 



 SolidWorks or Fusion, and willing to get dirty.
 



**Operations** 




 Vendor sourcing, BOM and inventory, field\-trial logistics, cross\-border shipping, documentation.
 



 Organized, follows up relentlessly, any degree background.
 



**Details** 




 Bangalore, near Kudlu Gate Metro — on\-site
 



 1–6 months, flexible to your academic calendar
 



 Stipend: Market Standard
 



 Strong performers get considered for full\-time
 



  





 Recent updates: The Engine (MIT) accelerator, Forum.vc, Draper University top 11 of 60 ,CES 2026, World Ag Expo, U.S. Special Congressional Recognition.
 



  





 Join the future of offroad autonomy

title: Game Developer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Game Developer\-Console Porting
 



**Location** 
 : Remote
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Part\-time (20hrs per week)
 



**Work Roster:** 
 9AM\-1PM Sydney Time
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a talented Game Developer to join one of our Australian client's team. Our client is a publishing studio that works with indie developers to publish and distribute their games on PlayStation and Xbox consoles.
 



  





 The main focus of this role is porting existing, already\-completed games for release on PlayStation and Xbox consoles — taking an indie developer's game and getting it console\-ready. The role also includes hands\-on development work, but porting is the primary responsibility.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with GameMaker Studio 2, Unreal Engine, or a similar game development platform, along with familiarity with GML (GameMaker Language), C\#, and/or Python \- the primary languages used across our codebase. Genuine familiarity with PlayStation consoles is essential, and familiarity with Xbox is preferred \- this can come from console development experience or simply from being an engaged player who understands how these platforms work from a customer perspective.
 



  





 This role suits someone who enjoys taking existing games and getting them ready for console audiences, is genuinely into console gaming, and can collaborate effectively with a remote team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Port and adapt existing, indie\-developed games for release on PlayStation and Xbox consoles, meeting platform\-specific technical and certification requirements.
* Develop and implement game features, mechanics, and interactive experiences as needed, alongside the porting work.
* Work with GameMaker Studio 2, Unreal Engine, or similar game development platforms to build, adapt, and maintain game projects.
* Translate game concepts and requirements into functional and engaging gameplay experiences.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well\-structured code.
* Debug, test, and resolve gameplay, technical, and performance issues, including console\-specific issues that arise during porting.
* Collaborate with designers, artists, indie developer partners, and other team members to deliver console\-ready builds.
* Integrate game assets, animations, audio, UI elements, and other required components.
* Optimise gameplay and technical performance for console hardware.
* Review and evaluate games built by other, including indie, developers as part of the publishing and porting pipeline, providing technical and design feedback.
* Participate in testing, iteration, and refinement based on feedback and platform certification requirements.
* Maintain clear documentation and provide regular updates on porting and development progress.



  





**Requirements** 



* Proven experience porting or adapting games for console platforms (PlayStation and/or Xbox), or strong game development experience with a clear ability to learn console porting and certification processes.
* Genuine familiarity with PlayStation consoles (required) and Xbox consoles (preferred) — as a player or from a technical/customer perspective; being an active console gamer is a strong plus.
* Experience with, or exposure to, the PlayStation Partners or ID@Xbox developer programs is preferred but not required.
* Experience with GameMaker Studio 2, Unreal Engine, Unity, or a similar game development platform.
* Familiarity with GML (GameMaker Language), C\#, and/or Python — the primary languages used across the codebase.
* Good understanding of gameplay mechanics, game systems, debugging, and optimisation.
* Experience taking game features from concept through development, testing, and refinement.
* Ability to work with existing codebases, often built by other developers, and contribute to ongoing projects.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Experience reviewing or evaluating games or code built by other developers, with the ability to give clear, constructive feedback.
* A portfolio, GitHub profile, playable game, or examples of previous game development or porting work is highly desirable.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Remote, part\-time working opportunity.
* Collaborative and supportive remote team environment.
* Opportunity to work on interesting games being published across PlayStation and Xbox

* Develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and data components for syncOS's integration platform

* Write clean, testable, and maintainable code; participate in code reviews and follow established engineering standards. Build and extend integrations for AMRs, AGVs, fleet managers, Warehouse Management Systems, and sensor OEM platforms
* Diagnose and resolve backend, API, protocol, and data\-flow issues during development and deployment

* 1\-3 years of backend software engineering experience, with strong hands\-on proficiency in Python and working knowledge of C\+\+
* Experience building, testing, and debugging backend services, REST APIs, or data\-driven applications
* Hands\-on experience or strong familiarity with Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT, Websockets, CAN, and TCP/IP
* Good understanding of backend fundamentals, API design, networking, data handling, automated testing, and debugging
* Exposure to integrating robotics or automation equipment such as AMRs or AGVs with fleet\-management or orchestration software


**Highly Desirable:**
* Experience integrating Warehouse Management Systems or sensor OEM platforms
* Working proficiency in Golang alongside Python and C\+\+


**Benefits**

* Comprehensive health benefits package
* Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve

title: Associate - Embedded & Electronics Engineer
description:
**About AgResearch Labs** 




 AgResearch Labs (ARL) is an agri\-tech company building climate\-smart clean\-food infrastructure.
 



  





 We develop farm technology, automation systems and digital platforms that help produce pesticide\-free vegetables reliably and at scale. ARL has been recognised among India’s Top 100 DeepTech startups by NASSCOM and has been part of programmes including Stanford Seed Spark, IIM Bangalore NSRCEL and RKVY\-RAFTAAR.
 



  





 As we scale our farms and technology, we are strengthening our in\-house engineering capability across automation, electronics, embedded systems and mechanisation.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an Embedded \& Electronics Engineer who enjoys building real systems, not just prototypes.
 



  





 You will work across firmware, PCB design, sensors, motors, power systems and machine integration, taking electronic systems from concept through testing and into field deployment.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on role based at ARL’s farm in Bangalore Rural.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Own embedded and electronics systems end\-to\-end — firmware, PCB design, schematics, wiring and power electronics.
* Develop and maintain firmware for ESP32, STM32 and similar microcontrollers.
* Build automation and control systems integrating sensors, motors, drivers and actuators.
* Design, test and debug PCBs and electronic subsystems.
* Work closely with Farm Operations, Product and R\&D teams to integrate electronics with machines.
* Take systems from prototype to field\-ready deployment.
* Troubleshoot issues under real farm and operating conditions.
* Maintain schematics, PCB files, BOMs and technical documentation.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 1–3 years of hands\-on experience in embedded systems, electronics, automation or related work.
* Degree or Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics or a related field.
* Experience with PCB design using KiCad, Altium, Eagle, EasyEDA or similar tools.
* Hands\-on experience with ESP32, STM32, Arduino or similar microcontrollers.
* Good understanding of sensors, motors, drivers, communication protocols and power systems.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving ability.
* Builder mindset — you enjoy designing, testing, breaking and improving systems.
* Willingness to relocate and stay full\-time at ARL’s farm in Bangalore Rural.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with custom PCBs or industrial control systems.
* Embedded C/C\+\+, RTOS, HAL or low\-level development.
* Robotics, machine development or industrial automation exposure.
* Experience taking electronics from prototype to deployed product.



  





**What You’ll Get at ARL** 



* Competitive salary.
* Free accommodation at the farm.
* Ownership of real embedded and automation systems.
* Opportunity to build ARL’s next generation of farm automation and mechanisation technology.
* Exposure across electronics, machines, farm operations and product development.
* Direct collaboration with Product, R\&D, Operations and ARL leadership.
* Significant room to grow as ARL’s engineering capability expands.



  





**Job Location** 




 ARL Farm — Bangalore Rural
 



 This is a hands\-on field role and requires staying full\-time at the farm. Accommodation will be provided.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Please complete the application form provided in this job description carefully.
 



  





 Once you have completed all the questions, upload your latest resume in the same form and submit your application. We will review your application and resume shared via Google Form and get back to you if you are shortlisted for the next round.
